declarations.name: CochainComplex.homologyMap_homOfDegreewiseSplit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 011K.** The morphism `δ : C^• → A[1]^•` attached to a degreewise split short exact
sequence induces on cohomology exactly the connecting map of the long exact sequence of 0117,
under the identification `H^i(A[1]^•) = H^{i+1}(A^•)` of tag 011H.

The proof is a diagram chase on the tautological cycle: `δ_eq` computes the connecting map from
any lift of a cycle of `C^•` along `B^• → C^•`, the splitting provides that lift as `(σ i).s`, and
`liftCycles_shift_homologyπ` moves the result across the shift identification.
declarations.statement:
theorem homologyMap_homOfDegreewiseSplit (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ))
    (σ : ∀ n, (S.map (eval C (up ℤ) n)).Splitting) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (i j : ℤ) (hij : (up ℤ).Rel i j) (h : 1 + i = j) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (homOfDegreewiseSplit S σ) i ≫
        ((homologyFunctor C (up ℤ) 0).shiftIso 1 i j h).hom.app S.X₁ =
      hS.δ i j hij

declarations.name: main_theorem_delta_eq_connecting
declarations.doc:
For a short exact sequence `E.S` split in each degree, the map induced on `n`-th cohomology
by the morphism `CochainComplex.homOfDegreewiseSplit E.S E.σ : C ⟶ A⟦1⟧` is the connecting
homomorphism `hS.δ n (n + 1) rfl : H^n(C) → H^{n+1}(A)` followed by the inverse of the shift
isomorphism `H^n(A⟦1⟧) ≅ H^{n+1}(A)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem main_theorem_delta_eq_connecting
    (C : Type*) [Category C] [Abelian C]
    (E : AdmissibleSES C)
    (hS : E.S.ShortExact) (n : ℤ) :
    HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (CochainComplex.homOfDegreewiseSplit E.S E.σ) n =
      hS.δ n (n + 1) rfl ≫
        ((CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso C 1 n (n + 1) (by ring)).app E.S.X₁).inv
declarations.comment: the homology map read through the inverse of the shift identification

declarations.name: CochainComplex.retractionSubHom_eq_neg
declarations.doc: **Stacks 011L**, part (1): `gⁿ = -hⁿ`.
declarations.statement: lemma retractionSubHom_eq_neg (n : ℤ) : retractionSubHom S σ σ' n = -sectionSubHom S σ σ' n

declarations.name: CochainComplex.homotopyHomOfDegreewiseSplit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 011L**, part (2): the family `gⁿ` is a homotopy between the two connecting morphisms
`δ, δ' : C^• ⟶ A[1]^•` of tag 011J.

Part (1) is what makes this true with `g` rather than `h`: passing a `0`-cochain `C^• ⟶ A^•` to a
`(-1)`-cochain `C^• ⟶ A[1]^•` conjugates `δ` by `Cochain.δ_rightShift`'s `(-1)^1`, and that sign
is exactly the one relating `g` to `h`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def homotopyHomOfDegreewiseSplit :
    Homotopy (homOfDegreewiseSplit S σ') (homOfDegreewiseSplit S σ)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.Ungraded
declarations.doc:
Stacks' ungraded spectral sequences `(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ r₀}` in `C`: `E_r ∈ C`,
`d_r : E_r → E_r` with `d_r ∘ d_r = 0`, and `E_{r+1} ≅ Ker(d_r)/Im(d_r)`. This is Mathlib's
`SpectralSequence` for the shape `ComplexShape.refl Unit` on every page: a homological complex of
that shape is one object `X ()` with one differential `d () () : X () ⟶ X ()` squaring to zero.
Stacks' `(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ 1}` is `r₀ = 1`.
declarations.statement: abbrev Ungraded
declarations.comment: (1) the ungraded case: `d_r : E_r → E_r`, `E_{r+1} ≅ Ker(d_r)/Im(d_r)`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.TowerData.step_Z_unique
declarations.doc:
Stacks' characterisation of `Z_{r+1}` at the level of `E_{r₀}`: it is the unique
subobject `X` with `B_r ⊆ X ⊆ Z_r` whose image in `E_r = Z_r/B_r` is `Ker(d_r)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma step_Z_unique {X : Subobject ((E.page r₀).X pq)} (hB : T.B ≤ X) (hZ : X ≤ T.Z)
    (h : (Subobject.exists T.q).obj ((Subobject.pullback T.Z.arrow).obj X) =
      kernelSubobject ((E.pageOfNat k).d pq ((c (r₀ + k)).next pq))) :
    X = T.step.Z
declarations.comment: `Z_{r+1}`: the unique `X` with `B_r ⊆ X ⊆ Z_r` and `X/B_r = Ker(d_r)` in `Z_r/B_r`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.TowerData.step_B_unique
declarations.doc:
Stacks' characterisation of `B_{r+1}` at the level of `E_{r₀}`: it is the unique
subobject `X` with `B_r ⊆ X ⊆ Z_r` whose image in `E_r = Z_r/B_r` is `Im(d_r)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma step_B_unique {X : Subobject ((E.page r₀).X pq)} (hB : T.B ≤ X) (hZ : X ≤ T.Z)
    (h : (Subobject.exists T.q).obj ((Subobject.pullback T.Z.arrow).obj X) =
      imageSubobject ((E.pageOfNat k).d ((c (r₀ + k)).prev pq) pq)) :
    X = T.step.B
declarations.comment: `B_{r+1}`: the unique `X` with `B_r ⊆ X ⊆ Z_r` and `X/B_r = Im(d_r)` in `Z_r/B_r`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.pageIsoSubquotient
declarations.doc: Stacks 011N: `E_r = Z_r/B_r`, for every `r ≥ r₀`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pageIsoSubquotient (r : ℤ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) :
    (E.page r).X pq ≅ cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (E.B pq r) (E.Z pq r) (E.B_le_Z pq r))
declarations.comment: the towers `B_r ⊆ Z_r ⊆ E_{r₀}` with `E_r = Z_r/B_r`, for any shape family and `r₀`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.Z_add_one_self
declarations.doc: Stacks 011N's base step: `Z_2 = Ker(d_1)`, i.e. `Z_{r₀+1} = Ker(d_{r₀})`.
declarations.statement:
lemma Z_add_one_self :
    E.Z pq (r₀ + 1) = kernelSubobject ((E.page r₀).d pq ((c r₀).next pq))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.B_add_one_self
declarations.doc: Stacks 011N's base step: `B_2 = Im(d_1)`, i.e. `B_{r₀+1} = Im(d_{r₀})`.
declarations.statement:
lemma B_add_one_self :
    E.B pq (r₀ + 1) = imageSubobject ((E.page r₀).d ((c r₀).prev pq) pq)

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence
registrations.comment: (1) `(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ r₀}` with `E_{r+1} ≅ Ker(d_r)/Im(d_r)`; any shapes

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.Hom
registrations.comment: (2) `f_r : E_r ⟶ E'_r` commuting with `d_r`, `f_{r+1}` induced by `f_r`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.limitObj
declarations.doc:
Stacks 011O (1): if `Z_∞ = ⋂ Z_r` and `B_∞ = ⋃ B_r` exist as subobjects of `E_{r₀}`, the
limit of the spectral sequence at `pq` is `E_∞ = Z_∞/B_∞`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def limitObj (hZ : IsGLB (Set.range (E.Z pq)) Zinf)
    (hB : IsLUB (Set.range (E.B pq)) Binf) : C
declarations.comment: (1) limit `E_∞ = Z_∞/B_∞` when `⋂ Z_r` and `⋃ B_r` exist

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.isGLB_range_Z
declarations.doc: Stacks 011O (1): `Z_∞ = ⋂ Z_r` exists, and is `Z_{rMin}`, when the pages stabilise.
declarations.statement: theorem isGLB_range_Z : IsGLB (Set.range (E.Z pq)) (E.Z pq (E.rMin pq))
declarations.comment: (1), stabilising case: `Z_∞ = ⋂ Z_r` exists and is `Z_{rMin}`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.isLUB_range_B
declarations.doc: Stacks 011O (1): `B_∞ = ⋃ B_r` exists, and is `B_{rMin}`, when the pages stabilise.
declarations.statement: theorem isLUB_range_B : IsLUB (Set.range (E.B pq)) (E.B pq (E.rMin pq))
declarations.comment: (1), stabilising case: `B_∞ = ⋃ B_r` exists and is `B_{rMin}`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.pageInfinityIsoSubquotient
declarations.doc: Stacks 011O (1): `E_∞ = Z_∞/B_∞`, where `E_∞` is the stable page `pageInfinity`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pageInfinityIsoSubquotient :
    E.pageInfinity pq ≅
      cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (E.B pq (E.rMin pq)) (E.Z pq (E.rMin pq)) (E.B_le_Z pq _))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.limitObjIsoPageInfinity
declarations.doc: Stacks 011O (1), stabilising case: the limit `Z_∞/B_∞` is the stable page `pageInfinity`.
declarations.comment: (1), stabilising case: the limit `Z_∞/B_∞` is the stable page `pageInfinity`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.DegeneratesAt
declarations.doc:
Stacks 011O (2): the spectral sequence degenerates at `E_r` if `d_r, d_{r+1}, …` all
vanish.
declarations.statement: def DegeneratesAt (r : ℤ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r := by lia) : Prop
declarations.comment: (2) degeneration at `E_r`: all differentials `d_{r'}`, `r' ≥ r`, vanish

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.DegeneratesAt.pageIso
declarations.doc:
Stacks 011O, remark: under degeneration at `E_r`, `E_r = E_{r+1} = ⋯`: the pages `E_r` and
`E_{r'}` agree for `r ≤ r'`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pageIso (pq : κ) (r' : ℤ) (hr' : r ≤ r' := by lia) :
    (E.page r hr).X pq ≅ (E.page r' (hr.trans hr')).X pq

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.DegeneratesAt.pageInfinityIso
declarations.doc:
Stacks 011O, remark: if the spectral sequence degenerates at `E_r`, then
`E_r = E_{r+1} = ⋯ = E_∞`: at every position `pq`, the infinity page is `E_{r'}^{pq}` for every
`r' ≥ r`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def pageInfinityIso (pq : κ) (r' : ℤ) (hr' : r ≤ r' := by lia) :
    E.pageInfinity pq ≅ (E.page r' (hr.trans hr')).X pq
declarations.comment: remark: degeneration at `E_r` gives `E_r = E_{r+1} = ⋯ = E_∞`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple
declarations.doc:
An exact couple `(A, E, α, f, g)` in an abelian category: `Ker α = Im f`, `Ker f = Im g`
and `Ker g = Im α`. The endomorphism is typed as `α : End A` so that `α ^ n` is the `n`-fold
composite of `α`.
declarations.statement: structure ExactCouple (C : Type*) [Category* C] [Abelian C]
declarations.comment: (1) exact couple: `Ker α = Im f`, `Ker f = Im g`, `Ker g = Im α`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.Hom
declarations.doc:
A morphism of exact couples `t = (t_A, t_E) : X ⟶ Y`: a pair of morphisms commuting with
`α`, `f` and `g`.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (X Y : ExactCouple C)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.d_comp_d
declarations.doc: `d ∘ d = 0`, since `f ∘ g = 0`.
declarations.statement: lemma d_comp_d : X.d ≫ X.d = 0

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.kernelSubobject_d_eq_pullback_kernelSubobject
declarations.doc: `Ker d = f⁻¹(Ker g)`, as subobjects of `E`.
declarations.statement:
lemma kernelSubobject_d_eq_pullback_kernelSubobject :
    kernelSubobject X.d = (Subobject.pullback X.f).obj (kernelSubobject X.g)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.kernelSubobject_d_eq_pullback_imageSubobject
declarations.doc: `Ker d = f⁻¹(Im α)`, as subobjects of `E`.
declarations.statement:
lemma kernelSubobject_d_eq_pullback_imageSubobject :
    kernelSubobject X.d = (Subobject.pullback X.f).obj (imageSubobject X.α.asHom)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.imageSubobject_d_eq_exists_imageSubobject
declarations.doc: `Im d = g(Im f)`, as subobjects of `E`.
declarations.statement:
lemma imageSubobject_d_eq_exists_imageSubobject :
    imageSubobject X.d = (Subobject.exists X.g).obj (imageSubobject X.f)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.imageSubobject_d_eq_exists_kernelSubobject
declarations.doc: `Im d = g(Ker α)`, as subobjects of `E`.
declarations.statement:
lemma imageSubobject_d_eq_exists_kernelSubobject :
    imageSubobject X.d = (Subobject.exists X.g).obj (kernelSubobject X.α.asHom)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.derived
declarations.doc:
The derived exact couple `(A', E', α', f', g') = (Im α, Ker d / Im d, α', f', g')` of
Stacks 011R (3). An `abbrev` on purpose (load-bearing): the iterated derived couples need
`X.derived.α` to reduce to `X.α'` (and likewise for `A`, `E`, `f`, `g`).
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev derived : ExactCouple C
declarations.comment: (3) the derived couple `(Im α, Ker d/Im d, α', f', g')` is exact

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.spectralSequence
declarations.doc:
The spectral sequence `(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ 1}` of the exact couple `X`: `(E_{n+1}, d_{n+1})` is
`(E^{(n)}, d^{(n)})`, the `E`-object and differential of the `n`-th derived couple, and
`E_{n+2} ≅ Ker d^{(n)}/Im d^{(n)}` is `derivedIterSuccIso n`. An `abbrev` of `Ungraded.ofNat`
on purpose (load-bearing): `X.spectralSequence.X r hr` must reduce to `(X.derivedIter _).E`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev spectralSequence : Ungraded C 1

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.spectralSequenceXIso
declarations.doc:
`E_{n+1} ≅ E^{(n)}`: the `(n + 1)`-st page of the spectral sequence of `X` is the `E` of
the `n`-th derived couple. An `abbrev` on purpose (load-bearing): the 011T statements for
`X.spectralSequence` must see through it.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev spectralSequenceXIso (n : ℕ) :
    X.spectralSequence.X (n + 1) ≅ (X.derivedIter n).E

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.spectralSequence_d
declarations.statement:
lemma spectralSequence_d (n : ℕ) :
    X.spectralSequence.d (n + 1) ≫ (X.spectralSequenceXIso n).hom =
      (X.spectralSequenceXIso n).hom ≫ (X.derivedIter n).d

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.spectralSequenceXOneIso
declarations.doc:
`E_1 ≅ E`. An `abbrev` on purpose (load-bearing): the 011T statements for
`X.spectralSequence` must see through it.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev spectralSequenceXOneIso : X.spectralSequence.X 1 ≅ X.E

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.spectralSequence_d_one
declarations.doc: `d_1 = d` under `E_1 ≅ E`.
declarations.statement:
lemma spectralSequence_d_one :
    X.spectralSequence.d 1 ≫ X.spectralSequenceXOneIso.hom = X.spectralSequenceXOneIso.hom ≫ X.d

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.spectralSequenceXTwoIso
declarations.doc: `E_2 ≅ E'`. An `abbrev` on purpose (load-bearing), as `spectralSequenceXOneIso`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev spectralSequenceXTwoIso : X.spectralSequence.X 2 ≅ X.derived.E

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.spectralSequence_d_two
declarations.doc: `d_2 = g' ∘ f'` under `E_2 ≅ E'`.
declarations.statement:
lemma spectralSequence_d_two :
    X.spectralSequence.d 2 ≫ X.spectralSequenceXTwoIso.hom =
      X.spectralSequenceXTwoIso.hom ≫ (X.f' ≫ X.g')

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.DerivedPages.Z_succ
declarations.doc:
Stacks 011T: `Z_{r+1} = f⁻¹(Im α^r)` under `E_1 ≅ E`, for any ungraded spectral sequence
`E` whose pages are the derived couples of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Z_succ (r : ℕ) :
    E.Z () (r + 1) =
      (Subobject.pullback (D.pageOneIso.hom ≫ X.f)).obj (imageSubobject (X.α ^ r).asHom)
declarations.comment: `Z_{r+1} = f⁻¹(Im α^r)` under `E_1 ≅ E`, for any `E` with derived-couple pages

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.DerivedPages.B_succ
declarations.doc:
Stacks 011T: `B_{r+1} = g(Ker α^r)` under `E_1 ≅ E`, for any ungraded spectral sequence
`E` whose pages are the derived couples of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem B_succ (r : ℕ) :
    E.B () (r + 1) =
      (Subobject.exists (X.g ≫ D.pageOneIso.inv)).obj (kernelSubobject (X.α ^ r).asHom)
declarations.comment: `B_{r+1} = g(Ker α^r)` under `E_1 ≅ E`, for any `E` with derived-couple pages

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.ExactCouple.DerivedPages.d_succ
declarations.doc:
Stacks 011T, the differential: for `x : T ⟶ Z_{r+1}` and `y : T ⟶ A` with `f x = α^r y`
under `E_1 ≅ E`, `d_{r+1}(x̄) = \overline{g y}`: here `x̄ = x ≫ q_{r+1} : T ⟶ E_{r+1}` and
`\overline{g y}` is the class of the lift of `y ≫ g` (Stacks' `g ∘ y`) to `Z_{r+1}` (which
exists by `factors_g`).
declarations.statement:
theorem d_succ (r : ℕ) {T : C} (x : T ⟶ (E.Z () (r + 1) : C)) (y : T ⟶ X.A)
    (hxy : x ≫ (E.Z () (r + 1)).arrow ≫ D.pageOneIso.hom ≫ X.f = y ≫ (X.α ^ r).asHom) :
    x ≫ E.q () (r + 1) ≫ E.d (r + 1) =
      y ≫ (E.Z () (r + 1)).factorThru (X.g ≫ D.pageOneIso.inv) (D.factors_g r) ≫
        E.q () (r + 1)
declarations.comment: `d_{r+1}(x̄) = \overline{g y}` for `x ∈ Z_{r+1}`, `y ∈ A` with `f x = α^r y`

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.B_le_Z
registrations.comment: the inclusions `B_r ⊆ Z_r` of the towers `0 = B_1 ⊆ … ⊆ Z_1 = E`

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.B_monotone
registrations.comment: the inclusions `B_r ⊆ B_{r+1}` of the tower `0 = B_1 ⊆ B_2 ⊆ …`

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.SpectralSequence.Z_antitone
registrations.comment: the inclusions `Z_{r+1} ⊆ Z_r` of the tower `… ⊆ Z_2 ⊆ Z_1 = E`

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.DifferentialObject
registrations.comment: object

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.DifferentialObject.Hom
registrations.comment: morphism

declarations.name: stacksDifferentialObject_abelianStructure
declarations.doc: The abelian structure on the category of differential objects of an abelian category.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def stacksDifferentialObject_abelianStructure
    (C : Type*) [Category C] [Abelian C] :
    Abelian (StacksDifferentialObject C)

declarations.name: stacksDifferentialObject_abelian
declarations.statement: alias stacksDifferentialObject_abelian

declarations.name: StacksDifferentialObject.homology
declarations.doc:
The homology `H(A, d) = Ker(d)/Im(d)` of a differential object, as the homology of
`A --d--> A --d--> A`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev homology (A : StacksDifferentialObject C) : C

declarations.name: StacksDifferentialObject.ShortExactSequence.homology_exact_sequence
declarations.doc:
For a short exact sequence `0 → (A, d) → (B, d) → (C, d) → 0` of
differential objects there is a connecting morphism `δ : H(C, d) ⟶ H(A, d)` making the periodic
sequence `H(A, d) → H(B, d) → H(C, d) -δ→ H(A, d) → H(B, d) → ⋯` exact at every spot.
declarations.statement:
theorem homology_exact_sequence :
    ∃ (δ : S.C.homology ⟶ S.A.homology)
      (h₁ : S.homologyMap₁ ≫ S.homologyMap₂ = 0)
      (h₂ : S.homologyMap₂ ≫ δ = 0)
      (h₃ : δ ≫ S.homologyMap₁ = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk S.homologyMap₁ S.homologyMap₂ h₁).Exact ∧
      (ShortComplex.mk S.homologyMap₂ δ h₂).Exact ∧
      (ShortComplex.mk δ S.homologyMap₁ h₃).Exact

declarations.name: StacksDifferentialObject.spectralSequenceOfEndo
declarations.doc:
The spectral sequence `(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ 0}` associated to a differential object `(A, d)`
and an injective endomorphism `α` commuting with `d`: `(E_0, d_0) = (A/αA, d)`, and for `r ≥ 1`
it is the spectral sequence of the exact couple `(H(A, d), H(A/αA, d), H(α), δ, H(π))`, so
`E_1 = H(A/αA, d)`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev spectralSequenceOfEndo : Ungraded 𝒜 0

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.gr
declarations.doc:
Stacks' graded piece `gr^p(A) = F^pA/F^{p+1}A` of a decreasing `ℤ`-filtration (`I := ℤᵒᵖ`), as
a functor `Fil(𝒜) ⥤ 𝒜`; `(gr p).obj A = cokernel (A.filtration.step (succHom p))` by `rfl`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev gr (p : ℤ) : FilteredObject C ℤᵒᵖ ⥤ C
declarations.comment: the graded pieces `gr^p(A) = F^pA/F^{p+1}A` of the text before 05SP, as functors

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.grGraded
declarations.doc:
Stacks' `gr : Fil(𝒜) ⥤ Gr(𝒜)`, the graded object with `p`-th piece `gr^p(A)`;
`grGraded ⋙ GradedObject.eval p ≅ gr p` is `Iso.refl _`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev grGraded : FilteredObject C ℤᵒᵖ ⥤ GradedObject ℤ C
declarations.comment: the functor `gr : Fil(𝒜) ⥤ Gr(𝒜)` of the paragraph before 05SP

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.antitone
declarations.doc: Stacks 0121(1): a filtration indexed by `ℤᵒᵖ` is decreasing, `F^mA ⊆ F^nA` for `n ≤ m`.
declarations.statement: lemma antitone (F : Filtration X ℤᵒᵖ) : Antitone fun n : ℤ => F.subobject (op n)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.ofAntitone
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0121(1), conversely: a decreasing family `F : ℤ → Subobject X` of subobjects is a
filtration indexed by `ℤᵒᵖ`, whose `n`-th step is (the underlying object of) `F n`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def ofAntitone (F : ℤ → Subobject X) (hF : Antitone F) : Filtration X ℤᵒᵖ
declarations.comment: (1) a decreasing family of subobjects, as a filtration indexed by `ℤᵒᵖ`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.pullback
declarations.doc:
The pullback filtration `f⁻¹F` along `f : Y ⟶ X`, with steps `Y ×_X F^iX`. For a
monomorphism `f` this is the induced filtration `F^iY = Y ∩ F^iX` of Stacks 0121(5).
declarations.statement: noncomputable def pullback (F : Filtration X I) {Y : C} (f : Y ⟶ X) : Filtration Y I
declarations.comment: (5) the induced filtration, along any morphism `f`; the tag is `f` a monomorphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.pushforward
declarations.doc:
The image filtration `π(F)` along `π : X ⟶ Y`, with steps the images of `F^iX ⟶ X ⟶ Y`.
For an epimorphism `π` this is the quotient filtration `F^iY = π(F^iX)` of Stacks 0121(6).
declarations.statement: noncomputable def pushforward (F : Filtration X I) {Y : C} (g : X ⟶ Y) : Filtration Y I
declarations.comment: (6) the quotient filtration, along any morphism `π`; the tag is `π` an epimorphism

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.HasInter
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0121(8): `⋂ F^iA` exists, i.e. the steps have a greatest lower bound in
`Subobject X`.
declarations.statement: def HasInter (F : Filtration X I) : Prop
declarations.comment: (8) existence of `⋂ F^iA`, as a greatest lower bound in `Subobject A`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.HasUnion
declarations.doc: Stacks 0121(8): `⋃ F^iA` exists, i.e. the steps have a least upper bound in `Subobject X`.
declarations.statement: def HasUnion (F : Filtration X I) : Prop
declarations.comment: (8) existence of `⋃ F^iA`, as a least upper bound in `Subobject A`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.IsSeparated
declarations.doc: Stacks 0121(9): a filtration is separated if `⋂ F^iA = 0`.
declarations.statement: def IsSeparated [HasInitial C] [InitialMonoClass C] (F : Filtration X I) : Prop

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.IsExhaustive
declarations.doc: Stacks 0121(9): a filtration is exhaustive if `⋃ F^iA = A`.
declarations.statement: def IsExhaustive (F : Filtration X I) : Prop

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.factors
declarations.doc: Stacks 0121(3), one direction: a morphism of filtered objects satisfies `φ(F^iA) ⊆ F^iB`.
declarations.statement:
lemma factors (f : A ⟶ B) (i : I) :
    (B.subobject i).Factors (A.filtration.ι.app i ≫ f.hom)
declarations.comment: (3) a morphism of filtered objects satisfies `φ(F^iA) ⊆ F^iB`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.homMk'
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0121(3), the other direction: a morphism `φ : A ⟶ B` with `φ(F^iA) ⊆ F^iB` for all
`i` is a morphism of filtered objects.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def homMk' (φ : A.X ⟶ B.X)
    (h : ∀ i, (B.subobject i).Factors (A.filtration.ι.app i ≫ φ)) : A ⟶ B
declarations.comment: (3) `φ` with `φ(F^iA) ⊆ F^iB` for all `i` is a morphism of filtered objects

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration.IsFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0121** (7).
A filtration is finite if some step is all of `X` and some step is an initial object.
declarations.statement: class IsFinite (F : Filtration X I) : Prop extends HasTopStep F, HasBotStep F
declarations.comment: (7) for an arbitrary index category and any category `C`

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.exists_inducedFiltrationStep_le
declarations.doc:
A morphism of filtered complexes carries each step of the induced filtration of cohomology into
the corresponding step: `H^n(φ)(F^pH^n(K^•)) ⊆ F^pH^n(L^•)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma exists_inducedFiltrationStep_le {K L : Filtered C} (φ : K ⟶ L) (n p : ℤ) :
    (Subobject.«exists» (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ.hom n)).obj
        (K.inducedFiltrationStep n p) ≤ L.inducedFiltrationStep n p
declarations.comment: (3) for the filtrations induced on cohomology by a morphism of filtered complexes

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Filtration
registrations.comment: (1) for an arbitrary index category `I`; the tag is `I := ℤᵒᵖ`

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject
registrations.comment: (2) filtered objects of an arbitrary category

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.Hom
registrations.comment: (3) morphisms of filtered objects, as `φ` together with the maps `F^iA ⟶ F^iB`

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.instCategory
registrations.comment: (4) the category `Fil(𝒜)`

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.forget
registrations.comment: the forgetful functor `Fil(𝒜) ⥤ 𝒜`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.hasKernels
declarations.doc: Stacks 0122 (3): `Fil(𝒜)` has kernels.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance hasKernels : HasKernels (FilteredObject C I)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.hasCokernels
declarations.doc: Stacks 0122 (3): `Fil(𝒜)` has cokernels.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance hasCokernels : HasCokernels (FilteredObject C I)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.imageIso
declarations.doc: Stacks 0122 (3): the image of `f` in `Fil(𝒜)` is `Im(f.hom)` with the induced filtration.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def imageIso (f : A ⟶ B) : Abelian.image f ≅ imageObj f
declarations.comment: (3) images `Ker(Coker f)`: `Im(f.hom)` with the induced filtration

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.coimageIso
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0122 (3): the coimage of `f` in `Fil(𝒜)` is `Coim(f.hom)` with the quotient
filtration.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def coimageIso (f : A ⟶ B) : Abelian.coimage f ≅ coimageObj f
declarations.comment: (3) coimages `Coker(Ker f)`: `Coim(f.hom)` with the quotient filtration

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.preadditive
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0122 (1): `Fil(𝒜)` is preadditive. Morphisms are added on the underlying morphism
and on every step of the filtration.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance preadditive : Preadditive (FilteredObject C I)
declarations.comment: (1) `Fil(𝒜)` is preadditive, for any preadditive `𝒜` and any index category

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.hasZeroObject
declarations.doc: Stacks 0122 (2): `Fil(𝒜)` has a zero object.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance hasZeroObject : HasZeroObject (FilteredObject C I)
declarations.comment: (2) the zero object, for any `𝒜` with a zero object and any index category

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.hasBinaryBiproducts
declarations.doc: Stacks 0122 (1): `Fil(𝒜)` has direct sums, `F^i(A ⊕ B) = F^iA ⊕ F^iB`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance hasBinaryBiproducts : HasBinaryBiproducts (FilteredObject C I)
declarations.comment: (1) direct sums `A ⊕ B` with `F^i(A ⊕ B) = F^iA ⊕ F^iB`, for any index category

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.hasFiniteBiproducts
declarations.doc: Stacks 0122 (1): `Fil(𝒜)` is an additive category (preadditive with finite biproducts).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable instance hasFiniteBiproducts [HasZeroObject C] :
    HasFiniteBiproducts (FilteredObject C I)
declarations.comment: (1) `Fil(𝒜)` is additive: preadditive with finite biproducts

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.IsStrict
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0123: a morphism `f : A ⟶ B` of filtered objects is *strict* if
`f(F^iA) = f(A) ∩ F^iB` for all `i`.
declarations.statement: class IsStrict (f : A ⟶ B) : Prop
declarations.comment: for filtered objects of any category with images and pullbacks

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_pullback_eq_sup
declarations.doc:
The remark after Stacks 0123: `f` is strict if and only if `f⁻¹(F^iB) = F^iA + Ker(f)`
for all `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_pullback_eq_sup (f : A ⟶ B) :
    IsStrict f ↔ ∀ i, (Subobject.pullback f.hom).obj (B.subobject i) =
      A.subobject i ⊔ kernelSubobject f.hom
declarations.comment: the equivalent condition `f⁻¹(F^iB) = F^iA + Ker(f)` of the following remark

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_subobject_eq_pullback_of_mono
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0124, the injective case: a monomorphism `u : A ⟶ B` of filtered objects is strict
if and only if the filtration on `A` is the induced filtration `F^iA = A ∩ F^iB`. This holds in
any category with images and pullbacks.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_subobject_eq_pullback_of_mono (f : A ⟶ B) [Mono f.hom] :
    IsStrict f ↔ ∀ i, A.subobject i = (B.filtration.pullback f.hom).subobject i
declarations.comment: the injective case: `u` is strict iff the filtration on `A` is the induced one

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_subobject_eq_pushforward_of_epi
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0124, the surjective case: an epimorphism `u : A ⟶ B` of filtered objects is strict
if and only if the filtration on `B` is the quotient filtration `F^iB = u(F^iA)`. This holds in
any balanced category with images and pullbacks.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_subobject_eq_pushforward_of_epi (f : A ⟶ B) [Epi f.hom] :
    IsStrict f ↔ ∀ i, B.subobject i = (A.filtration.pushforward f.hom).subobject i
declarations.comment: the surjective case: `u` is strict iff the filtration on `B` is the quotient one

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.GradedObject
registrations.comment: for an arbitrary index type and an arbitrary category

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.GradedObject.categoryOfGradedObjects
registrations.comment: the category structure

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.GradedObject.preadditive
declarations.statement: instance preadditive : Preadditive (GradedObject β C)
declarations.comment: the preadditive structure, for an arbitrary index type

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.GradedObject.abelian
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0126**: the category of graded objects of an abelian category is abelian.
Stated for an arbitrary index type; the tag's statement is the case `β := ℤ`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable instance abelian : Abelian (GradedObject β C)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_forall_exact_gr_kernel_ι
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0127, (1) ⇔ (4): `f` is strict iff `gr(Ker f) → gr(A) → gr(B)` is exact, when `A` has a
top step.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_forall_exact_gr_kernel_ι [HasTopStep A.filtration] :
    IsStrict f ↔ ∀ p, ((ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι f) f (kernel.condition f)).map (gr p)).Exact
declarations.comment: (1) ⇔ (4); needs only a top step of `A`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_forall_exact_gr_cokernel_π
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0127, (1) ⇔ (5): `f` is strict iff `gr(A) → gr(B) → gr(Coker f)` is exact, when `B` has
a zero step.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_forall_exact_gr_cokernel_π [HasBotStep B.filtration] :
    IsStrict f ↔
      ∀ p, ((ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (cokernel.condition f)).map (gr p)).Exact
declarations.comment: (1) ⇔ (5); needs only a zero step of `B`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_forall_isIso_gr_of_hasTopStep
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0127, (1) ⇔ (3): `f` is strict iff `gr^p(Coim f) → gr^p(Im f)` is an isomorphism for all
`p`, when `A` has a top step.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_forall_isIso_gr_of_hasTopStep [HasTopStep A.filtration] :
    IsStrict f ↔ ∀ p, IsIso ((gr p).map (Abelian.coimageImageComparison f))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_forall_isIso_gr_of_hasBotStep
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0127, (1) ⇔ (3): `f` is strict iff `gr^p(Coim f) → gr^p(Im f)` is an isomorphism for all
`p`, when `B` has a zero step.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_forall_isIso_gr_of_hasBotStep [HasBotStep B.filtration] :
    IsStrict f ↔ ∀ p, IsIso ((gr p).map (Abelian.coimageImageComparison f))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_forall_exact_gr_kernel_ι_cokernel_π_of_hasTopStep
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0127, (1) ⇔ (6): `f` is strict iff `0 → gr(Ker f) → gr(A) → gr(B) → gr(Coker f) → 0` is
exact, when `A` has a top step.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_forall_exact_gr_kernel_ι_cokernel_π_of_hasTopStep [HasTopStep A.filtration] :
    IsStrict f ↔ ∀ p, (ComposableArrows.mk₃ ((gr p).map (kernel.ι f)) ((gr p).map f)
        ((gr p).map (cokernel.π f))).Exact ∧ Mono ((gr p).map (kernel.ι f)) ∧
        Epi ((gr p).map (cokernel.π f))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_iff_forall_exact_gr_kernel_ι_cokernel_π_of_hasBotStep
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0127, (1) ⇔ (6): `f` is strict iff `0 → gr(Ker f) → gr(A) → gr(B) → gr(Coker f) → 0` is
exact, when `B` has a zero step.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_iff_forall_exact_gr_kernel_ι_cokernel_π_of_hasBotStep [HasBotStep B.filtration] :
    IsStrict f ↔ ∀ p, (ComposableArrows.mk₃ ((gr p).map (kernel.ι f)) ((gr p).map f)
        ((gr p).map (cokernel.π f))).Exact ∧ Mono ((gr p).map (kernel.ι f)) ∧
        Epi ((gr p).map (cokernel.π f))

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_tfae
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0127: for `f : A ⟶ B` with `A` having a top step and `B` a zero step (in particular
for finite filtrations), the following are equivalent: (1) `f` is strict; (2) `Coim f → Im f` is an
isomorphism in `Fil(𝒜)`; (3) `gr(Coim f) → gr(Im f)` is an isomorphism; (4) `gr(Ker f) → gr(A) →
gr(B)` is exact; (5) `gr(A) → gr(B) → gr(Coker f)` is exact; (6) `0 → gr(Ker f) → gr(A) → gr(B) →
gr(Coker f) → 0` is exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_tfae [HasTopStep A.filtration] [HasBotStep B.filtration] :
    [IsStrict f,
      IsIso (Abelian.coimageImageComparison f),
      ∀ p, IsIso ((gr p).map (Abelian.coimageImageComparison f)),
      ∀ p, ((ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι f) f (kernel.condition f)).map (gr p)).Exact,
      ∀ p, ((ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (cokernel.condition f)).map (gr p)).Exact,
      ∀ p, (ComposableArrows.mk₃ ((gr p).map (kernel.ι f)) ((gr p).map f)
        ((gr p).map (cokernel.π f))).Exact ∧ Mono ((gr p).map (kernel.ι f)) ∧
        Epi ((gr p).map (cokernel.π f))].TFAE
declarations.comment: for `A` with a top step and `B` with a zero step; in particular finite filtrations

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.preservesLeftHomologyOf_grMap
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0128, abstract form: for a complex `S` of strict morphisms, `gr_φ` preserves the left
homology of `S`, along any index arrow `φ`: it preserves the kernel of the strict `β`
(`preservesLimit_parallelPair_grMap_of_isStrict`) and the cokernel of `A ⟶ Ker β`, strict because
`α` is (`preservesColimit_parallelPair_grMap_of_isStrict`), i.e. the left homology data
`homologyObjLeftHomologyData S`.
declarations.statement:
instance preservesLeftHomologyOf_grMap [IsStrict S.f] [IsStrict S.g] :
    (grMap φ).PreservesLeftHomologyOf S
declarations.comment: `gr_φ` preserves the left homology of a complex of strict morphisms; any `φ`, `I`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.grMapHomologyIso
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0128: `gr_φ(Ker β / Im α) ≅ Ker(gr_φ β) / Im(gr_φ α)`, along any index arrow, for any
index category; the right-hand side is Mathlib's homology of the short complex `gr_φ(S)`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def grMapHomologyIso [IsStrict S.f] [IsStrict S.g] :
    (grMap φ).obj (homologyObj S) ≅ (S.map (grMap φ)).homology
declarations.comment: `gr(Ker β / Im α) = Ker(gr β) / Im(gr α)`, along any index arrow, any `I`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.grHomologyIso
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0128 in Stacks' indexing: `gr^p(Ker β / Im α) ≅ Ker(gr^p β) / Im(gr^p α)` for every
`p`, for a complex of filtered objects over `ℤᵒᵖ` with `α`, `β` strict.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def grHomologyIso (p : ℤ) :
    (gr p).obj (homologyObj S) ≅ (S.map (gr p)).homology
declarations.comment: in Stacks' indexing, `gr^p(Ker β / Im α) = Ker(gr^p β) / Im(gr^p α)`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.grGradedHomologyIso
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0128 in `Gr(𝒜)`: `gr(Ker β / Im α) ≅ Ker(gr β) / Im(gr α)` as graded objects, the
right-hand side being the homology of `gr(S)` in `Gr(𝒜)` (computed degreewise, as the exact
functor `GradedObject.eval p` preserves homology).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def grGradedHomologyIso :
    grGraded.obj (homologyObj S) ≅ (S.map grGraded).homology
declarations.comment: in `Gr(𝒜)`: `gr(Ker β / Im α) = Ker(gr β) / Im(gr α)` as graded objects

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrictHom_pullbackHom
declarations.doc:
The induced filtration is cartesian over `A`. For `X ⊆ Y ⊆ A` and `m = k ≫ n` this makes
`X → A` strict (Stacks 0129), through `IsStrictHom.isStrict`; no hypothesis on `k`, `n`.
declarations.statement:
instance isStrictHom_pullbackHom (A : FilteredObject C I) {Y : C} (m : Y ⟶ A.X) :
    IsStrictHom (pullbackHom A m)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrictHom_pullbackObjHom
declarations.doc:
The filtration induced along `k ≫ n` is induced along `k` from the one induced along `n`,
`X ∩ F^iA = X ∩ (Y ∩ F^iA)`: `pullbackObjHom A k n` is cartesian, as its composite with the
cartesian `pullbackHom A n` is the cartesian `pullbackHom A (k ≫ n)`. No hypothesis on `k`, `n`.
Hence `X → Y` is strict (Stacks 0129), through `IsStrictHom.isStrict`.
(An instance: `pullbackObjHom` is a `def`, so type class search cannot derive this.)
declarations.statement: instance isStrictHom_pullbackObjHom : IsStrictHom (pullbackObjHom A k n)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_pullbackHom
declarations.doc: A subobject with the induced filtration is a strict monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
instance isStrict_pullbackHom [HasPullbacks C] [HasImages C] (A : FilteredObject C I) {Y : C}
    (m : Y ⟶ A.X) [Mono m] : IsStrict (pullbackHom A m)
declarations.comment: `X → A`, `Y → A`: a subobject with the induced filtration is strict

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_pushforwardHom
declarations.doc:
The image filtration makes `e` a strict morphism, for any `e`: `e(F^iA) ⊆ e(A)`. For an
epimorphism `e` this says that a quotient with the quotient filtration is a strict epimorphism.
declarations.statement:
instance isStrict_pushforwardHom [HasPullbacks C] [HasImages C] (A : FilteredObject C I)
    {Z : C} (e : A.X ⟶ Z) : IsStrict (pushforwardHom A e)
declarations.comment: `Y → Y/X`: a quotient with the quotient filtration is strict

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrictHom_subquotientHom
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0129: the two filtrations on `Y/X` agree, i.e. `Y/X ⟶ A/X` is cartesian: the quotient
filtration on `Y/X` (from the induced filtration on `Y`) is the filtration induced along
`Y/X ⟶ A/X` from the quotient filtration on `A/X`. On the steps this is the identity
`π(Y ∩ F^iA) = q⁻¹(π'(F^iA))`, `π : Y → Y/X`, `π' : A → A/X`, `q : Y/X → A/X`, the modular law
read in `Subobject (Y/X)`. No hypothesis on `k` or `n`: for a monomorphism `n` (Stacks' `Y ⊆ A`)
this is the statement of 0129; in general "induced" means pulled back along `Y/X → A/X`, and
`Mono n` enters only for `Y/X = Ker(A/X → A/Y)`.
declarations.statement: instance isStrictHom_subquotientHom : IsStrictHom (subquotientHom A k n)
declarations.comment:
`Y/X`'s quotient filtration is the one induced from `A/X`, so `Y/X → A/X` is
  strict; any `k`, `n`, any `I`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.subquotientIsoPullbackObj
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0129, literally: `Y/X` with the quotient filtration is `q⁻¹(A/X)`, the pullback along
`q : Y/X ⟶ A/X` of the quotient filtration on `A/X` (for a monomorphism `n`: the subobject
`Y/X ⊆ A/X` with its induced filtration), as filtered objects over `A/X`
(`subquotientIsoPullbackObj_hom_pullbackHom`).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def subquotientIsoPullbackObj :
    subquotientObj A k n ≅
      pullbackObj (pushforwardObj A (cokernel.π (k ≫ n)))
        (cokernel.map k (k ≫ n) (𝟙 X) n (by simp))
declarations.comment: `Y/X` with the quotient filtration is the pullback along `Y/X → A/X` of `A/X`

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.subquotientIsoKernelObj
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0129, literally: `Y/X` with the quotient filtration is `Ker(A/X → A/Y)` with the
induced filtration, as filtered objects over `A/X` (`subquotientIsoKernelObj_hom_kernelι`); the
underlying isomorphism is the third isomorphism theorem `Abelian.cokernelIsoKernelCokernelMap`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def subquotientIsoKernelObj [Mono n] :
    subquotientObj A k n ≅ kernelObj (quotientHom A k n)
declarations.comment: `Y/X` with the quotient filtration is `Ker(A/X → A/Y)` with the induced filtration

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.isStrict_pullbackHom_comp_pushforwardHom
declarations.doc:
Stacks 0129: `Y → A/X` is strict. This is the one claim with content: `Y → A/X` is the strict
morphism `Y → A` (a strict monomorphism when `n` is) followed by the strict epimorphism
`A → A/X`, and by Stacks 05SJ (1) such a composite need not be strict. Here it is, because it is
also the strict epimorphism `Y → Y/X` followed by the strict (cartesian) morphism `Y/X → A/X`, to
which Stacks 05SJ (3) applies (for a monomorphism `n` the latter is a strict monomorphism and
05SJ (2) applies as well). No hypothesis on `k`, `n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStrict_pullbackHom_comp_pushforwardHom :
    IsStrict (pullbackHom A n ≫ pushforwardHom A (cokernel.π (k ≫ n)))
declarations.comment: `Y → A/X` is strict; the case that is not formal from 05SJ

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject
declarations.doc:
A *filtered differential object* `(K, F, d)` of an abelian category `A` is a filtered object
`(K, F)` of `A` endowed with an endomorphism `d : (K, F) → (K, F)` whose square is zero:
`d ∘ d = 0`.
declarations.statement: structure FilteredDifferentialObject extends FilteredObjectForDifferential C

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.exists_page_iso
declarations.doc:
The object `E_r^p` of the `r`-th page is `Z_r^p / B_r^p`, where, inside `gr^p K`,
`Z_r^p = (F^p K ∩ d⁻¹(F^{p + r} K) + F^{p + 1} K) / F^{p + 1} K` and
`B_r^p = (F^p K ∩ d(F^{p - r + 1} K) + F^{p + 1} K) / F^{p + 1} K`; the isomorphism is the identity
on the classes of elements of `F^p K ∩ d⁻¹(F^{p + r} K)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_page_iso (r p : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : X.page r p ≅ cokernel (Subobject.ofLE
      (X.F p ⊓ imageSubobject ((X.F (p - r + 1)).arrow ≫ X.d) ⊔ X.F (p + 1))
      (X.pageCycles r p ⊔ X.F (p + 1))
      (sup_le_sup_right (X.inf_imageSubobject_le_pageCycles r p) _)),
      cokernel.π _ ≫ e.hom = Subobject.ofLE _ _
        (le_sup_left : X.pageCycles r p ≤ X.pageCycles r p ⊔ X.F (p + 1)) ≫ cokernel.π _

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.spectralSequence
declarations.doc:
The spectral sequence `(E_r, d_r)_{r ≥ 0}` associated to a filtered differential object
`(K, F, d)`: its `r`-th page is the graded object `E_r^p = Z_r^p / (D_r^p ∩ Z_r^p)` with the
differential `d_r^p : E_r^p ⟶ E_r^{p + r}` induced by `d`, and the cohomology of `(E_r, d_r)` is
identified with `E_{r + 1}` by the page-turn isomorphism.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def spectralSequence : SpectralSequence A (fun r => ComplexShape.up' r) 0

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.π_spectralSequence_d
declarations.doc:
The differential `d_r^p : E_r^p ⟶ E_r^{p + r}` of the spectral sequence is induced by
`d : Z_r^p ⟶ Z_r^{p + r}`.
declarations.statement:
lemma π_spectralSequence_d (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (p p' : ℤ) (h : p + r = p') :
    cokernel.π _ ≫ (X.spectralSequence.page r hr).d p p' = X.pageδ r p p' h ≫ cokernel.π _

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.homologyπ_spectralSequence_iso_hom
declarations.doc:
The page-turn isomorphism of the spectral sequence sends the class of an `r`-cycle represented
by `x ∈ Z_{r + 1}^p` to the class of `x` in `E_{r + 1}^p`.
declarations.statement:
lemma homologyπ_spectralSequence_iso_hom (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (p : ℤ) {T : A}
    (y : T ⟶ (X.spectralSequence.page r hr).cycles p) (x : T ⟶ (X.pageCycles (r + 1) p : A))
    (x' : T ⟶ (X.pageCycles r p : A))
    (hx : x' ≫ (X.pageCycles r p).arrow = x ≫ (X.pageCycles (r + 1) p).arrow)
    (hy : y ≫ (X.spectralSequence.page r hr).iCycles p = x' ≫ cokernel.π _) :
    y ≫ (X.spectralSequence.page r hr).homologyπ p ≫ (X.spectralSequence.iso r (r + 1) p).hom =
      x ≫ cokernel.π _

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.pageZeroIso
declarations.doc: `E_0^p = gr^p K`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def pageZeroIso (p : ℤ) : X.page 0 p ≅ (X.gr p).X

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.spectralSequence_d_zero
declarations.doc: Under `E_0^p = gr^p K`, the differential `d_0^p` is `gr^p(d)`.
declarations.statement:
lemma spectralSequence_d_zero (p : ℤ) :
    (X.spectralSequence.page 0).d p p ≫ (X.pageZeroIso p).hom =
      (X.pageZeroIso p).hom ≫ (X.gr p).d

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.pageOneIso
declarations.doc: `E_1^p = H(gr^p K, gr^p(d))`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def pageOneIso (p : ℤ) : X.page 1 p ≅ (X.gr p).homology

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.spectralSequence_d_one
declarations.doc:
Under the identifications `E_1^p = H(gr^p K)` and `E_1^{p + 1} = H(gr^{p + 1} K)`, the
differential `d_1^p` of the spectral sequence is the boundary map in homology of the short exact
sequence `0 → gr^{p + 1} K → F^p K / F^{p + 2} K → gr^p K → 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem spectralSequence_d_one (p : ℤ) :
    (X.spectralSequence.page 1).d p (p + 1) ≫ (X.pageOneIso (p + 1)).hom =
      (X.pageOneIso p).hom ≫ (X.grShortExactSequence p).δ

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.inducedFiltration
declarations.doc:
The `p`-th step of the induced filtration on `H(K, d)` is
`F^p H(K, d) := Im (H(F^p K, d) ⟶ H(K, d))`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def inducedFiltration (p : ℤ) : Subobject X.homology

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.gr_homology_isSubquotient_stablePage
declarations.doc:
Let `(K, F, d)` be a filtered differential object of an abelian category, let
`p : ℤ`, and suppose the stable cycles `Z_∞^p` and boundaries `B_∞^p` in degree `p` exist, i.e.
that `Zinf` is the greatest lower bound of the numerators of the `Z_r^p` and `Binf` the least upper
bound of the numerators of the `B_r^p`. Then the numerators `D = Im(d) ⊓ F^p K ⊔ F^{p+1} K` and
`N = Ker(d) ⊓ F^p K ⊔ F^{p+1} K` satisfy `Binf ≤ D ≤ N ≤ Zinf`, and `N / D` is `gr^p H(K, d)`,
the graded piece of the cohomology for the induced filtration, by the isomorphism compatible with
the two quotient maps out of `Ker(d) ⊓ F^p K`. In particular the limit term `E_∞^p = Zinf / Binf`
is defined and has `gr^p H(K, d)` as a subquotient.
declarations.statement:
public theorem gr_homology_isSubquotient_stablePage {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    {K : C} {d : K ⟶ K} (hd : d ≫ d = 0) {F : ℤ → Subobject K} {p : ℤ} (hFp : F (p + 1) ≤ F p)
    {Zinf Binf : Subobject K}
    (hZinf : IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
      F p ⊓ (Subobject.pullback d).obj (F (p + (r : ℤ))) ⊔ F (p + 1)) Zinf)
    (hBinf : IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
      F p ⊓ imageSubobject ((F (p - (r : ℤ))).arrow ≫ d) ⊔ F (p + 1)) Binf)
    {D N : Subobject K} (hD : D = imageSubobject d ⊓ F p ⊔ F (p + 1))
    (hN : N = kernelSubobject d ⊓ F p ⊔ F (p + 1))
    (j : (D : C) ⟶ (N : C)) (hj : j ≫ N.arrow = D.arrow)
    {V W : Subobject (ShortComplex.mk d d hd).cycles}
    (hV : V = (Subobject.pullback (ShortComplex.mk d d hd).iCycles).obj (F p))
    (hW : W = (Subobject.pullback (ShortComplex.mk d d hd).iCycles).obj (F (p + 1)))
    {FH FH' : Subobject (ShortComplex.mk d d hd).homology}
    (hFH : FH = imageSubobject (V.arrow ≫ (ShortComplex.mk d d hd).homologyπ))
    (hFH' : FH' = imageSubobject (W.arrow ≫ (ShortComplex.mk d d hd).homologyπ))
    (ι : (FH' : C) ⟶ (FH : C)) (hι : ι ≫ FH.arrow = FH'.arrow)
    (a : (V : C) ⟶ (N : C)) (ha : a ≫ N.arrow = V.arrow ≫ (ShortComplex.mk d d hd).iCycles)
    (b : (V : C) ⟶ (FH : C))
    (hb : b ≫ FH.arrow = V.arrow ≫ (ShortComplex.mk d d hd).homologyπ) :
    Binf ≤ D ∧ D ≤ N ∧ N ≤ Zinf ∧
      ∃ e : cokernel j ≅ cokernel ι, a ≫ cokernel.π j ≫ e.hom = b ≫ cokernel.π ι

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.WeaklyConvergesTo
declarations.doc:
The spectral sequence *weakly converges to `H(X)`* when the comparison
`gr^p H(X) ⟶ E_∞^p` is an isomorphism for every `p`.
declarations.statement:
def WeaklyConvergesTo (X : FilteredDifferentialObject A) (ss : AssociatedSpectralSequence X) :
    Prop

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.AbutsTo
declarations.doc:
The spectral sequence *abuts to `H(X)`* when it weakly converges and the induced filtration on
`H(X)` is separated and exhaustive: the only subobject contained in every `F^p H(X)` is `⊥`, and
the only one containing every `F^p H(X)` is `⊤`.
declarations.statement: def AbutsTo (X : FilteredDifferentialObject A) (ss : AssociatedSpectralSequence X) : Prop

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.weaklyConverges_iff
declarations.doc:
The spectral sequence of a filtered differential object weakly converges to `H(K)` if and only
if equality holds in (012G) and (012H) for every `p`: the intersection of the numerators of the
cycles is `(Ker(d) ∩ F^p K) + F^{p + 1} K` and the union of the numerators of the boundaries is
`(Im(d) ∩ F^p K) + F^{p + 1} K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyConverges_iff : X.WeaklyConverges ↔ ∀ p : ℤ,
    IsGLB (Set.range (X.cyclesNumerator p)) (X.stableCyclesBound p) ∧
    IsLUB (Set.range (X.boundariesNumerator p)) (X.stableBoundariesBound p)

declarations.name: FilteredDifferentialObject.abuts_iff
declarations.doc:
The spectral sequence of a filtered differential object abuts to `H(K)` if and only if it
weakly converges to `H(K)`, `⋂_p ((Ker(d) ∩ F^p K) + Im(d)) = Im(d)` and
`⋃_p ((Ker(d) ∩ F^p K) + Im(d)) = Ker(d)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem abuts_iff : X.Abuts ↔ X.WeaklyConverges ∧
    IsGLB (Set.range fun p => kernelSubobject X.d ⊓ X.F p ⊔ imageSubobject X.d)
      (imageSubobject X.d) ∧
    IsLUB (Set.range fun p => kernelSubobject X.d ⊓ X.F p ⊔ imageSubobject X.d)
      (kernelSubobject X.d)

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered
declarations.doc:
A filtered complex of `C`: a cochain complex `K^•` together with a decreasing filtration
`F^pK^•` of it by subcomplexes, i.e. a filtered object of `CochainComplex C ℤ` indexed by `ℤᵒᵖ`.
declarations.statement: abbrev Filtered (C : Type u) [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroMorphisms C] : Type _
declarations.comment: as a complex filtered by subcomplexes, the same datum as a complex of `Fil(𝒜)`

declarations.name: CochainComplex.ImageSystem.filtered
declarations.doc:
**The filtration of `X^•` by the images of a system**, as a filtered complex in the sense of
[Stacks, Tag 012L].
declarations.statement: public def filtered : CochainComplex.Filtered C
declarations.comment: a complex filtered by the images of a system of complexes mapping into it

declarations.name: CochainComplex.exists_cohomologicalSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**The spectral sequence of a filtered complex.**  For a filtered complex `(K^•, F)` of an
abelian category, with `Z_r^{p, q} = F^p K^n ⊓ (d^n)⁻¹(F^{p + r}K^{n + 1})` and
`D_r^{p, q} = Z_{r - 1}^{p + 1, q - 1} ⊔ d^{n - 1}(Z_{r - 1}^{p - r + 1, q + r - 2})` as
subobjects of `K^n`, the quotients `E_r^{p, q} = Z_r^{p, q} / (D_r^{p, q} ⊓ Z_r^{p, q})` are the
pages of a cohomological spectral sequence whose differential is induced by `d`, whose zeroth
page is `gr^p K^•`, and whose first page is therefore `H^n(gr^p K^•)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_cohomologicalSpectralSequence
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    (K : FilteredObject (CochainComplex A ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
    (F : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F p n = Subobject.mk ((K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n))
    (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hZ : ∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
      F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)))
    (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hD : ∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
      (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1))) :
    ∃ (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence A 0)
      (e : ∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
        cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n)))
      (α : ∀ (p q n : ℤ), n = p + q → ((E.page 0 le_rfl).X (p, q) ≅
        ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj K).X n)),
      (∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hn : n = p + q),
        ∃ δ : (Z r p n : A) ⟶ (Z r (p + r) (n + 1) : A),
          δ ≫ (Z r (p + r) (n + 1)).arrow = (Z r p n).arrow ≫ K.X.d n (n + 1) ∧
          cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n)) ≫
              (e r p q n hr hn).inv ≫ (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) =
            δ ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right :
                D r (p + r) (n + 1) ⊓ Z r (p + r) (n + 1) ≤ Z r (p + r) (n + 1))) ≫
              (e r (p + r) (q - r + 1) (n + 1) hr (by omega)).inv) ∧
      (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hn : n = p + q) (u : (Z 0 p n : A) ⟶ (K.filtration.obj (op p)).X n),
        u ≫ (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n = (Z 0 p n).arrow →
        cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D 0 p n ⊓ Z 0 p n ≤ Z 0 p n)) ≫
            (e 0 p q n le_rfl hn).inv ≫ (α p q n hn).hom =
          u ≫ (FilteredObject.grMapπ (FilteredObject.succHom p) K).f n) ∧
      (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hn : n = p + q),
        (E.page 0 le_rfl).d (p, q) (p, q + 1) ≫ (α p (q + 1) (n + 1) (by omega)).hom =
          (α p q n hn).hom ≫
            ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj K).d n (n + 1)) ∧
      (∀ p q n : ℤ, n = p + q → Nonempty ((E.page 1).X (p, q) ≅
        ((FilteredObject.gr p).obj K).homology n))

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.exists_iso_firstPage_homology_d_eq_δ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012N (1).** Let `E` be the spectral sequence of the filtered complex `K`, presented
on its first page as in [Stacks, Tag 012M]: `E_1^{p, q} = Z_1^{p, q}/(D_1^{p, q} ∩ Z_1^{p, q})`,
with `d_1` induced by `d`. Then `E_1^{p, q} = H^{p + q}(gr^pK^•)`, the class of
`x ∈ Z_1^{p, q} ⊆ F^pK^{p + q}` going to the class of its image in `gr^pK^{p + q}`, and under
these identifications `d_1^{p, q}` is the boundary map in cohomology of the short exact sequence
of complexes `0 → gr^{p + 1}K^• → F^pK^•/F^{p + 2}K^• → gr^pK^• → 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_firstPage_homology_d_eq_δ :
    ∃ ε : ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (_ : n = p + q),
        (E.page 1).X (p, q) ≅ ((gr p).obj K).homology n,
      (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hn : n = p + q)
          (u : (cycles K.X K.step 1 p n : C) ⟶ (K.filtration.obj (op p)).X n)
          (_ : u ≫ (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n = (cycles K.X K.step 1 p n).arrow)
          (hc : (u ≫ (grMapπ (succHom p) K).f n) ≫ ((gr p).obj K).d n (n + 1) = 0),
        cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : boundaries K.X K.step 1 p n ⊓
            cycles K.X K.step 1 p n ≤ cycles K.X K.step 1 p n)) ≫
            (e p q n hn).inv ≫ (ε p q n hn).hom =
          ((gr p).obj K).liftCycles (u ≫ (grMapπ (succHom p) K).f n) (n + 1) (by simp) hc ≫
            ((gr p).obj K).homologyπ n) ∧
      ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hn : n = p + q),
        (E.page 1).d (p, q) (p + 1, q) ≫ (ε (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega)).hom =
          (ε p q n hn).hom ≫
            (grMapCompShortComplex_shortExact (succHom (p + 1)) (succHom p) K).δ n (n + 1)
              (by simp)

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.d_gr_eq_zero_and_exists_iso_firstPage_d_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012N (2).** If `d(F^pK) ⊆ F^{p + 1}K` for all `p`, then `d` induces the zero
differential on every `gr^pK^•`, so that `E_1^{p, q} = gr^pK^{p + q}`, the class of
`x ∈ Z_1^{p, q} = F^pK^{p + q}` going to its image; and under these identifications `d_1^{p, q}`
is the morphism `gr^pK^{p + q} → gr^{p + 1}K^{p + q + 1}` induced by `d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem d_gr_eq_zero_and_exists_iso_firstPage_d_eq
    (hd : ∀ p n : ℤ, (K.step (p + 1) (n + 1)).Factors ((K.step p n).arrow ≫ K.X.d n (n + 1))) :
    (∀ p i j : ℤ, ((gr p).obj K).d i j = 0) ∧
    ∃ ε : ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page 1).X (p, q) ≅ ((gr p).obj K).X n,
      (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hn : n = p + q)
          (u : (cycles K.X K.step 1 p n : C) ⟶ (K.filtration.obj (op p)).X n)
          (_ : u ≫ (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n = (cycles K.X K.step 1 p n).arrow),
        cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : boundaries K.X K.step 1 p n ⊓
            cycles K.X K.step 1 p n ≤ cycles K.X K.step 1 p n)) ≫
            (e p q n hn).inv ≫ (ε p q n hn).hom =
          u ≫ (grMapπ (succHom p) K).f n) ∧
      ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hn : n = p + q), ∃ μ : ((gr p).obj K).X n ⟶ ((gr (p + 1)).obj K).X (n + 1),
        (∀ (v : (K.filtration.obj (op p)).X n ⟶ (K.filtration.obj (op (p + 1))).X (n + 1)),
          v ≫ (K.filtration.ι.app (op (p + 1))).f (n + 1) =
              (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n ≫ K.X.d n (n + 1) →
            (grMapπ (succHom p) K).f n ≫ μ = v ≫ (grMapπ (succHom (p + 1)) K).f (n + 1)) ∧
        (E.page 1).d (p, q) (p + 1, q) ≫ (ε (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by omega)).hom =
          (ε p q n hn).hom ≫ μ

declarations.name: FilteredComplexSpectralSequence.spectralSequenceMap
declarations.doc:
A morphism `φ : K ⟶ L` of filtered complexes, i.e. carrying each `F^p K^n` into `F^p L^n`,
induces a morphism of spectral sequences `E_r(K) ⟶ E_r(L)`: on the `r`-th pages it is the map
`Z_r^{p,q}(K)/D_r^{p,q}(K) ⟶ Z_r^{p,q}(L)/D_r^{p,q}(L)` induced by `φ`, and these maps commute
with the differentials `d_r` and the identifications `H(E_r) = E_{r+1}`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def spectralSequenceMap :
    spectralSequence K FK hantiK ⟶ spectralSequence L FL hantiL

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.inducedFilteredObject
declarations.doc:
**The cohomology of a filtered complex, filtered.** `H^n(K^•)` together with the filtration
`F^pH^n(K^•) = Im(H^n(F^pK^•) ⟶ H^n(K^•))` induced on it by `(K^•, F)` ([Stacks, Tag 012P]), as
an object of `Fil(C) = CategoryTheory.FilteredObject C ℤᵒᵖ`.  Packaging the induced filtration
this way is what lets `CategoryTheory.FilteredObject.gr p` be applied to it, so that the graded
pieces `gr^pH^n(K^•)` are the values of a functor.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def inducedFilteredObject (K : Filtered C) (n : ℤ) : FilteredObject C ℤᵒᵖ
declarations.comment: the induced filtration of `H^n(K^•)`, bundled as an object of `Fil(𝒜)`

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.inducedFiltration
declarations.doc:
The filtration of `H^n(K^•)` induced by a filtered complex `K^•`, with steps
`F^pH^n(K^•) = Im(H^n(F^pK^•) ⟶ H^n(K^•))`.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def inducedFiltration : Filtration (K.X.homology n) ℤᵒᵖ

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.inducedFilteredObjectFunctor
declarations.doc:
The cohomology `H^n` of a functorial filtered complex, with its induced filtration, as a
functor to `Fil(𝒜)`.
declarations.statement: def inducedFilteredObjectFunctor (G : D ⥤ Filtered C) (n : ℤ) : D ⥤ FilteredObject C ℤᵒᵖ
declarations.comment: the induced filtration of `H^n`, functorially in the filtered complex

declarations.name: CochainComplex.exists_epi_gradedPiece_homology_of_isGLB_isLUB
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012Q.** Let `𝒜` be an abelian category and let `(K^•, F)` be a filtered complex of
`𝒜`, with degreewise filtration subobjects `F^p K^n`. Fix `p, n : ℤ` and write `q = n - p`.
Assume the stable cycles `Z_∞^{p, q}` and the stable boundaries `B_∞^{p, q}` exist, i.e. that
`Z` is the greatest lower bound of the subobjects `F^p K^n ∩ (d^n)⁻¹(F^{p + r}K^{n + 1})
+ F^{p + 1}K^n` and `B` the least upper bound of the subobjects
`F^p K^n ∩ d^{n - 1}(F^{p - r}K^{n - 1}) + F^{p + 1}K^n` of `K^n`. Then
`B_∞^{p, q} ≤ Z_∞^{p, q}`, so the limit `E_∞^{p, q} = Z_∞^{p, q}/B_∞^{p, q}` exists, and the
graded piece `gr^p H^n(K^•)` of the induced filtration on cohomology is a subquotient of it: the
object `A = Ker(d^n) ∩ F^p K^n` maps to `Z_∞^{p, q}` and to `F^p H^n(K^•)`, its image `S` in
`E_∞^{p, q}` is a subobject of `E_∞^{p, q}`, and the induced map `S ⟶ gr^p H^n(K^•)` is an
epimorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_epi_gradedPiece_homology_of_isGLB_isLUB
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ) (p n : ℤ)
    (F : ℤ → ∀ m : ℤ, Subobject (K.X.X m))
    (hF : ∀ p' m : ℤ, F p' m = Subobject.mk ((K.filtration.ι.app (op p')).f m))
    (A : Subobject (K.X.cycles n)) (hA : A = (Subobject.pullback (K.X.iCycles n)).obj (F p n))
    (Z B : Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hZ : IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
      F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔ F (p + 1) n) Z)
    (hB : IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
      F p n ⊓ (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (F (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔ F (p + 1) n) B) :
    B ≤ Z ∧
    ∃ (a : (A : C) ⟶ (Z : C))
      (b : (A : C) ⟶ image (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))
      (S : Subobject (cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ Z) Z inf_le_right)))
      (g : (A : C) ⟶ (S : C))
      (e : (S : C) ⟶ cokernel (image.preComp
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.diagram.map
          (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))),
      A.arrow ≫ K.X.iCycles n = a ≫ Z.arrow ∧
      A.arrow ≫ K.X.homologyπ n =
        b ≫ image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n) ∧
      Epi g ∧ Epi e ∧
      g ≫ S.arrow = a ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ Z) Z inf_le_right) ∧
      g ≫ e = b ≫ cokernel.π (image.preComp
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.diagram.map
          (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))

declarations.name: sub_image_homologyMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012R.** The step `F^{p'}H^n(K^•)` of the induced filtration on cohomology, read as a
subobject of `K^n`, is `Ker(d^n) ∩ F^{p'}K^n + Im(d^{n-1})`.
declarations.statement:
lemma sub_image_homologyMap (F : ℤ → ∀ m : ℤ, Subobject (K.X.X m))
    (hF : ∀ p' m : ℤ, F p' m = Subobject.mk ((K.filtration.ι.app (op p')).f m)) (p' : ℤ) :
    (Subobject.exists (K.X.iCycles n)).obj ((Subobject.pullback (K.X.homologyπ n)).obj
        (Subobject.mk (image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
          (K.filtration.ι.app (op p')) n))))
      = kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p' n ⊔ imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n)

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.WeaklyConverges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012U (1).** The spectral sequence of a filtered complex `K` *weakly converges* to
`H^*(K^•)` if for all `p, n` the stable cycles `Z_∞^{p, n - p}` and boundaries
`B_∞^{p, n - p}` exist and `gr^p H^n(K^•) = E_∞^{p, n - p}` via [Stacks, Tag 012Q]: there is an
isomorphism `E_∞^{p, n - p} = Z_∞^{p, n - p}/B_∞^{p, n - p} ≅ gr^p H^n(K^•)` compatible with the
canonical maps to both from `Ker(d^n) ∩ F^p K^n`.
declarations.statement: def WeaklyConverges : Prop

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.Abuts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012U (2).** The spectral sequence of a filtered complex `K` *abuts* to `H^*(K^•)` if
it weakly converges to `H^*(K^•)` and for all `n` the induced filtration on `H^n(K^•)` is
separated, `⋂_p F^p H^n(K^•) = 0`, and exhaustive, `⋃_p F^p H^n(K^•) = H^n(K^•)`.
declarations.statement: def Abuts : Prop

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.Converges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012U (3).** The spectral sequence of a filtered complex `K` *converges* to
`H^*(K^•)` if it is regular, abuts to `H^*(K^•)`, and
`H^n(K^•) = lim_p H^n(K^•)/F^p H^n(K^•)` for all `n`.
declarations.statement: def Converges : Prop

declarations.name: CochainComplex.exists_iso_stablePage_iff_and_isGLB_isLUB_inducedFiltration_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012V.** Let `𝒜` be an abelian category, let `(K^•, F)` be a filtered complex of `𝒜`
with degreewise filtration subobjects `F p n = F^p K^n`, and fix `p n : ℤ`; write `q = n - p`,
`A = Ker(d^n) ∩ F^p K^n`, `N = Ker(d^n) ∩ F^p K^n + F^{p + 1}K^n` (the left-hand side of the
inclusion (012S)), `D = Im(d^{n - 1}) ∩ F^p K^n + F^{p + 1}K^n` (the right-hand side of the
inclusion (012T)), and `FH p' = F^{p'} H^n(K^•)` for the induced filtration on cohomology. Then:

1. whenever `Z = Z_∞^{p, q}` and `B = B_∞^{p, q}` exist, the graded piece `gr^p H^n(K^•)` is the
   whole of the limit `E_∞^{p, q} = Z/B` — that is, there is an isomorphism between them
   compatible with the two canonical maps out of `A` — if and only if `Z = N` and `B = D`, i.e.
   if and only if (012S) and (012T) are equalities;
2. the induced filtration on `H^n(K^•)` is separated, `⋂_{p'} F^{p'} H^n(K^•) = 0`, if and only if
   `⋂_{p'} (Ker(d^n) ∩ F^{p'}K^n + Im(d^{n - 1})) = Im(d^{n - 1})`, and it is exhaustive,
   `⋃_{p'} F^{p'}H^n(K^•) = H^n(K^•)`, if and only if
   `⋃_{p'} (Ker(d^n) ∩ F^{p'}K^n + Im(d^{n - 1})) = Ker(d^n)`.

Weak convergence to `H^*(K^•)` is (1) for all `p, n`, and abutment is weak convergence together
with (2) for all `n`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_iso_stablePage_iff_and_isGLB_isLUB_inducedFiltration_iff
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ) (p n : ℤ)
    (F : ℤ → ∀ m : ℤ, Subobject (K.X.X m))
    (hF : ∀ p' m : ℤ, F p' m = Subobject.mk ((K.filtration.ι.app (op p')).f m))
    (A : Subobject (K.X.cycles n))
    (hA : A = (Subobject.pullback (K.X.iCycles n)).obj (F p n))
    (N D : Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hN : N = kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n)
    (hD : D = imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n)
    (FH : ℤ → Subobject (K.X.homology n))
    (hFH : ∀ p' : ℤ, FH p' =
      Subobject.mk (image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p')) n))) :
    (∀ Z B : Subobject (K.X.X n),
        IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔ F (p + 1) n) Z →
        IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (F (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔
            F (p + 1) n) B →
        ∀ a : (A : C) ⟶ (Z : C), a ≫ Z.arrow = A.arrow ≫ K.X.iCycles n →
        ∀ b : (A : C) ⟶ image (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n),
          b ≫ image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n) =
            A.arrow ≫ K.X.homologyπ n →
        ((∃ e : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ Z) Z inf_le_right) ≅
              cokernel (image.preComp
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.diagram.map
                  (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)),
            a ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ Z) Z inf_le_right) ≫ e.hom =
              b ≫ cokernel.π (image.preComp
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.diagram.map
                  (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))) ↔
          Z = N ∧ B = D)) ∧
      (IsGLB (Set.range FH) ⊥ ↔
        IsGLB (Set.range fun p' : ℤ => kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p' n ⊔
          imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n)) (imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n))) ∧
      (IsLUB (Set.range FH) ⊤ ↔
        IsLUB (Set.range fun p' : ℤ => kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p' n ⊔
          imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n)) (kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1))))

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.abutsTo_of_isDegreewiseFinite
declarations.doc:
**The spectral sequence of a degreewise finite filtered complex abuts to its cohomology.**

The spectral sequence is presented as in [Stacks, Tag 012W]: by an isomorphism `hE` of each page
with the subquotient `Z_r^{p,q}/(D_r^{p,q} ⊓ Z_r^{p,q})` of `K^n`.  This is the presentation in
which [Stacks, Tag 012M], [Stacks, Tag 012W], [Stacks, Tag 0132] and [Stacks, Tag 015N] all state
their conclusions, so a consumer which has invoked one of those already has the data to hand.

The filtration witnessing the abutment is the one [Stacks, Tag 012P] induces on `H^n(K^•)`, and
degreewise finiteness of the filtration of `K^•` is the only hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
theorem abutsTo_of_isDegreewiseFinite (K : Filtered C) (F : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F p n = Subobject.mk ((K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n))
    (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hZ : ∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
      F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)))
    (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hD : ∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
      (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1)))
    (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence C 0)
    (hE : ∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
      cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n)))
    (hK : K.filtration.IsDegreewiseFinite) :
    SpectralSequence.AbutsTo E (fun n => K.X.homology n)
declarations.comment: (2) and (3) together, in the form `E` abuts to `H^*(K^•)`

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.abutsTo_of_isDegreewiseFinite'
declarations.doc:
**The canonical spectral sequence of a degreewise finite filtered complex abuts to its
cohomology.**  `abutsTo_of_isDegreewiseFinite` for
`CochainComplex.Filtered.spectralSequenceFunctor`, whose pages are the subquotients
`Z_r^{p,q}/(D_r^{p,q} ⊓ Z_r^{p,q})` on the nose, so that the presentation hypotheses are
discharged and degreewise finiteness is the only one left.
declarations.statement:
theorem abutsTo_of_isDegreewiseFinite' (K : Filtered C)
    (hK : K.filtration.IsDegreewiseFinite) :
    SpectralSequence.AbutsTo (spectralSequenceFunctor.obj K) (fun n => K.X.homology n)
declarations.comment: (2) and (3), for the canonical spectral sequence of a filtered complex

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.nonempty_pageInfinityIso_gr'
declarations.doc:
**`E_∞^{p,q} ≅ gr^p H^{p+q}(K^•)`.**  For a filtered complex `(K^•, F)` of an abelian
category whose filtration is finite in each degree, the infinity page of its spectral sequence at
the bidegree `(p, q)` is the `p`-th graded piece of the filtration induced on `H^{p+q}(K^•)`.

This is the convergence datum of [Stacks, Tag 012W](3): the spectral sequence converges to
`H^*(K^•)`.  Degreewise finiteness of the filtration is the only hypothesis; the boundedness, the
finiteness of the induced filtration, the regularity and the two equalities (012S), (012T) that
the statement of 012W lists separately are all consequences of it, and are discharged here.

The isomorphism is `pageInfinityIsoGrAt` at a stable page chosen by `exists_isStableFrom`; only
its existence is asserted, because a page chosen here is not a page chosen anywhere else.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_pageInfinityIso_gr' (hK : K.filtration.IsDegreewiseFinite) (p q : ℤ) :
    Nonempty (E.pageInfinity (p, q) ≅
      (FilteredObject.gr p).obj (K.inducedFilteredObject (p + q)))
declarations.comment: (3), the comparison `E_∞^{p,q} ≅ gr^pH^n(K^•)` of (012V) is an isomorphism

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Filtered.nonempty_pageInfinityIso_gr
declarations.doc:
**`E_∞^{p,q} ≅ gr^p H^{p+q}(K^•)` for the canonical spectral sequence of a filtered
complex.**  `nonempty_pageInfinityIso_gr'` for
`CochainComplex.Filtered.spectralSequenceFunctor`, whose pages are the subquotients
`Z_r^{p,q}/(D_r^{p,q} ⊓ Z_r^{p,q})` on the nose.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_pageInfinityIso_gr (K : Filtered C)
    (hK : K.filtration.IsDegreewiseFinite) (p q : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((spectralSequenceFunctor.obj K).pageInfinity (p, q) ≅
      (FilteredObject.gr p).obj (K.inducedFilteredObject (p + q)))
declarations.comment: (3), for the canonical spectral sequence of a filtered complex

declarations.name: CochainComplex.isBounded_and_converges_of_isDegreewiseFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012W.** Let `𝒜` be an abelian category and let `(K^•, F)` be a filtered complex of
`𝒜` whose filtration is finite in each degree. Let `E` be the spectral sequence of `(K^•, F)`,
so that its page at `(r, p, q)` is `Z_r^{p,q}/D_r^{p,q}` for `n = p + q`, where
`Z_r^{p,q} = F^p K^n ⊓ (d^n)⁻¹(F^{p+r}K^{n+1})` and
`D_r^{p,q} = Z_{r-1}^{p+1,q-1} ⊔ d^{n-1}(Z_{r-1}^{p-r+1,q+r-2})`, and let
`F^p H^n(K^•) = Im(H^n(F^pK^•) ⟶ H^n(K^•))` be the induced filtration on cohomology. Then:

1. `E` is bounded: for every `n` only finitely many `E_0^{p, n-p}` are nonzero;
2. the induced filtration on each `H^n(K^•)` is finite;
3. `E` converges to `H^*(K^•)`: it is regular, `d_r^{p,q} = 0` for `r ≫ 0`, and it converges
   weakly, the stable cycles and boundaries `Z_∞^{p,q}` and `B_∞^{p,q}` existing and being equal
   to `Ker(d^n) ⊓ F^p K^n ⊔ F^{p+1}K^n` and `Im(d^{n-1}) ⊓ F^p K^n ⊔ F^{p+1}K^n`, i.e. equality
   holding in (012S) and (012T);
4. if `𝒞 ⊆ 𝒜` is a weak Serre subcategory with `E_r^{p,q}` in `𝒞` for all `p, q` and some
   `r ≥ 0`, then every `H^n(K^•)` is in `𝒞`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isBounded_and_converges_of_isDegreewiseFinite
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    (K : FilteredObject (CochainComplex A ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
    (hK : K.filtration.IsDegreewiseFinite)
    (F : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F p n = Subobject.mk ((K.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n))
    (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hZ : ∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
      F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)))
    (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.X n))
    (hD : ∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
      (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1)))
    (FH : ∀ (n _p : ℤ), Subobject (K.X.homology n))
    (hFH : ∀ n p : ℤ, FH n p =
      imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (K.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))
    (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence A 0)
    (hE : ∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
      cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n))) :
    (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 0).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
    (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ FH n a = ⊤ ∧ FH n b = ⊥) ∧
    (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), b ≤ r →
      (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0) ∧
    (∀ p n : ℤ,
      IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (K.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔ F (p + 1) n)
        (kernelSubobject (K.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n) ∧
      IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.«exists» (K.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (F (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔ F (p + 1) n)
        (imageSubobject (K.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n)) ∧
    (∀ (P : ObjectProperty A) [P.IsWeakSerreClass] (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r),
      (∀ p q : ℤ, P ((E.page r hr).X (p, q))) → ∀ n : ℤ, P (K.X.homology n))

declarations.name: HomologicalComplex₂.DoubleComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012Y.** A double complex: a `ℤ × ℤ`-indexed family of objects with a horizontal and
a vertical differential, such that `d₁ ∘ d₁ = 0`, `d₂ ∘ d₂ = 0` and the squares commute.
declarations.statement: structure DoubleComplex (C : Type*) [Category* C] [HasZeroMorphisms C]
declarations.comment: the tag's definition, as a structure shaped like `HomologicalComplex`

declarations.name: HomologicalComplex₂.DoubleComplex.equivHomologicalComplex₂
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012Y**, identified with Mathlib: double complexes are exactly the bicomplexes
`HomologicalComplex₂ C (up ℤ) (up ℤ)`, over any category with zero morphisms.
declarations.statement:
def DoubleComplex.equivHomologicalComplex₂ (C : Type*) [Category* C] [HasZeroMorphisms C] :
    DoubleComplex C ≃ HomologicalComplex₂ C (up ℤ) (up ℤ)
declarations.comment: identified with `HomologicalComplex₂ C (up ℤ) (up ℤ)` by a bijection

registrations.name: HomologicalComplex₂
registrations.comment: any complex shapes, any category with zero morphisms; the first index is outer

registrations.comment: rule (3), the squares commute; stated with its two sides swapped

declarations.name: HomologicalComplex₂.hasTotal_of_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012Z**, the existence remark: `Tot(A)` exists when finite coproducts do and each
antidiagonal `{(p, q) | π (p, q) = n}` carries only finitely many nonzero terms.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasTotal_of_finite (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C c₁ c₂) (c₁₂ : ComplexShape I₁₂)
    [TotalComplexShape c₁ c₂ c₁₂] [HasFiniteCoproducts C]
    (h : ∀ n, {pq : I₁ × I₂ | π c₁ c₂ c₁₂ pq = n ∧ ¬ IsZero ((K.X pq.1).X pq.2)}.Finite) :
    K.HasTotal c₁₂
declarations.comment: existence: finite coproducts, finitely many nonzero `A^{p, n - p}` for each `n`

declarations.name: HomologicalComplex₂.ιTotal_d_up_ℤ
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 012Z**, the differential summand-wise for a `ℤ`-cochain double complex: on the
summand `A^{p, q}` of `Tot(A)^n` it is `d₁^{p, q} + (-1)^p d₂^{p, q}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ιTotal_d_up_ℤ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) :
    K.ιTotal (up ℤ) p q n h ≫ (K.total (up ℤ)).d n (n + 1) =
      (K.d p (p + 1)).f q ≫ K.ιTotal (up ℤ) (p + 1) q (n + 1) (by dsimp; lia) +
        p.negOnePow •
          ((K.X p).d q (q + 1) ≫ K.ιTotal (up ℤ) p (q + 1) (n + 1) (by dsimp; lia))
declarations.comment: the tag's formula `d₁ + (-1)^p d₂` on each summand, for `ℤ`-cochain complexes

declarations.name: HomologicalComplex₂.exists_iso_pages_totalFiltration₂
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0130, the second filtration.** Let `(''E_r, ''d_r)` be the spectral sequence of the
total complex of a double complex `K^{•,•}` filtered by the second coordinate, presented as in
[Stacks, Tag 012M] by its pages `Z_r^{p,q}/D_r^{p,q}` and its differentials induced by `d`. Then
2. `''E_0^{p,q} = K^{q,p}` with `''d_0^{p,q} = d_1^{q,p}`;
4. `''E_1^{p,q} = H^q(K^{•,p})` with `''d_1^{p,q} = (-1)^q H^q(d_2^{•,p})`; here `H^q(K^{•,p})`
   is written as the `p`-th term of `H^q_I(K^{•,•})`, whose differential is induced by `d_2`;
6. `''E_2^{p,q} = H^p_{II}(H^q_I(K^{•,•}))`.
