declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.cohomologyOverNatIsoRestriction
declarations.doc:
The cohomology of a sheaf of modules over an open is naturally isomorphic
to the cohomology of its restriction to that open subspace.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cohomologyOverNatIsoRestriction (X : SheafedSpace RingCat.{u})
    (U : Opens X.carrier) (p : ℕ) :
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (OXSh X) (op U) ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((OXSh X).obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).rightDerived p) ≅
      restMod X U ⋙
        ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (OUSh X U) (op (⊤ : Opens U)) ⋙
          forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((OUSh X U).obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens U))))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).rightDerived p)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.cohomologyOverModuleNatIsoRestriction
declarations.doc:
The cohomology of a sheaf of modules over an open is naturally isomorphic, as a module over
the sections of `𝒪_X` on that open, to the cohomology of its restriction to the open subspace.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cohomologyOverModuleNatIsoRestriction (X : SheafedSpace RingCat.{u})
    (U : Opens X.carrier) (p : ℕ) :
    ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (OXSh X)
          (op ((jFun X U).obj (⊤ : Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X.carrier).obj U)))) :
        SheafOfModules.{u} (OXSh X) ⥤ _).rightDerived p) ≅
      restMod X U ⋙ ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (OUSh X U)
          (op (⊤ : Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X.carrier).obj U))) :
        SheafOfModules.{u} (OUSh X U) ⥤ _).rightDerived p)
declarations.comment: cohomology_of_open, as modules over the sections on the open

declarations.name: locality_of_cohomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project Tag 01E3 (Lemma 20.7.2), Locality of cohomology.**
For a ringed space with structure sheaf `R`, a sheaf of `O_X`-modules `F`, an open `U`, a positive
degree `n`, and a cohomology class `ξ ∈ H^n(U, F)`, there exists an open covering
`U = ⨆ i, cover i` (each `cover i ⊆ U`) on which `ξ` restricts to `0`.

Rigorous argument (assembly).
Choose the canonical injective resolution `I := InjectiveResolution.of F` of `F`. The iso
`e_W : Hgroup R W n F ≅ (secCx R I W).homology n` from `InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj`
identifies cohomology with section-complex homology, naturally in the open `W` in the following
precise
sense (`InjectiveResolution.rightDerived_app_eq`): for `h : V ≤ U`,
`Hrestrict R h n F = e_U.hom ≫ homologyMap (r_V) n ≫ e_V.inv`, where
`r_V = (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (secRestrict R h) _).app I.cocomplex`.

Transport `ξ` to `ξ' := e_U.hom ξ ∈ (secCx R I U).homology n`. Apply
`exists_cover_homologyMap_eq_zero`
to `ξ'` (using `n > 0`) to get a cover `U = ⨆ i, cover i`, `hle i : cover i ≤ U`, with
`homologyMap (r_{cover i}) n ξ' = 0` for each `i`. Then, for each `i`,
`Hrestrict R (hle i) n F ξ = e_{cover i}.inv (homologyMap (r_{cover i}) n (e_U.hom ξ))
  = e_{cover i}.inv (homologyMap (r_{cover i}) n ξ') = e_{cover i}.inv 0 = 0`,
using that `e_{cover i}.inv` is an additive group hom (sends `0` to `0`). This is the required
cover.
declarations.statement:
theorem locality_of_cohomology
    (F : SheafOfModules R) (U : Opens X) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (ξ : Hgroup R U n F) :
    ∃ (I : Type u) (cover : I → Opens X) (hle : ∀ i, cover i ≤ U),
      ((⨆ i, cover i) = U) ∧
      ∀ i, Hrestrict R (hle i) n F ξ = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImagePresheaf.preimageCohomologyPresheaf_evaluation_iso
declarations.doc:
The value on `V` of the cohomology presheaf is canonically and naturally isomorphic
to `Hⁿ(f⁻¹(V), -)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def preimageCohomologyPresheaf_evaluation_iso
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Opens Y.carrier) (n : ℕ) :
    (cohFunctor.{u, u, u, u, u, u} (opensMap f) (structureSheafRing X) (structureSheafRing Y)
        (structureSheafHom f)).rightDerived n ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (structureSheafRing Y).obj ⋙
        (evaluation (Opens Y.carrier)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op V) ≅
    Hfunctor (structureSheafRing X) ((opensMap f).obj V) n

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImagePresheaf.preimageCohomologyPresheaf_map_eq_Hrestrict
declarations.doc:
Under the canonical identifications of its values with cohomology, the map of the
cohomology presheaf along `U ⊆ V` is the restriction map of Tag 01E2.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preimageCohomologyPresheaf_map_eq_Hrestrict
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {U V : Opens Y.carrier} (h : U ≤ V) (n : ℕ)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) :
    ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (structureSheafRing Y).obj).obj
          (cohPresheafModule.{u, u, u, u}
            (opensMap f) (structureSheafRing X) (structureSheafRing Y)
            (structureSheafHom f) n F)).map (homOfLE h).op ≫
        (preimageCohomologyPresheaf_evaluation_iso f U n).hom.app F =
    (preimageCohomologyPresheaf_evaluation_iso f V n).hom.app F ≫
        Hrestrict (structureSheafRing X) (leOfHom ((opensMap f).map (homOfLE h))) n F

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImagePresheaf.higherDirectImage_iso_sheafify_preimageCohomology
declarations.doc:
The `n`-th higher direct image is naturally isomorphic to the sheafification of the
presheaf `V ↦ Hⁿ(f⁻¹(V), -)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def higherDirectImage_iso_sheafify_preimageCohomology
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    (modulePushforward f).rightDerivedPlus n ≅
      (cohFunctor.{u, u, u, u, u, u} (opensMap f) (structureSheafRing X) (structureSheafRing Y)
          (structureSheafHom f)).rightDerived n ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (structureSheafRing Y).obj)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImagePresheaf.preimageHypercohomologyPresheaf_evaluation_iso
declarations.doc:
The value on `V` of the bounded-below hypercohomology presheaf is canonically and
naturally isomorphic to the `i`-th hypercohomology of `K` on `f⁻¹(V)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def preimageHypercohomologyPresheaf_evaluation_iso
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Opens Y.carrier) (i : ℤ) :
    (modulePushforward f ⋙ SheafOfModules.forget (structureSheafRing Y)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ i ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (structureSheafRing Y).obj ⋙
        (evaluation (Opens Y.carrier)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op V) ≅
      (secF (structureSheafRing X) ((opensMap f).obj V)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} i

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImagePresheaf.preimageHypercohomologyPresheaf_map_eq_hypercohomologyRestrict
declarations.doc:
Under the canonical identifications of its values with hypercohomology, the map of
the bounded-below hypercohomology presheaf along `U ⊆ V` is the restriction map
induced by restriction of sections.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preimageHypercohomologyPresheaf_map_eq_hypercohomologyRestrict
    (f : X ⟶ Y) {U V : Opens Y.carrier} (h : U ≤ V) (i : ℤ)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))) :
    ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf (structureSheafRing Y).obj).obj
          (preimageHypercohomologyPresheaf f K i)).map (homOfLE h).op ≫
        (preimageHypercohomologyPresheaf_evaluation_iso f U i).hom.app K =
      (preimageHypercohomologyPresheaf_evaluation_iso f V i).hom.app K ≫
        (hypercohomologyRestrict (structureSheafRing X)
          (leOfHom ((opensMap f).map (homOfLE h))) i).app K

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImagePresheaf.derivedPushforwardPlus_homology_iso_sheafify_preimageHypercohomology
declarations.doc:
For a bounded below complex, the `i`-th cohomology sheaf of its derived pushforward
is naturally isomorphic to the sheafification of `V ↦ Hⁱ(f⁻¹(V), K)`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def
    derivedPushforwardPlus_homology_iso_sheafify_preimageHypercohomology
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (i : ℤ) :
    (modulePushforward f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ i ≅
      (modulePushforward f ⋙ SheafOfModules.forget (structureSheafRing Y)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ i ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 (structureSheafRing Y).obj)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.rightDerivedPushforwardRestrictIso_ofLE
declarations.doc:
The comparison `rightDerivedPushforwardRestrictIso` attached to `V'` is the comparison
attached to `V`, whiskered by restriction along `V' ≤ V` and followed by the derived middle
comparison, read through the transitivity isomorphism `moduleRestrictionOfLEIso` on the `Y` side.

Equivalently: the two routes from `R^p f_* ℱ` restricted to `V'`, namely restricting to `V` and
then along `V' ≤ V` or restricting to `V'` directly, induce the same identification of
`(R^p f_* ℱ)|_{V'}` with the `p`-th right derived functor of
`ℱ ↦ (f|_{f⁻¹(V')})_*(ℱ|_{f⁻¹(V')})`.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerivedPushforwardRestrictIso_ofLE (p : ℕ) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (rightDerivedPushforwardRestrictIso f V p).hom
          (moduleRestrictionOfLE Y h) ≫
        (rightDerivedPushforwardRestrictionOfLEIso f h p).hom =
      Functor.whiskerLeft ((modulePushforward f).rightDerived p)
          (moduleRestrictionOfLEIso Y h).hom ≫
        (rightDerivedPushforwardRestrictIso f V' p).hom
declarations.comment: compatibility across nested opens, every degree

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.higherDirectImageRestrictIsoSucc_ofLE
declarations.doc:
The comparison `higherDirectImageRestrictIsoSucc` attached to `V`, whiskered by restriction
along `V' ≤ V` and followed by the transitivity isomorphism `moduleRestrictionOfLEIso` on the
`Y` side, agrees with `higherDirectImageRestrictIsoSuccOfLE` followed by the comparison attached
to `V'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageRestrictIsoSucc_ofLE (p : ℕ) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (higherDirectImageRestrictIsoSucc f V p).hom
          (moduleRestrictionOfLE Y h) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft ((modulePushforward f).rightDerived p)
          (moduleRestrictionOfLEIso Y h).hom =
      (higherDirectImageRestrictIsoSuccOfLE f h p).hom ≫
        (higherDirectImageRestrictIsoSucc f V' p).hom
declarations.comment: higher direct images, compatibility across nested opens

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.higherDirectImageRestrictIso_injectiveResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01E5, compatibility with injective resolutions.**  On injective resolutions,
localization of a higher direct image is obtained by restricting the resolution and applying
the identity-on-sections comparison before taking cohomology.  The augmentation condition `hφ`
says that the comparison of resolutions descends the identity of the restricted module.

`higherDirectImageRestrictIso` is defined by cases on the degree; in positive degree this is
`higherDirectImageRestrictIso_injectiveResolution_succ` and in degree zero it is
`higherDirectImageRestrictIso_injectiveResolution_zero`.
declarations.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageRestrictIso_injectiveResolution (p : ℕ)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) (I : InjectiveResolution M)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V)).obj M))
    (φ : J.cocomplex ⟶
      ((moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
    (hφ : J.ι.f 0 ≫ φ.f 0 =
      (moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V)).map (I.ι.f 0)) :
    (higherDirectImageRestrictIso f V p).hom.app M ≫
        (moduleRestriction Y V).map
          (I.isoRightDerivedObj (modulePushforward f) p).hom =
      (J.isoRightDerivedObj (modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V)) p).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
          (((modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map φ) ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
          (((modulePushforwardRestrictIso f V).hom.mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).app I.cocomplex) ≫
        (((((modulePushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          I.cocomplex).sc p).mapHomologyIso (moduleRestriction Y V)).hom

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.higherDirectImageRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01E5, higher direct images.**  Higher direct images commute naturally with
restriction to an open subspace: for `U = f⁻¹(V)`, restricting a sheaf of `𝒪_X`-modules to `U`
and taking the `p`-th higher direct image along `f|_U` agrees with taking the `p`-th higher
direct image along `f` and restricting to `V`.

In positive degree this is `higherDirectImageRestrictIsoSucc`, which rests on Stacks 01E1; in
degree zero it is the normalized comparison `higherDirectImageRestrictIsoZero`, so that the
degree-zero compatibility below holds by construction.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def higherDirectImageRestrictIso (p : ℕ) :
    moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V) ⋙
          (modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V)).rightDerived p ≅
        (modulePushforward f).rightDerived p ⋙ moduleRestriction Y V

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.higherDirectImageRestrictIso_zero_compatibility
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01E5, degree-zero compatibility.**  In degree zero the higher-direct-image
comparison is the ordinary restriction comparison, after the canonical maps to the zeroth right
derived functors.  This rules out multiplying the degree-zero comparison by an automorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageRestrictIso_zero_compatibility :
    Functor.whiskerLeft
          (moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V))
          (modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V)).toRightDerivedZero ≫
        (higherDirectImageRestrictIso f V 0).hom =
      (modulePushforwardRestrictIso f V).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (modulePushforward f).toRightDerivedZero
          (moduleRestriction Y V)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.derivedPushforwardPlusRestrictIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01E5, bounded below derived image.**  The total right derived pushforward of a
bounded below complex commutes naturally with restriction to an open subspace: deriving
restriction to `U = f⁻¹(V)` and then pushforward along `f|_U` agrees with deriving pushforward
along `f` and then restriction to `V`.

Both sides are right derived functors, along `DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh` and relative to
quasi-isomorphisms, of the two composites of termwise functors; the isomorphism is the one
induced by `modulePushforwardRestrictHomotopyIso` through uniqueness of right derived
functors.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def derivedPushforwardPlusRestrictIso :
    (moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
          (modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ≅
        (modulePushforward f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
          (moduleRestriction Y V).rightDerivedFunctorPlus

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.derivedPushforwardPlusRestrictIso_unit_compatibility
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01E5, compatibility with derived units.**  The derived localization isomorphism is
the one induced by the undeived comparison: after precomposition with the localization functor
its hom intertwines the two composite derived-functor units.  This is the defining
factorization of `Functor.rightDerivedNatTrans`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedPushforwardPlusRestrictIso_unit_compatibility :
    Functor.whiskerRight (modulePushforwardRestrictHomotopyIso f V).hom
          DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh ≫
        successiveRightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit (modulePushforward f) (moduleRestriction Y V) =
      successiveRightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit (moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V))
          (modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V)) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh
          (derivedPushforwardPlusRestrictIso f V).hom

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.modulePushforwardRestrictIso_ofLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01E5, compatibility across nested opens, before deriving.**  Stacks 01E5 asserts
an *equality* of
sheaves, so the comparisons it attaches to two nested opens `V' ≤ V` of `Y` must agree.  Before
deriving that is this cocycle identity: the comparison
`(f|_{f⁻¹(V')})_*(ℱ|_{f⁻¹(V')}) ≅ (f_* ℱ)|_{V'}` is the comparison for `V`, whiskered by
restriction along `V' ≤ V`, composed with the middle comparison
`modulePushforwardRestrictionOfLEIso` and the two transitivity isomorphisms
`moduleRestrictionOfLEIso` on the `X` and the `Y` side.  Equivalently: the two routes from
`ℱ|_{f⁻¹(V)} ↦ ((f|_{f⁻¹(V)})_*(ℱ|_{f⁻¹(V)}))|_{V'}` to `(f_* ℱ)|_{V'}` agree.

This is the "localizing" input to the construction Stacks 02O7 calls *localizing and then
sheafifying*: it is what makes the comparisons over the opens of `Y` fit together into a
statement about sheaves on `Y`, rather than one open at a time.

Every factor is, on sections, a restriction map along an equality of opens, hence the identity
up to the transport of the type of sections; both sides are maps between the same two types, so
`heq_val_map_of_hom` four times forces them to agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem modulePushforwardRestrictIso_ofLE :
    (modulePushforwardRestrictIso f V').hom =
      Functor.whiskerRight (moduleRestrictionOfLEIso X (preimageOpen_mono f h)).inv
          (modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V')) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V))
          (modulePushforwardRestrictionOfLEIso f h).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (modulePushforwardRestrictIso f V).hom
          (moduleRestrictionOfLE Y h) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (modulePushforward f) (moduleRestrictionOfLEIso Y h).hom
declarations.comment: compatibility across nested opens, before deriving

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.higherDirectImageRestrictIso_zero_ofLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01E5, compatibility across nested opens in degree zero.**  The degree-zero
derived comparison `higherDirectImageRestrictIso f V' 0` is compatible with shrinking `V` to
`V'`: after the canonical maps to the zeroth right derived functors it is the degree-zero
comparison for `V`, carried along the three isomorphisms of
`modulePushforwardRestrictIso_ofLE`.

In degree zero both pushforwards are left exact, so the derived comparison is normalized to the
undeived one (`higherDirectImageRestrictIso_zero_compatibility`) and the clause reduces to the
cocycle identity before deriving.  No analogue of Stacks 01E1 for an inclusion of opens is
needed; see the implementation notes for why positive degree is not proved here.
declarations.statement:
theorem higherDirectImageRestrictIso_zero_ofLE :
    Functor.whiskerLeft (moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V'))
          (modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V')).toRightDerivedZero ≫
        (higherDirectImageRestrictIso f V' 0).hom =
      Functor.whiskerRight (moduleRestrictionOfLEIso X (preimageOpen_mono f h)).inv
          (modulePushforward (restrictedMorphism f V')) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (moduleRestriction X (preimageOpen f V))
          (modulePushforwardRestrictionOfLEIso f h).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (modulePushforwardRestrictIso f V).hom
          (moduleRestrictionOfLE Y h) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (modulePushforward f) (moduleRestrictionOfLEIso Y h).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (modulePushforward f).toRightDerivedZero
          (moduleRestriction Y V')
declarations.comment: compatibility across nested opens, degree zero

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.OnSpace.injective_tensorSheaf_of_finiteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:
Tensoring an injective sheaf of modules with a finite locally free sheaf of modules preserves
injectivity.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_tensorSheaf_of_finiteLocallyFree
    (I E : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))
    [Injective I] [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    Injective ((((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
      ⟨((X)).presheaf, ((X)).IsSheaf⟩).obj (E)).obj (I)))

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectionFormula.derivedPushforwardTensorRightRingedSpacePlusIso
declarations.doc:
**The `D⁺` clause of [Stacks, Tag 01E8]**: for a morphism of **ringed spaces** `f : X ⟶ Y` and
a **finite locally free** `𝒪_Y`-module `ℰ`,

`D(- ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^*ℰ) ⋙ Rf_* ≅ Rf_* ⋙ D(- ⊗_{𝒪_Y} ℰ)`

as functors `D⁺(𝒪_X) ⥤ D⁺(𝒪_Y)`: the projection formula in the bounded below derived category,
for an arbitrary morphism of ringed spaces, every object of `D⁺(𝒪_X)` and `ℰ` of arbitrary
rank.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardTensorRightRingedSpacePlusIso :
    (tensorRightSheaf X ((pullbackFunctor f).obj E)).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (pushforwardFunctor f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ≅
      (pushforwardFunctor f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        (tensorRightSheaf Y E).mapDerivedCategoryPlus
declarations.comment: the D⁺ clause: for a morphism of ringed spaces f : X ⟶ Y and a finite locally free 𝒪_Y-module ℰ, the isomorphism ℰ ⊗_{𝒪_Y} Rf_*ℱ ≅ Rf_*(f^*ℰ ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℱ) in D^+(Y), functorial in ℱ

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectionFormula.higherDirectImageProjectionFormulaRingedSpaceIso
declarations.doc:
**The higher direct image clause of [Stacks, Tag 01E8]**: for a morphism of **ringed spaces**
`f : X ⟶ Y`, an arbitrary `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ` and a **finite locally free** `𝒪_Y`-module `ℰ`,

`R^n f_*(ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^*ℰ) ≅ (R^n f_*ℱ) ⊗_{𝒪_Y} ℰ`

for every integer `n`; the tag's `q ≥ 0` is the case `n = (q : ℤ)`.
declarations.statement:
def higherDirectImageProjectionFormulaRingedSpaceIso
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureRingSheaf X)) (n : ℤ) :
    ((pushforwardFunctor f).rightDerivedPlus n).obj
        (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, u, u, u, u} X.sheaf).obj F).obj
          ((pullbackFunctor f).obj E)) ≅
      ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, u, u, u, u} Y.sheaf).obj
        (((pushforwardFunctor f).rightDerivedPlus n).obj F)).obj E
declarations.comment: the higher direct image clause: for a morphism of ringed spaces f : X ⟶ Y, an 𝒪_X-module ℱ and a finite locally free 𝒪_Y-module ℰ, the isomorphisms R^n f_*(ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^*ℰ) ≅ R^n f_*ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_Y} ℰ for every integer n; the tag's q ≥ 0 is the case n = (q : ℤ)

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineProjectionFormula.isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_class_ringedSpace
declarations.doc:
**The projection formula for an arbitrary morphism of ringed spaces at a finite locally free
module on the target**, finite local freeness being the class of [Stacks, Tag 01C6]: for `𝒢` an
arbitrary `𝒪_Z`-module and `ℋ` a finite locally free `𝒪_X`-module, the canonical map
`f_*𝒢 ⊗_{𝒪_X} ℋ ⟶ f_*(𝒢 ⊗_{𝒪_Z} f^*ℋ)` is an isomorphism.

This is `isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_ringedSpace` with its pointwise
input supplied by `exists_moduleRestriction_iso_free_of_isFiniteLocallyFree`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_projectionFormulaMap_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_class_ringedSpace
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} H] :
    IsIso (projectionFormulaMap f G H)
declarations.comment: the q = 0 clause: for a morphism of ringed spaces f, an arbitrary module 𝒢 on the source and a finite locally free module ℋ on the target, the projection formula map f_*𝒢 ⊗ ℋ ⟶ f_*(𝒢 ⊗ f^*ℋ) is an isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.InjectiveRestriction.injective_restriction_surjective
declarations.doc: An injective sheaf of modules has surjective restriction maps.

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AbsoluteMayerVietoris.mayerVietoris_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01EB (Mayer--Vietoris), in the right-derived model of cohomology.**
Every six-term window
`H^n(X,F) ⟶ H^n(U,F) ⊞ H^n(V,F) ⟶ H^n(U ⊓ V,F) ⟶ H^{n+1}(X,F) ⟶ H^{n+1}(U,F) ⊞ H^{n+1}(V,F)
⟶ H^{n+1}(U ⊓ V,F)` of the Mayer--Vietoris sequence is exact.  The two outer maps are the
restriction maps, by `mvFirst_eq` and `mvSecond_eq`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mayerVietoris_exact (n : ℕ) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} O) :
    (ComposableArrows.mk₅ ((mvFirst O U V n).app F) ((mvSecond O U V n).app F)
      ((mvDelta O U V hUV n).app F) ((mvFirst O U V (n + 1)).app F)
      ((mvSecond O U V (n + 1)).app F)).Exact

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AbsoluteMayerVietoris.mono_mvFirst_zero
declarations.doc:
**The Mayer--Vietoris sequence starts with a zero**: the pair of restriction maps
`H⁰(X,F) ⟶ H⁰(U,F) ⊞ H⁰(V,F)` is a monomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mono_mvFirst_zero (F : SheafOfModules.{u} O) :
    Mono ((mvFirst O U V 0).app F)
declarations.comment: the leading zero, in the right-derived model `Hgroup`

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.MayerVietoris.mayerVietorisInitialSequence_exact
declarations.doc: The Mayer--Vietoris sequence is exact at its initial segment, including the leading zero.
declarations.statement:
lemma mayerVietorisInitialSequence_exact :
    (mayerVietorisInitialSequence S F).Exact

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.MayerVietoris.mayerVietoris_delta_naturality
declarations.doc:
The connecting morphisms in the Mayer--Vietoris long exact sequence are natural in the
coefficient sheaf.
declarations.statement:
lemma mayerVietoris_delta_naturality {G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}} (f : F ⟶ G)
    (n₀ n₁ : ℕ) (h : n₀ + 1 = n₁) :
    S.δ F n₀ n₁ h ≫ ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor J n₁).map f).app (op S.X₄) =
      ((Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor J n₀).map f).app (op S.X₁) ≫ S.δ G n₀ n₁ h

registrations.comment: successive windows

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.RelativeMayerVietoris.relativeMayerVietoris
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : X → Y`, two open subspaces covering `X`, and their intersection, the
higher direct images of every module fit into a long exact Mayer--Vietoris sequence, naturally
in the module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem relativeMayerVietoris
    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (iW : W ⟶ X)
    [SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion iU] [SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion iV]
    [SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion iW]
    (cover : Set.range iU.hom.base ∪ Set.range iV.hom.base = Set.univ)
    (intersection : Set.range iW.hom.base =
      Set.range iU.hom.base ∩ Set.range iV.hom.base) :
    Nonempty (RelativeMayerVietorisSequence f iU iV iW)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.RelativeMayerVietoris.relativeMayerVietorisPlus
declarations.doc:
The bounded below higher direct images of a module and of its restrictions to a two-open
cover and to the intersection form a functorial long exact sequence indexed by the integers.
declarations.statement:
public theorem relativeMayerVietorisPlus
    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (iW : W ⟶ X)
    [SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion iU] [SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion iV]
    [SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion iW]
    (cover : Set.range iU.hom.base ∪ Set.range iV.hom.base = Set.univ)
    (intersection : Set.range iW.hom.base =
      Set.range iU.hom.base ∩ Set.range iV.hom.base) :
    Nonempty (RelativeMayerVietorisSequencePlus f iU iV iW)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechDegreeZero.isSheaf_iff_existsUnique_cechRestrictionHomologyMap
declarations.doc:
An abelian presheaf is a sheaf if and only if, for every open covering, the
canonical restriction-induced map from sections on the covered open to zeroth
Čech cohomology is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isSheaf_iff_existsUnique_cechRestrictionHomologyMap
    (F : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :
    F.IsSheaf ↔
      ∀ (ι : Type u) (V : Opens X) (U : ι → Opens X) (hU : V = iSup U),
        ∃! f : F.obj (op V) ⟶
            ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F).homology 0,
          IsIso f ∧
            f ≫ ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F).homologyι 0 =
              cechDegreeZeroRestriction F V U hU ≫
                ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F).pOpcycles 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechExactFunctor.presheafCechComplexFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01EI.** The Čech complex functor
`Č^•(U, -) : PMod(R) ⥤ Comp⁺(Mod_{R(U)})` for a family of opens contained in `U`: a
presheaf of `R`-modules goes to its Čech cochain complex, each term a module over `R(U)`
and each differential `R(U)`-linear.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def presheafCechComplexFunctor
    (R : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{r}) (U : Opens X) {ι : Type w}
    (obj : ι → Opens X) (le : ∀ i, obj i ≤ U) :
    PresheafOfModules.{max v w} R ⥤
      CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v w} (R.obj (op U))) ℕ
declarations.comment: the family is not required to cover `U`, which neither the functor nor its differentials use

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechExactFunctor.presheafCechComplexFunctor_exact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01EJ.** The Čech complex functor on presheaves of
modules is exact.
declarations.statement:
public theorem presheafCechComplexFunctor_exact
    (R : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{r}) (U : Opens X) {ι : Type w}
    (obj : ι → Opens X) (le : ∀ i, obj i ≤ U) :
    exactFunctor (PresheafOfModules.{max v w} R)
      (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max v w} (R.obj (op U))) ℕ)
      (presheafCechComplexFunctor R U obj le)

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.CechComplex.shortExact_map_cechComplexFunctor
declarations.doc:
**The Čech half of [Stacks, Tag 01EJ].** If the sections of a short complex of presheaves are
short exact over every object `inter U x` appearing in the Čech complex of the family `U`, then the
Čech complexes form a short exact sequence of cochain complexes. Short exactness in the presheaf
category, the hypothesis of [Stacks, Tag 01EJ], is the case in which this holds over every object.
declarations.statement:
theorem shortExact_map_cechComplexFunctor
    (hS : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ι),
      (S.map ((evaluation Cᵒᵖ A).obj (op (inter U x)))).ShortExact) :
    (S.map (cechComplexFunctor U)).ShortExact
declarations.comment: exactness of the Čech complex functor into complexes, for Mathlib's cechComplexFunctor, and assuming short exactness of sections only over the intersections that occur in the Čech complex

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechDeltaFunctor.presheafCechCohomologyDeltaFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01EK.** The Čech cohomology functors of a family of opens form a
cohomological delta functor from presheaves of modules over the structure presheaf to
modules over the ring of sections on the ambient open.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def presheafCechCohomologyDeltaFunctor
    (R : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ RingCat.{uR}) (U : Opens X) {ι : Type w}
    (obj : ι → Opens X) (le : ∀ i, obj i ≤ U) :
    { F : DeltaFunctor (PresheafOfModules.{max v w} R)
        (ModuleCat.{max v w} (R.obj (op U))) //
      ∀ n : ℕ, F.functor n =
        ((PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀ (Over.forget U) R ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat
            (op (Over.mk (𝟙 U))) (Over.mkIdTerminal.op) :
              PresheafOfModules.{max v w} R ⥤
                (Over U)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{max v w} (R.obj (op U))) ⋙
          CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor
            (fun i ↦ Over.mk (homOfLE (le i)))) ⋙
          HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{max v w} (R.obj (op U))) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n }

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.CechComplex.cechδ
declarations.doc:
**The connecting map of Čech cohomology.** For a short complex of presheaves whose sections are
short exact over the objects of the Čech complex of `U`, this is the map
`Ȟ^n(𝒰, P₃) ⟶ Ȟ^(n+1)(𝒰, P₁)`.
declarations.comment: the connecting maps and the long exact sequence of Čech cohomology

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.CechComplex.cech_exact₁
declarations.doc:
**Exactness of `Ȟ^n(𝒰, P₃) ⟶ Ȟ^(n+1)(𝒰, P₁) ⟶ Ȟ^(n+1)(𝒰, P₂)`**, one of the three exactness
statements making up the long exact sequence of [Stacks, Tag 01EK].
declarations.statement:
theorem cech_exact₁ (n : ℕ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (cech_δ_comp U S hS n)).Exact
declarations.comment: the connecting maps and the long exact sequence of Čech cohomology

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.CechComplex.cech_exact₂
declarations.doc:
**Exactness of `Ȟ^n(𝒰, P₁) ⟶ Ȟ^n(𝒰, P₂) ⟶ Ȟ^n(𝒰, P₃)`**, one of the three exactness statements
making up the long exact sequence of [Stacks, Tag 01EK].
declarations.statement:
theorem cech_exact₂ (n : ℕ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((cechComplexFunctor U).map S.f) n)
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ((cechComplexFunctor U).map S.g) n)
      (by rw [← HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp, ← Functor.map_comp, S.zero,
        Functor.map_zero, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_zero])).Exact
declarations.comment: the connecting maps and the long exact sequence of Čech cohomology

declarations.name: Stacks.CategoryTheory.CechComplex.cech_exact₃
declarations.doc:
**Exactness of `Ȟ^n(𝒰, P₂) ⟶ Ȟ^n(𝒰, P₃) ⟶ Ȟ^(n+1)(𝒰, P₁)`**, one of the three exactness
statements making up the long exact sequence of [Stacks, Tag 01EK].
declarations.statement:
theorem cech_exact₃ (n : ℕ) :
    (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (cech_comp_δ U S hS n)).Exact
declarations.comment: the connecting maps and the long exact sequence of Čech cohomology

declarations.name: StacksCechPresheaf.ModPresheaf.main_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 20.10.3, tag 01EL.** The natural isomorphism of functors
`Hom_{O_X}(K(U)_•, -) ≅ Č^•(U, -)` itself (the data, not merely its existence), exhibiting the
isomorphism `Hom_{O_X}(K(U)_•, F) ≅ Č^•(U, F)` as natural in `F`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def main_iso (U : Cover X I) :
    homComplexFunctor U ≅ cechComplexFunctor U

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechImagePresheaf.positive_exact
declarations.doc:
The Čech chain complex of an open covering is exact in every positive degree, objectwise on
opens. Equivalently all its positive-degree homology presheaves vanish.

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechImagePresheaf.augmentation_ker
declarations.doc:
The kernel of the canonical augmentation is the image of the first Čech differential. Thus
degree-zero homology is canonically the image presheaf of `K(U)₀ → O_X`, with its evident maps on
restrictions.

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechImagePresheaf.homologyZeroIsoImage
declarations.doc:
The canonical identification of degree-zero homology with the image of the augmentation. Its
value on a homology class is the augmentation of a representative; this specification determines
the isomorphism uniquely.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def homologyZeroIsoImage (U : Cover X I)
    (W : Opens X.carrier) :
    { e : (((Kterm U 0).obj W ⧸ LinearMap.range ((Kdiff U 0).app W)) ≃ₗ[sections X W]
        (imagePresheaf U).obj W) //
      ∀ x : (Kterm U 0).obj W,
        e ((LinearMap.range ((Kdiff U 0).app W)).mkQ x) =
          ⟨augmentationApp U W x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩ }

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechImagePresheaf.homologyZeroIsoImage_naturality
declarations.doc:
The canonical degree-zero identification commutes with restrictions; hence it is an isomorphism
of homology presheaves, not merely a family of isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem homologyZeroIsoImage_naturality (U : Cover X I)
    {W W' : Opens X.carrier} (h : W ≤ W') (x : (Kterm U 0).obj W') :
    (homologyZeroIsoImage U W).1
        ((LinearMap.range ((Kdiff U 0).app W)).mkQ ((Kterm U 0).res h x)) =
      (imagePresheaf U).res h
        ((homologyZeroIsoImage U W').1
          ((LinearMap.range ((Kdiff U 0).app W')).mkQ x))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechDelta.cechDeltaFunctorIsoRightDerived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01EN, first assertion.** Čech cohomology of the covering `𝒰`, as the cohomological
δ-functor on presheaves of `R`-modules of Stacks 01EK, is canonically isomorphic to the
right-derived δ-functor of its degree-zero part. All three inputs of Stacks 01EN are now
available: enough injectives on presheaves of modules (Stacks 01DV), effaceability of the Čech
δ-functor (Stacks 01EL and 01EM), and the δ-functor `cechRightDerivedDeltaFunctor` realizing
the right derived functors. The argument is the one of Stacks 010T and 010U: both δ-functors
are universal, and universal δ-functors with the same degree-zero part are uniquely
isomorphic.
declarations.statement: def cechDeltaFunctorIsoRightDerived : cechDeltaFunctor R 𝒰 ≅ cechRightDerivedDeltaFunctor R 𝒰

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechComparisonU.cechDerivedComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01EN, first assertion (construction), at four independent
universes.** The space, the structure ring, the coefficient modules and the covering index are
independent; the module universe is `max u r v w`, as the indexed products and injective
resolutions need. Every field is the four-universe one of
`Stacks.Cohomology.CechComparisonU`, over the Godement effacement of
`Stacks.Cohomology.CechComparisonU.effaceable_cechDeltaFunctor` and the `derivedδ_eq` field
proved above.

This construction carries the first assertion's proof obligation.
declarations.statement: def cechDerivedComparison : CechDerivedComparison.{u, r, v, w} O 𝒰
declarations.comment: construction of the canonical delta-functor isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechTotalComparison.cechComplexIsoRightDerived
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01EN, moreover assertion.** The functorial quasi-isomorphism from the
Čech complex functor to the total right-derived functor of degree-zero Čech cohomology,
together with, for every injective resolution, the two augmentations into the total Čech
complex that prescribe it.

The isomorphism is built at a resolution chosen for each presheaf; it is natural because the
two augmentations and the comparison with the total right derived functor are each natural in
the resolution, and independent of that choice because naturality over the identity says so.
declarations.statement: noncomputable def cechComplexIsoRightDerived : CechComplexIsoRightDerived.{u} O 𝒰

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.existsUnique_cechRestrictionHomologyMap
declarations.doc:
There is a unique `R(V)`-linear map from the sections of `I` over the covered open `V` to
the degree `0` Čech cohomology whose composite with the inclusion of the homology into the
opcycles is induced by the restriction map, and it is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_cechRestrictionHomologyMap (V : Opens X) (U : ι → Opens X)
    (hU : V = ⨆ i, U i) (I : SheafOfModules.{uM} R) :
    ∃! f : (SheafOfModules.evaluation R (op V)).obj I ⟶ (cechComplex V U hU I).homology 0,
      IsIso f ∧ f ≫ (cechComplex V U hU I).homologyι 0 =
        cechDegreeZeroRestriction V U hU I ≫ (cechComplex V U hU I).pOpcycles 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.isZero_homology_cechComplex_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01EP, positive degrees.** The cohomology of the module-valued Čech
complex of an injective sheaf of modules, for a covering of an open subset `V` by a family
`U`, vanishes in every positive degree.

An injective sheaf of modules is injective as a presheaf of modules, so it splits off its
global cofree hull; the restriction of that hull to the opens over `V` is a product of cofree
presheaves of `R(V)`-modules and of zero presheaves, whose positive-degree Čech cohomology
vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_homology_cechComplex_of_injective (V : Opens X) (U : ι → Opens X)
    (hU : V = ⨆ i, U i) (I : SheafOfModules.{uM} R) [Injective I] (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsZero ((cechComplex V U hU I).homology n)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechSheaf.existsUnique_cechRestrictionHomologyMap
declarations.doc:
**The degree-zero clause of [Stacks, Tag 01EP].**  There is a unique `R(V)`-linear map from
the sections of `ℱ` on the covered open to degree-zero Čech cohomology whose composite with the
inclusion of homology into the degree-zero opcycles is the restriction map to the cover, and
that map is an isomorphism.

Existence is `homologyZeroIso`, which is the sheaf condition for the cover: the augmentation
is a kernel of the first Čech differential.  Uniqueness is the monomorphy of
`HomologicalComplex.homologyι`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_cechRestrictionHomologyMap :
    ∃! f : (SheafOfModules.evaluation.{uM} R (op V)).obj I ⟶ (cechComplex V U hU I).homology 0,
      IsIso f ∧
        f ≫ (cechComplex V U hU I).homologyι 0 =
          cechDegreeZeroRestriction V U hU I ≫ (cechComplex V U hU I).pOpcycles 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechSheaf.isZero_cechComplex_homology_of_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01EP, positive degrees.** The positive-degree module-valued Čech cohomology of an
injective sheaf of modules vanishes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_cechComplex_homology_of_injective
    (V : Opens X) (U : ι → Opens X) (hU : V = ⨆ i, U i)
    (I : SheafOfModules.{uM} R) [Injective I] (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero ((cechComplex V U hU I).homology p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechDerived.cechToDerivedGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
**The canonical natural transformation from the Čech complex of an open cover to derived
global sections on the covered open.**

It is built at an injective resolution chosen for each sheaf of modules; it is natural because
the two augmentations and the identification of the sections of a resolution with derived
sections are each natural in the resolution.

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechDerived.cechCohomologyToCohomology
declarations.doc:
**The canonical maps from Čech cohomology to sheaf cohomology**, natural in the sheaf of
modules.
declarations.statement:
def cechCohomologyToCohomology (p : ℤ) :
    (cechComplexPlusFunctor O U Ui hU ⋙ DerivedCategory.Plus.Q ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ p) ⟶
      (derivedGlobalSectionsFunctor O U ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechDerived.nonempty_cechResolutionComparison
declarations.doc:
**For every injective resolution, the canonical comparison is the map prescribed by the
total Čech complex construction.**  In particular it is independent of the resolution.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_cechResolutionComparison (F : SheafOfModules.{u} O)
    (J : InjectiveResolution F) :
    Nonempty (CechResolutionComparison O U Ui hU
      (cechToDerivedGlobalSections O U Ui hU) F J)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechOne.cechH1ToRightDerivedSections
declarations.doc:
The canonical additive comparison from the Čech quotient to the first
right-derived functor of sections, for an arbitrary abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cechH1ToRightDerivedSections
    {I : Type w}
    (U : Opens X) (Ui : I → Opens X) (hUi : U = ⨆ i, Ui i)
    (H : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v} X) :
    CechCochains.CechH1 Ui H.presheaf →+
      (((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v}).obj
        (op U)).rightDerived 1).obj H

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechOne.exists_cechOneResolutionRepresentative
declarations.doc:
Every Čech cocycle admits the representative prescribed by the total-complex
construction, in every injective resolution, and its class is the comparison image.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_cechOneResolutionRepresentative
    {I : Type w}
    (U : Opens X) (Ui : I → Opens X) (hUi : U = ⨆ i, Ui i)
    (H : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v} X) (J : InjectiveResolution H)
    (z : CechCochains.cocycles1 Ui H.presheaf) :
    ∃ r : CechOneResolutionRepresentative X U Ui hUi H J z,
      cechH1ToRightDerivedSections X U Ui hUi H (CechCochains.cls Ui H.presheaf z) =
        (@InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj _ _ AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v} _ _ _ _ H J
          ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v}).obj
            (op U)) (inferInstanceAs
              (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v} ⋙
                (evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v}).obj (op U)).Additive) 1).inv
          ((abelianResolutionSections X U J).homologyπ 1 r.cycle)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechOne.cechH1ToRightDerivedSections_apply
declarations.doc:
Any injective-resolution representative computes the canonical comparison;
neither the chosen zero-cochain nor the chosen resolution changes its value.
declarations.statement:
theorem cechH1ToRightDerivedSections_apply
    {I : Type w} (U : Opens X) (Ui : I → Opens X) (hUi : U = ⨆ i, Ui i)
    (H : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v} X) (J : InjectiveResolution H)
    (z : CechCochains.cocycles1 Ui H.presheaf)
    (r : CechOneResolutionRepresentative X U Ui hUi H J z) :
    cechH1ToRightDerivedSections X U Ui hUi H (CechCochains.cls Ui H.presheaf z) =
      (@InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj _ _ AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v} _ _ _ _ H J
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v}).obj
          (op U)) (inferInstanceAs
              (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v} ⋙
                (evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v}).obj (op U)).Additive) 1).inv
        ((abelianResolutionSections X U J).homologyπ 1 r.cycle)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechOne.cechH1ToRightDerivedSections_naturality
declarations.doc: Naturality of the additive-sheaf comparison, expressed on Čech cocycles.
declarations.statement:
theorem cechH1ToRightDerivedSections_naturality
    {I : Type w}
    (U : Opens X) (Ui : I → Opens X) (hUi : U = ⨆ i, Ui i)
    {H G : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v} X} (f : H ⟶ G)
    (z : CechCochains.cocycles1 Ui H.presheaf) (z' : CechCochains.cocycles1 Ui G.presheaf)
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin 2 → I,
      z'.val i = (f.hom.app (op (CechCochains.inter Ui i))) (z.val i)) :
    (((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{max uX v}).obj
      (op U)).rightDerived 1).map f
        (cechH1ToRightDerivedSections X U Ui hUi H (CechCochains.cls Ui H.presheaf z)) =
      cechH1ToRightDerivedSections X U Ui hUi G (CechCochains.cls Ui G.presheaf z')
declarations.comment: naturality of the additive-sheaf degree-one comparison

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedForget.rightDerivedForgetEvaluationIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01ER.** The value on `U` of the `p`-th right derived functor of the inclusion
`Mod(O) ⟶ PMod(O)` is canonically the `p`-th right derived functor of sections on `U`. The
isomorphism is natural in the coefficient sheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def rightDerivedForgetEvaluationIso (U : Opens X) (p : ℕ) :
    (SheafOfModules.forget O).rightDerived p ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation O.obj (op U) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.evaluation O (op U)).rightDerived p

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedForget.rightDerivedForgetCohomologyIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01ER.** After forgetting the module structure, the value on `U` of the `p`-th
right derived functor of `Mod(O) ⟶ PMod(O)` is canonically `H^p(U, -)`. This is an isomorphism
of functors in the coefficient sheaf.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def rightDerivedForgetCohomologyIso (U : Opens X) (p : ℕ) :
    (SheafOfModules.forget O).rightDerived p ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf O.obj ⋙
        (evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat).obj (op U) ≅
      Hfunctor O U p

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedForget.rightDerivedForgetCohomologyIso_naturality_open
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01ER.** The canonical identification of the derived presheaf with
`U ↦ H^p(U, -)` commutes with restriction from an open subset `V` to an open subset `U`.
declarations.statement:
lemma rightDerivedForgetCohomologyIso_naturality_open
    {U V : Opens X} (h : U ≤ V) (p : ℕ) (F : SheafOfModules O) :
    ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf O.obj).obj
          (((SheafOfModules.forget O).rightDerived p).obj F)).map (homOfLE h).op ≫
        (rightDerivedForgetCohomologyIso O U p).hom.app F =
      (rightDerivedForgetCohomologyIso O V p).hom.app F ≫ Hrestrict O h p F

registrations.name: SheafOfModules.Finite.forgetPreservesFiniteLimits
registrations.comment: left exact

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechSpectral.cechSpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**The functorial Čech spectral sequence of an open covering**, with second page
`Ȟ^p(𝒰, H^q(ℱ))` and abutment `H^{p+q}(U, ℱ)`.

This is [Stacks, Tag 01ES]: the four fields are `SheafOfModules.enoughInjectives_opens`,
`cechSpectralSequenceFunctor`, `cechPageTwoIso` and `cechAbutment`.
declarations.statement: def cechSpectralSequence : CechSpectralSequenceData.{u, r, v, w} O 𝒰

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechAcyclic.isIso_cechCohomologyToCohomology_app
declarations.doc:
An open covering whose nonempty finite intersections are acyclic for a module sheaf
computes the cohomology of that sheaf by its Čech complex.

This is the whole of [Stacks, Tag 01ET]: the source's equality `Ȟᵖ(𝒰, ℱ) = Hᵖ(U, ℱ)` of
`𝒪_X(U)`-modules is read here as the canonical comparison of [Stacks, Tag 01EQ] being an
isomorphism, both sides living in the derived category of `𝒪_X(U)`-modules.  `hacyclic` is the
acyclicity of `ℱ` on the intersections `U_{i₀ … i_r}`, and the two instance binders are
synthesizable for any topological space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_cechCohomologyToCohomology_app
    [HasSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [(Opens.grothendieckTopology X).WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} O)
    (hacyclic : ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : Fin (r + 1) → I) (q : ℕ), 0 < q →
      IsZero (((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} O (op (⨅ k, Ui (s k)))).rightDerived q).obj F))
    (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((cechCohomologyToCohomology O U Ui hU (p : ℤ)).app F)
declarations.comment: the comparison of Tag 01EQ is an isomorphism in every degree

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechDegreeOneVanishing.cech_h1_vanishing_implies_surjective_on_sections
declarations.doc:
**Theorem (Stacks project, Tag 01EU; Lemma 20.11.7).** Let `X` be a (ringed) space and
`0 → F → G → H → 0` a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on `X` (the underlying short exact
sequence of the given short exact sequence of `O_X`-modules), encoded as a short exact
`ShortComplex` `S` with `S.X₁ = F`, `S.X₂ = G`, `S.X₃ = H`, `S.f = a`, `S.g = b`. Let `U ⊆ X` be
open and suppose there is a cofinal system `𝒮` of open coverings of `U` with `Ȟ¹(𝒰, F) = 0` for
every `𝒰 ∈ 𝒮`. Then the map on sections over `U` induced by `b`, `b_U : G(U) → H(U)`, is
surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem cech_h1_vanishing_implies_surjective_on_sections
    (S : ShortComplex (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X)) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (U : Opens X)
    (𝒮 : Set (OpenCovering U)) (hcof : CofinalCoveringSystem 𝒮)
    (hH1 : ∀ 𝒰 ∈ 𝒮, CechH1IsZero (S.X₁.1) 𝒰) :
    Function.Surjective
      (((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat X).map S.g).app (op U))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechVanishing.isZero_rightDerived_sections_of_isZero_cechHomology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01EV.** If all positive-degree Čech cohomology of a sheaf
of modules vanishes, then every positive right-derived functor of sections vanishes.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerived_sections_of_isZero_cechHomology
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [UnivLE.{u, v}]
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{v})
    (F : SheafOfModules.{v} R)
    (hF : ∀ {I : Type (max u v)} (U : I → Opens X) (p : ℕ), 0 < p →
      IsZero (((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
        (F.val.presheaf ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u, v})).homology p)) :
    ∀ (U : Opens X) (p : ℕ), 0 < p →
      IsZero ((((SheafOfModules.toSheaf R ⋙
        (sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{v}).obj
          (op U)).rightDerived p).obj F))

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.BasisCycles.isZero_hgroup_of_cech_isZero_on_basis
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 01EW.** Let `B` be a basis of open subsets of a ringed space and let `Cov` be a
collection of open covers by members of `B` whose finite intersections also lie in `B`.  If every
open cover of a member of `B` is refined by a member of `Cov` covering it, and the positive-degree
Čech cohomology of `F` vanishes for every cover in `Cov`, then the higher cohomology of `F`
vanishes over every member of `B`.

This is the case `T = SheafOfModules.toSheaf R` of `isZero_Hobj_of_cech_isZero_on_basis`: the
Čech acyclicity of the injective objects is `cechAcyclicInjectives_toSheaf`, Stacks 01EA followed
by Stacks 09SZ.

The hypothesis that `B` is a basis is not needed: the cofinality hypothesis `hCovCofinal` already
provides all the covers the proof uses.  It is kept because it is part of the statement of the
tag.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_hgroup_of_cech_isZero_on_basis (F : SheafOfModules.{max u w} R)
    (B : Set (Opens X)) (_hB : Opens.IsBasis B) (Cov : Set (OpenCover X))
    (hCovBasis : ∀ U ∈ Cov, U.carrier ∈ B ∧ (∀ i, U.obj i ∈ B) ∧
      ∀ (p : ℕ) (s : Fin (p + 1) → U.ι), (⨅ k, U.obj (s k)) ∈ B)
    (hCovCofinal : ∀ U ∈ B, ∀ V : OpenCover X, V.carrier = U →
      ∃ W ∈ Cov, W.carrier = U ∧ W.Refines V)
    (hCech : ∀ U ∈ Cov, ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → CechCohomologyIsZero R F U n)
    (U : Opens X) (hU : U ∈ B) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    IsZero (Hgroup R U n F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.PushforwardAcyclic.pushforward_injective_rightAcyclic
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01EX, part (2).** The pushforward of an injective module is right acyclic for
the sections functor on every open subset.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pushforward_injective_rightAcyclic
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) [Injective I]
    (V : Opens Y.carrier) :
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation (structureSheafRing Y) (op V)).rightAcyclic
      ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePushforward f).obj I)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.PushforwardAcyclic.pushforward_injective_cechCohomology_isZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01EX, part (1).** The positive-degree Čech cohomology of the pushforward of an
injective module vanishes for every family of opens, and hence for every open covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem pushforward_injective_cechCohomology_isZero
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) [Injective I]
    {J : Type u} (U : J → Opens Y.carrier) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (((cechComplexFunctor U).obj
      ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePushforward f).obj I).val.presheaf).homology p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforwardSections.rightDerivedSectionsRestrictionIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01EZ.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of ringed spaces and an open `V` of `Y`,
let `U = f⁻¹(V)`. The composite of derived sections over `U` with derived restriction of
scalars along `Γ(V, 𝒪_Y) → Γ(U, 𝒪_X)` is naturally isomorphic to the composite of
derived pushforward along `f` with derived sections over `V`. Thus the corresponding square of
bounded-below derived categories commutes.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def rightDerivedSectionsRestrictionIso
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Opens Y.carrier) :
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation (structureSheafRing X)
          (op ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.opensMap f).obj V))).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.structureSheafHom f).hom.app
            (op V)).hom).rightDerivedFunctorPlus
      ≅
    (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePushforward f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
      (SheafOfModules.evaluation (structureSheafRing Y)
        (op V)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforwardSections.rightDerivedSectionsRestrictionIso_hom_app
declarations.doc:
The derived comparison is induced by the identity on underived sections: its
composite with the two derived-functor units is the comparison through pushforward.
This equation fixes the canonical isomorphism, including its normalization on degree-zero
cohomology.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerivedSectionsRestrictionIso_hom_app
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Opens Y.carrier)
    (K : HomotopyCategory.Plus
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))) :
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
        ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.structureSheafHom f).hom.app
          (op V)).hom).rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnith.app
        ((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing X)
          (op ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.opensMap f).obj V))).mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj
            K) ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.structureSheafHom f).hom.app
            (op V)).hom).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
          ((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing X)
            (op ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.opensMap f).obj
              V))).rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnith.app K) ≫
        (rightDerivedSectionsRestrictionIso f V).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj K) =
      DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.map
          ((Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryPlusCompIso
              (F := SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing X)
                (op ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.opensMap f).obj V)))
              (G := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
                ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.structureSheafHom f).hom.app (op V)).hom)
              (sectionsRestrictionIso f V)).hom.app K ≫
            (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryPlusCompIso (Iso.refl
              (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePushforward f ⋙
                SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing Y)
                  (op V)))).inv.app K) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing Y)
          (op V)).rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnith.app
          ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePushforward f).mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
        (SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing Y)
          (op V)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
          ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePushforward f).rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnith.app
            K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforwardSections.rightDerivedSectionsRestrictionIso_hom_app
declarations.doc:
The derived comparison is induced by the identity on underived sections: its
composite with the two derived-functor units is the comparison through pushforward.
This equation fixes the canonical isomorphism, including its normalization on degree-zero
cohomology.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerivedSectionsRestrictionIso_hom_app
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Opens Y.carrier)
    (K : HomotopyCategory.Plus
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))) :
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
        ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.structureSheafHom f).hom.app
          (op V)).hom).rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnith.app
        ((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing X)
          (op ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.opensMap f).obj V))).mapHomotopyCategoryPlus.obj
            K) ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u}
          ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.structureSheafHom f).hom.app
            (op V)).hom).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
          ((SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing X)
            (op ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.opensMap f).obj
              V))).rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnith.app K) ≫
        (rightDerivedSectionsRestrictionIso f V).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj K) =
      DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.map
          ((Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryPlusCompIso
              (F := SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (structureSheafRing X)
                (op ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.opensMap f).obj V)))

                ((RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.structureSheafHom f).hom.app (op V)).hom)
              (sectionsRestrictionIso f V)).hom.app K ≫

declarations.comment: the comparison is induced by the identity on underived sections

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModuleComparison.rightDerivedFunctorPlus_sections_forget_iso
declarations.doc:
The comparison between module and abelian-sheaf cohomology is valid for bounded below
complexes and is natural in the complex.
declarations.statement:
def rightDerivedFunctorPlus_sections_forget_iso (U : Opens X.carrier) :
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation (structureSheafRing X) (op U)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing X).obj.obj (op U)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ≅
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing X)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op U)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModuleComparison.rightDerivedFunctorPlus_sections_forget_iso_unit
declarations.doc:
The bounded-below sections comparison is the canonical one: it intertwines the two
units from ordinary sections.
declarations.statement:
lemma rightDerivedFunctorPlus_sections_forget_iso_unit (U : Opens X.carrier) :
    moduleSectionsDerivedUnit X U ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh
          (rightDerivedFunctorPlus_sections_forget_iso X U).hom =
      abelianSectionsDerivedUnit X U
declarations.comment: bounded below complexes, part (1), canonical comparison

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModuleComparison.rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso_cocycles
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01F1, part (1), canonical comparison in every degree.**  In every degree the
comparison sends a cocycle to the same cocycle in an abelian injective resolution, for any
comparison `φ` of resolutions extending the identity and any induced map `c` on cocycles.

Degree zero is `rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso_cocycles_zero`; in positive degree this is
`rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso_cocycles_of_hom_app_eq` with its hypothesis discharged by
`sectionsComparisonIso_hom_app_succ_eq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso_cocycles (n : ℕ) (M : SheafOfModules.{u} R)
    (I : InjectiveResolution M)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf R).obj M))
    (φ : ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf R).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ J.cocomplex)
    (hφ : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf R).map (I.ι.f 0) ≫ φ.f 0 = J.ι.f 0) :
    let E := SheafOfModules.evaluation R (op U)
    let G := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (R.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let A := (sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op U)
    let K := (E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let L := (A.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex
    ∀ (c : G.obj (K.cycles n) ⟶ L.cycles n)
      (_ : c ≫ L.iCycles n = G.map (K.iCycles n) ≫ A.map (φ.f n)),
      G.map (K.homologyπ n ≫ (I.isoRightDerivedObj E n).inv) ≫
          (rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso R U n).hom.app M ≫
          (J.isoRightDerivedObj A n).hom =
        c ≫ L.homologyπ n
declarations.comment: part (1), canonical comparison in every degree

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModuleComparison.rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso
declarations.doc:
Cohomology over an open subset `U`, computed by deriving module-valued sections and then
forgetting the module structure, agrees canonically and naturally with cohomology computed after
forgetting the coefficient sheaf to an abelian sheaf.

This is `canonicalSectionsForgetIso`, in the shape in which Stacks 01F1 part (1) states it; the
degree-zero normalization is `rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso_zero` and the compatibility with
restriction is `canonicalSectionsForgetIso_naturality_open`.
declarations.statement:
def rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso (n : ℕ) :
    (SheafOfModules.evaluation R (op U)).rightDerived n ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (R.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ≅
      SheafOfModules.toSheaf R ⋙
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op U)).rightDerived n

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModuleComparison.rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso_zero
declarations.doc:
In degree zero the comparison `rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso` intertwines the canonical maps
from ordinary sections to the zeroth right derived functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso_zero :
    Functor.whiskerRight (SheafOfModules.evaluation R (op U)).toRightDerivedZero
          (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (R.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≫
        (rightDerivedSectionsForgetIso R U 0).hom =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (SheafOfModules.toSheaf R)
        ((sheafSections (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
          (op U)).toRightDerivedZero

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModuleComparison.canonicalSectionsForgetIso_naturality_open
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01F1, part (1), compatibility with restriction.** The comparison of cohomology over
an open subset commutes with restriction to a smaller open subset.  The left-hand restriction is
derived from the underlying abelian-group-valued module sections; `rightDerivedEvaluationForgetIso`
identifies it with module-valued cohomology.

Through that identification the comparison is `ModuleSheafCohomology.sectionsComparisonIso`, and
the statement is `sectionsComparisonIso_naturality` for the morphism `homOfLE h : U ⟶ V` of the
site of opens, read at the module sheaf `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem canonicalSectionsForgetIso_naturality_open {U V : Opens X} (h : U ≤ V) (n : ℕ)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} R) :
    (NatTrans.rightDerived
          (Functor.whiskerLeft (SheafOfModules.toSheaf R)
            (sectionsRestriction (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (homOfLE h))) n).app M ≫
        (rightDerivedEvaluationForgetIso R U n).inv.app M ≫
        (canonicalSectionsForgetIso R U n).hom.app M =
      (rightDerivedEvaluationForgetIso R V n).inv.app M ≫
        (canonicalSectionsForgetIso R V n).hom.app M ≫
        (NatTrans.rightDerived
          (sectionsRestriction (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (homOfLE h)) n).app
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf R).obj M)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModulePushforwardComparison.rightDerivedFunctorPlus_modulePushforward_forget_iso
declarations.doc:
The comparison between module and abelian-sheaf higher direct images is valid for
bounded below complexes and is natural in the complex.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def rightDerivedFunctorPlus_modulePushforward_forget_iso :
    (modulePushforward f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing Y)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ≅
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing X)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        ((opensMap f).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y.carrier)
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModulePushforwardComparison.rightDerivedFunctorPlus_modulePushforward_forget_iso_unit
declarations.doc:
The bounded-below higher-direct-image comparison is the canonical one: it intertwines
the units from ordinary pushforward.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerivedFunctorPlus_modulePushforward_forget_iso_unit :
    modulePushforwardDerivedUnit f ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh
          (rightDerivedFunctorPlus_modulePushforward_forget_iso f).hom =
      abelianPushforwardDerivedUnit f
declarations.comment: bounded below complexes, part (2), canonical comparison

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModulePushforwardComparison.rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01F1, part (2).**  Higher direct images of a sheaf of modules, computed in sheaves
of modules and then forgotten to abelian sheaves, agree canonically and naturally with the
higher direct images of the underlying abelian sheaf.

In degree zero the isomorphism is the canonical one coming from left exactness of the two
pushforwards, which is what makes `rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso_zero` true; in
positive degree it is `rightDerivedModulePushforwardCompIso` followed by
`rightDerivedToSheafAbelianPushforwardIso`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso (n : ℕ) :
    (modulePushforward f).rightDerived n ⋙ SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing Y) ≅
      SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing X) ⋙
        ((opensMap f).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y.carrier)
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)).rightDerived n

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModulePushforwardComparison.rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01F1, part (2), degree-zero normalization.**  In degree zero the comparison
intertwines the canonical maps from the ordinary pushforwards to the zeroth right derived
functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso_zero :
    Functor.whiskerRight (modulePushforward f).toRightDerivedZero
          (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing Y)) ≫
        (rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso f 0).hom =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing X))
        ((opensMap f).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y.carrier)
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)).toRightDerivedZero

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.ModulePushforwardComparison.rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso_cocycles
declarations.doc:
The higher-direct-image comparison is induced by a comparison from a module injective
resolution to an abelian injective resolution extending the identity of the underlying abelian
sheaf: in every degree its effect on cocycles is the one prescribed by any such comparison.  This
fixes the comparison independently of all choices of resolutions and comparison maps.
declarations.statement:
theorem rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso_cocycles (n : ℕ)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)) (I : InjectiveResolution M)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing X)).obj M))
    (φ : ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing X)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ J.cocomplex)
    (hφ : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing X)).map (I.ι.f 0) ≫ φ.f 0 = J.ι.f 0) :
    let E := modulePushforward f
    let G := SheafOfModules.toSheaf (structureSheafRing Y)
    let A := (opensMap f).sheafPushforwardContinuous AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y.carrier) (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
    let K := (E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let L := (A.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex
    ∀ (c : G.obj (K.cycles n) ⟶ L.cycles n)
      (_ : c ≫ L.iCycles n = G.map (K.iCycles n) ≫ A.map (φ.f n)),
      G.map (K.homologyπ n ≫ (I.isoRightDerivedObj E n).inv) ≫
          (rightDerived_modulePushforward_forget_iso f n).hom.app M ≫
          (J.isoRightDerivedObj A n).hom =
        c ≫ L.homologyπ n
declarations.comment: part (2), canonical comparison in every degree

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.LerayCard.leraySpectralSequence
declarations.doc:
**The Leray spectral sequence of a morphism of ringed spaces**, [Stacks, Tag 01F2]. For
`f : X ⟶ Y` a morphism of ringed spaces, this is the functorial `E₂`-cohomological spectral
sequence of `Γ(Y, 𝒪_Y)`-modules on `D⁺(Mod(𝒪_X))` whose second page is `H^p(Y, R^q f_* K)`
naturally in `K`, which abuts to `H^{p+q}(X, K)` with scalars restricted along `f`, together
with the low-degree Leray sequence for abelian sheaves on the underlying spaces.

The abelian sheaves have coefficients in the universe of the space, `.{u, u}`, where
[Stacks, Tag 01F2] allows `.{u, v}`; see the implementation notes of this module.
declarations.statement:
def leraySpectralSequence {X Y : RingedSpace.{u, u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    LeraySpectralSequenceData.{u, u} f

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.LerayModules.exists_spectralSequence_leray
declarations.doc:
**The Leray spectral sequence for sheaves of modules.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of
ringed spaces and let `K` be an object of `D⁺(Mod(𝒪_X))`.  There is a filtered complex `L` of
`Γ(Y, 𝒪_Y)`-modules with `H^n(L) ≅ H^n(X, K)` for all `n`, the right-hand side being the
hypercohomology of `X` with scalars restricted along `f`, whose spectral sequence `E`,
presented as in [Stacks, Tag 012M] by its pages `Z_r^{p,q}/D_r^{p,q}`, has
`E_2^{p,q} ≅ H^p(Y, R^q f_* K)`, is bounded, induces a finite filtration on each `H^n(L)`, and
converges to `H^*(L)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_spectralSequence_leray
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))) :
    ∃ L : FilteredObject (CochainComplex
        (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing Y).obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens Y.carrier)))) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ,
      (∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (L.X.homology n ≅
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
            (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing Y).obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens Y.carrier)))) n).obj
          (((SheafOfModules.evaluation (structureSheafRing X)
                (op ((opensMap f).obj (⊤ : Opens Y.carrier)))).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
                ((structureSheafHom f).hom.app
                  (op (⊤ : Opens Y.carrier))).hom).rightDerivedFunctorPlus).obj K))) ∧
      ∀ (Fil : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (L.X.X n))
        (_ : ∀ p n : ℤ, Fil p n = Subobject.mk ((L.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n))
        (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (L.X.X n))
        (_ : ∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
          Fil p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (L.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (Fil (p + r) (n + 1)))
        (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (L.X.X n))
        (_ : ∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
          (Subobject.«exists» (L.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1)))
        (FH : ∀ (n _p : ℤ), Subobject (L.X.homology n))
        (_ : ∀ n p : ℤ, FH n p =
          imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (L.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)),
      ∃ (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence
          (ModuleCat.{u} ((structureSheafRing Y).obj.obj (op (⊤ : Opens Y.carrier)))) 0)
        (_ : ∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n))),
        (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((E.page 2 zero_le_two).X (p, q) ≅
          ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (structureSheafRing Y)
              (op (⊤ : Opens Y.carrier))).rightDerivedPlus p).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing Y)) q).obj
              ((modulePushforward f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj K)))) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 0).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ FH n a = ⊤ ∧ FH n b = ⊥) ∧
        (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), b ≤ r →
          (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0) ∧
        (∀ p n : ℤ,
          IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
              Fil p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (L.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (Fil (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔
                Fil (p + 1) n)
            (kernelSubobject (L.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ Fil p n ⊔ Fil (p + 1) n) ∧
          IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
              Fil p n ⊓ (Subobject.«exists» (L.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Fil (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔
                Fil (p + 1) n)
            (imageSubobject (L.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ Fil p n ⊔ Fil (p + 1) n))
declarations.comment:
the whole statement: existence of the spectral sequence with second page
`H^p(Y, R^q f_* K)` converging to `H^{p+q}(X, K)`, for `K` in `D⁺(Mod(𝒪_X))`. Functoriality in
`K` is NOT asserted — the source does not state it

declarations.name: Stacks.LeraySections.cohomologyIsoOfVanishingHigherDirectImages
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01F4] part (1).** If the higher direct images of a sheaf of
`𝒪_X`-modules along a morphism of ringed spaces vanish, then its cohomology agrees in every
degree with the cohomology of its direct image.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def cohomologyIsoOfVanishingHigherDirectImages
    {F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)}
    (hF : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero (((modulePushforward f).rightDerived q).obj F)) (p : ℕ) :
    (Hfunctor (structureSheafRing X) ⊤ p).obj F ≅
      (Hfunctor (structureSheafRing Y) ⊤ p).obj ((modulePushforward f).obj F)

declarations.name: Deformation.Artin.SectionsSheaf.isIso_edgeMap_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01F4, part (1), through the edge map.** If the higher direct images `R^q p_* G`
vanish for `q > 0`, the edge map `|Hⁿ(Y, p_* G)| ⟶ |Hⁿ(X, G)|` is an isomorphism in every
degree.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_edgeMap_app (G : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf)
    (hG : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).rightDerived q).obj G))
    (n : ℕ) : IsIso ((edgeMap p π n).app G)
declarations.comment:
(1) for a morphism of schemes, the isomorphism H^p(Y, f_*F) ≅ H^p(X, F) being the
edge map, which commutes with the connecting morphisms

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.LerayModules.isIso_cohomologyToSectionsHigherDirectImage_of_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01F4] part (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of ringed spaces and let `F`
be a sheaf of `𝒪_X`-modules. If `H^p(Y, R^q f_* F) = 0` for every `p > 0` and every `q`, then
the canonical map `H^q(X, F) ⟶ Γ(Y, R^q f_* F)` is an isomorphism for every `q`; in particular
`H^q(X, F) = H^0(Y, R^q f_* F)`, which is what the source states.

Global sections on `X` *are* the direct image followed by global sections on `Y`, so the
cohomology of `X` is the homology of `Γ(Y, -)` applied to `K = f_*(I^•)` for an injective
resolution `I` of `F`. The terms of `K` are `Γ(Y, -)`-acyclic by [Stacks, Tag 01EX] part (2)
(`Stacks.LeraySections.rightAcyclic_secF_modulePushforward_obj`) and its cohomology objects are
`Γ(Y, -)`-acyclic by hypothesis, so `Γ(Y, -)` commutes with taking homology in degree `q`:
that is `Stacks.Cohomology.RightDerivedCoEdge.isIso_homologyToMapHomology_of_acyclic`, and the
two transports in `cohomologyToSectionsHigherDirectImage` are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_cohomologyToSectionsHigherDirectImage_of_vanishing
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X))
    (hvan : ∀ (p q : ℕ), 0 < p →
      IsZero (Hgroup (structureSheafRing Y) ⊤ p (((modulePushforward f).rightDerived q).obj F)))
    (q : ℕ) :
    IsIso (cohomologyToSectionsHigherDirectImage f F q)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.RelativeLeray.derivedPushforwardPlusCompIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01F5]: `R(g ∘ f)_* ≅ Rf_* ⋙ Rg_*` as functors `D⁺(X) ⥤ D⁺(Z)`**, for
arbitrary morphisms of ringed spaces `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ Z`. No hypothesis.

The isomorphism is the **canonical** comparison of [Stacks, Tag 05T2],
`CategoryTheory.Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusComp`, inverted — not an arbitrary
identification — precomposed with the undeived composition formula
[Stacks, Tag 0097] (1) for `(g ∘ f)_* = g_* ∘ f_*`. Invertibility is the criterion of
[Stacks, Tag 015M], whose hypothesis is discharged by
`rightAcyclic_modulePushforward_obj_of_injective`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardPlusCompIso :
    (modulePushforward (f ≫ g)).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ≅
      (modulePushforward f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus ⋙
        (modulePushforward g).rightDerivedFunctorPlus

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedDirectImageComposition.higherDirectImagesComparison_isIso
declarations.doc:
