declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ModuleTwistIso.twistsOnBasicOpen
declarations.doc:
Let `f ∈ S` be homogeneous of degree `d`. Restricted to the standard open `D₊(f)`, the twisting
sheaf `𝒪_X(nd)` is invertible and in fact trivial for every integer `n`, and the three families of
canonical maps built from it are isomorphisms: `𝒪_X(nd) ⊗ 𝒪_X(m) ⟶ 𝒪_X(nd+m)`,
`𝒪_X(nd) ⊗ ℱ(m) ⟶ ℱ(nd+m)` for every sheaf of `𝒪_X`-modules `ℱ`, and `M̃ ⊗ 𝒪_X(nd) ⟶ M(nd)~` for
every graded `S`-module `M`. The second index is arbitrary throughout, and `d` is not assumed
positive.
declarations.statement:
theorem twistsOnBasicOpen {f : S} {d : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒮 d) :
    (∀ n : ℤ, _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible
        ((Over.forget (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒮 f)).op ⋙
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.structureSheaf 𝒮).obj)
        ((projRingSheaf 𝒮).over (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒮 f)).property
        ((twistingSheaf 𝒮 (n * d)).over (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒮 f))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsTrivial
        ((Over.forget (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒮 f)).op ⋙
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.structureSheaf 𝒮).obj)
        ((projRingSheaf 𝒮).over (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒮 f)).property
        ((twistingSheaf 𝒮 (n * d)).over (ProjectiveSpectrum.basicOpen 𝒮 f))) ∧
      (∀ n m : ℤ, IsIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒮 f).ι).map
          (twistMultiplicationMap 𝒮 ((d : ℤ) * n) m))) ∧
      (∀ (F : SheafOfModules.{u}
          ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology (ProjectiveSpectrum.top 𝒮))
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
            (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.structureSheaf 𝒮))) (n m : ℤ), IsIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒮 f).ι).map
          (twistSheafMultiplicationMap 𝒮 F ((d : ℤ) * n) m))) ∧
      (∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M] (τ : Type t) [SetLike τ M]
          [AddSubgroupClass τ M] (𝒨 : ℤ → τ) [DirectSum.Decomposition 𝒨]
          [SetLike.GradedSMul 𝒮 𝒨] (n : ℤ), IsIso
        ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒮 f).ι).map
          (moduleTwistMap 𝒮 𝒨 ((d : ℤ) * n))))
declarations.comment: the lemma's five assertions in one statement

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistDegreeOneCover.isInvertible_twistingSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01MT: the sheaves `𝒪_X(n)` are invertible.**

The trivializing sections are the ratios `(f/1)^n` on the standard opens `D₊(f)` with
`f ∈ S₁`, assembled by
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjInvertibleLocus.isInvertible_twistingSheaf_of_ratioLocus_eq_top`
at `d = 1`.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistDegreeOneCover.isIso_twistMultiplicationMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01MT: Equation 01MO `𝒪_X(n) ⊗ 𝒪_X(m) ⟶ 𝒪_X(n + m)` is an isomorphism**, for all
integers `n` and `m`.

This is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistTensor.isIso_twistMultiplicationMap_of_ratioLocus_eq_top` at
`k = 1`; the only work is the substitution of `1 * n` for `n`, which has to be done after
`revert` because the index occurs in the type of the morphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_twistMultiplicationMap (hcover : DegreeOneCover 𝒮) (n m : ℤ) :
    IsIso (twistMultiplicationMap 𝒮 n m)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistDegreeOneCover.isIso_twistSheafMultiplicationMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01MT: Equation 03GJ `𝒪_X(n) ⊗ ℱ(m) ⟶ ℱ(n + m)` is an isomorphism**, for every
sheaf of `𝒪_X`-modules `ℱ` and all integers `n` and `m`.

The source deduces this clause from the Equation 01MO clause, and so does the proof: by
construction
`AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistSheafMultiplicationMap` is the composite of
the inverse associator, the braiding on `𝒪(n) ⊗ ℱ` tensored with `𝒪(m)`, the associator, and
`𝟙 ℱ ⊗ (Equation 01MO)`.  The first three factors are isomorphisms unconditionally, and the
fourth is one because the native tensor bifunctor maps the product of two isomorphisms to an
isomorphism.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistDegreeOneCover.nonempty_tensorPowModule_iso_twistingSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01MT: the induced identification `𝒪_X(1)^{⊗ n} ≅ 𝒪_X(n)`**, for every integer `n`,
at the canonical integral tensor power `Stacks.Ample.tensorPowModule` of Tag 01CU.

Both families are carried one degree by the autoequivalence `twistRight` — the tensor powers by
the addition law of Tag 01CU, the twists by Equation 01MO at `(n, 1)` — and they agree in degree
one, so `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistPowers.nonempty_iso_of_shift` identifies them in
every degree, negative ones included, with no separate argument.

The library already had this under the stronger hypothesis
`Algebra.adjoin (𝒮 0) (𝒮 1) = ⊤`, as
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistPowers.nonempty_tensorPowModule_iso_twistingSheaf`; this is
the same statement at the source's own printed hypothesis.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_tensorPowModule_iso_twistingSheaf (hcover : DegreeOneCover 𝒮) (n : ℤ) :
    letI := isInvertibleModule_twistingSheaf 𝒮 hcover 1
    Nonempty (Stacks.Ample.tensorPowModule (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮) (twistingSheaf 𝒮 1) n ≅
      twistingSheaf 𝒮 n)
declarations.comment: the induced identification 𝒪_X(1)^{⊗ n} ≅ 𝒪_X(n)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistDegreeOneCover.isIso_moduleTwistMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01MT: Equation 01MQ `M̃ ⊗ 𝒪_X(n) ⟶ M(n)̃` is an isomorphism**, for every graded
`S`-module `M` and every integer `n`.

`isIso_moduleTwistMap_of_ratioLocus_eq_top` at `d = 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_moduleTwistMap (hcover : DegreeOneCover 𝒮) (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (ProjShifted.moduleTwistMap 𝒮 𝒨 n)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistDegreeOneCover.moduleTwistIso
declarations.doc: **Stacks 01MT: the induced isomorphism `M̃ ⊗_{𝒪_X} 𝒪_X(n) = M̃(n) ≅ M(n)̃`.**
declarations.statement:
public def moduleTwistIso (hcover : DegreeOneCover 𝒮) (n : ℤ) :
    (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
        ⟨(((AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮).toRingedSpace)).presheaf,
          (((AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮).toRingedSpace)).IsSheaf⟩).obj
        ((associatedModuleSheaf 𝒮 𝒨))).obj ((twistingSheaf 𝒮 n))) ≅
      associatedModuleSheaf 𝒮 (shiftedGrading 𝒨 n)
declarations.comment: the induced isomorphism M̃ ⊗ 𝒪_X(n) ≅ M(n)~

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GoodOpenClose.isGoodOpen_iff_le_whereInvertible_of_pos
declarations.doc:
For `0 < d`, an open is good exactly when it lies in the largest good open
`whereInvertible 𝒮 d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGoodOpen_iff_le_whereInvertible_of_pos (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d)
    (U : (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮).Opens) :
    IsGoodOpen 𝒮 d U ↔ U ≤ whereInvertible 𝒮 d
declarations.comment: maximality and goodness of the invertible locus

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GoodOpenClose.whereInvertible_eq_iSup_basicOpen_mul_of_pos
declarations.doc:
For `0 < d`, the largest good open `whereInvertible 𝒮 d` is the union of the standard opens
`D₊(fg)` with `deg f = deg g + d`.
declarations.statement:
theorem whereInvertible_eq_iSup_basicOpen_mul_of_pos (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) :
    whereInvertible 𝒮 d =
      ⨆ (e : ℕ) (f : 𝒮 (e + d)) (g : 𝒮 e),
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒮 ((f : S) * (g : S))
declarations.comment: equality of the two open subsets

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ModuleTwistIso.moduleTwistMap_isIso_on_whereInvertible
declarations.doc:
On the largest open on which the `d`-divisible twists are invertible and their multiplication
maps are isomorphisms, the canonical comparison from the tensor product of an associated sheaf
with such a twist to the associated sheaf of the shifted module is an isomorphism, for every
graded module and every integral multiple of `d`. The hypothesis `0 < d` is not used.
declarations.statement:
theorem moduleTwistMap_isIso_on_whereInvertible (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (whereInvertible 𝒮 d).ι).map
      (moduleTwistMap 𝒮 𝒨 ((d : ℤ) * n)))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjInvertibleLocus.nonvanishingLocus_degreeSection_inter
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 01MV.** Let `S` be a graded ring, `X = Proj(S)`, `d ≥ 1`, `n ≥ 1` and
`f ∈ S_{nd}`. Let `s` be the global section of `𝒪(nd)` attached to `f`. Then, on the open `W_d`
where the `d`-divisible twists are invertible, the nonvanishing locus of `s` is the standard
open `D₊(f)`:

`X_s ∩ W_d = D₊(f) ∩ W_d`.

This is stated on `Proj(S)` rather than on the open subscheme `W_d`, which is strictly stronger
than the form of the source: the statement there is the image of this one under
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.preimage_nonvanishingLocus`. No positivity of `d` or `n` is needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonvanishingLocus_degreeSection_inter (d n : ℕ) (f : 𝒮 (n * d)) :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.nonvanishingLocus
          (X := (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮).toRingedSpace)
          (twistingSheaf 𝒮 ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (sectionsOfTop _ (degreeSection 𝒮 (n * d) f)) ∩
        (whereInvertible 𝒮 d : Set ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮)) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒮 (f : S) : Set ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮)) ∩
        (whereInvertible 𝒮 d : Set ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CommonDegreeTwist.exists_degree_forall
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_degree_forall (Y : (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮).Opens)
    (hY : IsCompact (Y : Set (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮))) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, 1 ≤ d ∧
      Y ≤ whereInvertible 𝒮 d ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.toScheme.presheaf Y.toScheme.ringCatSheaf.2
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback Y.ι).obj (twistingSheaf 𝒮 ((d : ℤ) * n)))) ∧
      (∀ n m : ℤ, IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.ι).map
        (twistMultiplicationMap 𝒮 ((d : ℤ) * n) m))) ∧
      (∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M] (τ : Type t) [SetLike τ M]
        [AddSubgroupClass τ M] (𝒨 : ℤ → τ) [DirectSum.Decomposition 𝒨]
        [SetLike.GradedSMul 𝒮 𝒨] (n : ℤ),
          IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor Y.ι).map
            (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjShifted.moduleTwistMap 𝒮 𝒨 ((d : ℤ) * n)))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : 𝒮 (n * d)),
        Stacks.Ample.nonvanishingLocus (restrictedTwist 𝒮 Y ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ))
            (restrictedDegreeSection 𝒮 Y (n * d) f) =
          ((Y.ι ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒮 (f : S) : Y.toScheme.Opens) :
            Set Y.toScheme)) ∧
      Opens.IsBasis {V : Y.toScheme.Opens | ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
        ∃ s : Γ(restrictedTwist 𝒮 Y ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ), ⊤),
          (V : Set Y.toScheme) =
            Stacks.Ample.nonvanishingLocus (restrictedTwist 𝒮 Y ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ)) s} ∧
      Opens.IsBasis {V : Y.toScheme.Opens | ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
        ∃ s : Γ(restrictedTwist 𝒮 Y ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ), ⊤),
          IsAffineOpen V ∧ (V : Set Y.toScheme) =
            Stacks.Ample.nonvanishingLocus (restrictedTwist 𝒮 Y ((n * d : ℕ) : ℤ)) s}

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjMapCard.projMapData_preserves_products
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01MY, graded-algebra multiplication, on the canonical bundle.** The tagged
statement's spelling of `twistMap_comp_pullbackTwistMultiplication`: the morphism and the twist maps are the
fields of `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.projMapData`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projMapData_preserves_products (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (n m : ℤ) :
    pullbackTwistMultiplication 𝒜 (projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).hom n m ≫
      (projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).twistMap (n + m) =
    ((Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, u, u, u, u}
      ⟨(((mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).toScheme.toRingedSpace)).presheaf,
      (((mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).toScheme.toRingedSpace)).IsSheaf⟩)).map
      ((((projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).twistMap n), ((projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).twistMap m)) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫
      pullbackTwistMultiplication ℬ (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι n m

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjMapCardUnit.projMapData_preserves_unit
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01MY, the graded-algebra unit, on the canonical bundle.** The Stacks statement's spelling of
`twistMap_comp_pullbackTwistUnit`: the morphism and the twist maps are the fields of
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.projMapData`.
declarations.statement:
theorem projMapData_preserves_unit (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) :
    pullbackTwistUnit 𝒜 (projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).hom ≫ (projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).twistMap 0 =
      pullbackTwistUnit ℬ (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistChain.awayToSection_comp_appLE_mapHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01MY (2)**: on the standard open `D₊(ψ f)` of the domain of definition, the
morphism induced by `ψ` is the one induced by the map `𝒜_{(f)} → ℬ_{(ψ f)}` of degree-zero
homogeneous localizations.

With no hypothesis on `ψ`; compare `AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.awayToSection_comp_appLE`, which
states this for `AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map` and so assumes `ℬ₊ ≤ 𝒜₊.map ψ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem awayToSection_comp_appLE_mapHom (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (f : A) (d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d)
    (hd : 0 < d) :
    Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 f ≫
      Scheme.Hom.appLE (mapHom 𝒜 ℬ ψ) (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f)
        ((mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen ℬ (ψ f))
        (by rw [mapHom_preimage_basicOpen 𝒜 ℬ ψ f d hf hd]) =
    CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map ψ f) ≫
      Proj.awayToSection ℬ (ψ f) ≫
        Scheme.Hom.appLE (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι (Proj.basicOpen ℬ (ψ f))
          ((mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen ℬ (ψ f)) le_rfl
declarations.comment: part (2), localization map on standard opens

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistChain.eq_mapHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01MY (2), uniqueness**: a morphism out of the domain of definition that has the
inverse images of standard opens of Tag 01MY (2), and that on each of them is induced by the
corresponding map of degree-zero homogeneous localizations, is `mapHom`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eq_mapHom (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (p : (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).toScheme ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒜)
    (hopen : ∀ (f : A) (d : ℕ), f ∈ 𝒜 d → 0 < d →
      p ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f =
        (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen ℬ (ψ f))
    (hlocal : ∀ (f : A) (d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d) (hd : 0 < d),
      Proj.awayToSection 𝒜 f ≫
        Scheme.Hom.appLE p (Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f)
          ((mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen ℬ (ψ f))
          (by rw [hopen f d hf hd]) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Away.map ψ f) ≫
        Proj.awayToSection ℬ (ψ f) ≫
          Scheme.Hom.appLE (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι (Proj.basicOpen ℬ (ψ f))
            ((mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen ℬ (ψ f)) le_rfl) :
    p = mapHom 𝒜 ℬ ψ

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjMapUniqueTwist.projMapData_twistMap_unique
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01MY, uniqueness of the graded-algebra map.** A bundle of the canonical morphism with
maps on all twists which satisfies condition (1) at `⊤`, the multiplication law in all integer
degrees and the unit law is the canonical bundle.

Together with `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjMapData.eq_mapHom`, this is uniqueness of the
canonical triple of Tag 01MY.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projMapData_twistMap_unique (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) (ℬ : ℕ → τ) [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (D : ProjMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ)
    (hh : D.hom = (projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).hom)
    (hdegree : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : 𝒜 n),
      (D.twistMap (n : ℤ)).val.app (.op ⊤)
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction D.hom).unit.app
          (twistingSheaf 𝒜 (n : ℤ))).val.app (.op ⊤)
            (degreeSection 𝒜 n a)) =
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι).unit.app
        (twistingSheaf ℬ (n : ℤ))).val.app (.op ⊤)
          (degreeSection ℬ n ⟨ψ a, ψ.map_mem a.2⟩))
    (hmul : ∀ n m : ℤ,
      pullbackTwistMultiplication 𝒜 D.hom n m ≫ D.twistMap (n + m) =
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor ⟨(((mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ
        ψ).toScheme.toRingedSpace)).presheaf, (((mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ
        ψ).toScheme.toRingedSpace)).IsSheaf⟩)).map
          (((D.twistMap n), (D.twistMap m)) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫
        pullbackTwistMultiplication ℬ (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι n m)
    (hunit : pullbackTwistUnit 𝒜 D.hom ≫ D.twistMap 0 =
      pullbackTwistUnit ℬ (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι) :
    D = projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjShared.mapDomain
declarations.doc:
The union of the standard opens `D₊(ψ f)` of `Proj ℬ` for `f` homogeneous of positive
degree: the largest open on which a graded ring homomorphism `ψ` induces a morphism to
`Proj 𝒜`.
declarations.statement: public def mapDomain (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) : (Proj ℬ).Opens

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistChain.mapHom_preimage_basicOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01MY (2)**: the inverse image of a standard open of `Proj 𝒜` under the induced
morphism is the standard open of the image element.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mapHom_preimage_basicOpen (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (f : A) (d : ℕ) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 d)
    (hd : 0 < d) :
    mapHom 𝒜 ℬ ψ ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f =
      (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen ℬ (ψ f)
declarations.comment: part (2), inverse images of standard opens

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.projMapData
declarations.doc:
**The canonical bundle of Tag 01MY**: the glued morphism `mapHom` together with the
comparison maps `θ` on all twists.
declarations.statement: public def projMapData (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) : ProjMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ
declarations.comment: the morphism and the maps on all twists

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistGradedAlgebra.thetaGraded
declarations.doc:
The comparison maps on all integer twists, as one homomorphism of sheaves of `ℤ`-graded
algebras
`θ : r_ψ^*(⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_{Proj 𝒜}(n)) ⟶ ⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_{Proj ℬ}(n)|_{U(ψ)}`.
Its degree-`n` component is `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.twistMap`.
declarations.comment: theta as a single morphism of sheaves of Z-graded algebras: the comparison maps on all integer twists, assembled into one morphism from the pullback along r_psi of the graded algebra of integer twists of Proj A to the pullback along the inclusion of U(psi) of that of Proj B

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistTheta.twistMap_degreeSection
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01MY, part (1), homogeneous global sections.** The comparison map on the `n`-th twist
carries the global section of `O(n)` attached to a homogeneous element `a` of degree `n` to the
global section attached to `psi a`, both read through the unit of the pullback--pushforward
adjunction.
declarations.statement:
public theorem twistMap_degreeSection (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (n : ℕ) (a : 𝒜 n) :
    ((projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).twistMap (n : ℤ)).val.app (.op ⊤)
      (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).hom).unit.app
        (twistingSheaf 𝒜 (n : ℤ))).val.app (.op ⊤)
          (degreeSection 𝒜 n a)) =
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ).ι).unit.app
      (twistingSheaf ℬ (n : ℤ))).val.app (.op ⊤)
        (degreeSection ℬ n ⟨ψ a, ψ.map_mem a.2⟩)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompTwistMap.mapDomain_mapHom_twistMap_comp
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01MZ].** Let `𝒜`, `ℬ`, `𝒞` be nonnegatively graded rings, write
`X = Proj 𝒜`, `Y = Proj ℬ`, `Z = Proj 𝒞`, and let `φ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ` and `ψ : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒞` be
homomorphisms of graded rings. Then `U(ψ ∘ φ) = r_ψ⁻¹(U(φ))`, the morphism
`r_{ψ ∘ φ} : U(ψ ∘ φ) ⟶ X` is `r_φ ∘ r_ψ|_{U(ψ ∘ φ)}`, and `θ_ψ ∘ r_ψ^* θ_φ = θ_{ψ ∘ φ}` on
every twist.

The three conjuncts are, in order:

1. **The domain of definition of the composite.** `U(ψ ∘ φ)`, an open of `Z`, is the image under
  the inclusion of `U(ψ)` of the open `r_ψ⁻¹(U(φ))` of `U(ψ)`. This is `mapDomain_comp`.
2. **The morphism of the composite.** Read through the canonical isomorphism
  `mapDomainCompIso : r_ψ⁻¹(U(φ)) ≅ U(ψ ∘ φ)` that the first conjunct supplies,
  `r_{ψ ∘ φ}` is the restriction `r_ψ|_{r_ψ⁻¹(U(φ))} : r_ψ⁻¹(U(φ)) ⟶ U(φ)` followed by `r_φ`.
  This is `mapDomainCompIso_hom_mapHom`.
3. **The comparison maps on the twists.** For every `n : ℤ`, Tag 01MY's comparison
  `θ_{ψ ∘ φ}` on the `n`-th twist, pulled back along the canonical isomorphism, is `θ_φ` pulled
  back along `r_ψ|_{r_ψ⁻¹(U(φ))}` followed by `θ_ψ` pulled back along the inclusion of
  `r_ψ⁻¹(U(φ))`, the pseudofunctoriality isomorphisms of the inverse image and the three
  identifications of composites of the first two conjuncts mediating between the two sides.
  This is `twistMap_comp`.

The source's data are the three graded rings and the two homomorphisms, and those are the only
binders here: every domain of definition is an arbitrary open, and `θ` is Tag 01MY's comparison
for an arbitrary homomorphism of nonnegatively graded rings.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mapDomain_mapHom_twistMap_comp (φ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (ψ : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒞) :
    mapDomain 𝒜 𝒞 (ψ.comp φ) =
        (mapDomain ℬ 𝒞 ψ).ι ''ᵁ (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ ⁻¹ᵁ mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ) ∧
      (mapDomainCompIso 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 φ ψ).hom ≫ mapHom 𝒜 𝒞 (ψ.comp φ) =
        (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ ∣_ mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ) ≫ mapHom 𝒜 ℬ φ ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ,
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (mapDomainCompIso 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 φ ψ).hom
              (mapHom 𝒜 𝒞 (ψ.comp φ))).inv.app (twistingSheaf 𝒜 n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullback (mapDomainCompIso 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 φ ψ).hom).map
              (twistMap 𝒜 𝒞 (ψ.comp φ) n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (mapDomainCompIso 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 φ ψ).hom
              (mapDomain 𝒜 𝒞 (ψ.comp φ)).ι).hom.app (twistingSheaf 𝒞 n) =
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
              (mapDomainCompIso_hom_mapHom 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 φ ψ)).hom.app (twistingSheaf 𝒜 n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ ∣_ mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ)
              (mapHom 𝒜 ℬ φ)).inv.app (twistingSheaf 𝒜 n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullback (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ ∣_ mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ)).map
              (twistMap 𝒜 ℬ φ n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ ∣_ mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ)
              (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ).ι).hom.app (twistingSheaf ℬ n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
              (morphismRestrict_ι (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ) (mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ))).hom.app
                (twistingSheaf ℬ n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ ⁻¹ᵁ mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ).ι
              (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ)).inv.app (twistingSheaf ℬ n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullback (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ ⁻¹ᵁ mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ).ι).map
              (twistMap ℬ 𝒞 ψ n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (mapHom ℬ 𝒞 ψ ⁻¹ᵁ mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ φ).ι
              (mapDomain ℬ 𝒞 ψ).ι).hom.app (twistingSheaf 𝒞 n) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
              (mapDomainCompIso_hom_ι 𝒜 ℬ 𝒞 φ ψ)).inv.app (twistingSheaf 𝒞 n)
declarations.comment:
the tag's three assertions in one statement, for an arbitrary composable pair of
homomorphisms of nonnegatively graded rings: the domain of definition of the composite is the
inverse image under `r_ψ` of the domain of definition of `φ`, the morphism of the composite is
`r_φ ∘ r_ψ` restricted to that open, and the comparison maps on every twist compose

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.pullbackGlobalSections_degreeSection_eq_zero_iff_degreeSection_map_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01N0 part (3) on canonical twisted sections, for a surjective homomorphism of graded
rings out of a Noetherian ring generated in degree one.** Write `X = Proj 𝒮`, `Y = Proj ℬ` and
`r = r_ψ : Y ⟶ X` for the closed immersion of part (2). For `a ∈ 𝒮 n`, the pullback along `r` of
the canonical section of `𝒪_X(n)` attached to `a` vanishes exactly when the canonical section of
`𝒪_Y(n)` attached to `ψ a` vanishes.

The source's part (3) says the comparison maps `θ : r^* 𝒪_X(n) ⟶ 𝒪_Y(n)` of Tag 01MY are
surjective but in general not injective, even for a surjective `ψ`; its counterexample is
`𝒮 = k[x, y]` with `deg x = 1`, `deg y = 2` and `Ker ψ = (x)`. The statement here is that `θ`
*is* injective on the canonical sections once `𝒮` is generated in degree one — the hypothesis the
counterexample violates. Surjectivity of `θ` is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistEpi.epi_projMapData_twistMap_of_eventually_surjective`.

Both sides are the saturation of `Ker ψ`: the left by `mem_idealOfClosedSubscheme_map_iff` and
the right by `AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.degreeSection_eq_zero_iff` on `ℬ`, which
inherits Noetherianness and degree-one generation from `𝒮` along `ψ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pullbackGlobalSections_degreeSection_eq_zero_iff_degreeSection_map_eq_zero
    [IsNoetherianRing S] (hψ : Function.Surjective ψ)
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin (𝒮 0) (𝒮 1 : Set S) = ⊤) {n : ℕ} (b : 𝒮 n) :
    pullbackGlobalSections (Proj.map ψ hq) (twistingSheaf 𝒮 (n : ℤ))
          (degreeSection 𝒮 n b) = 0 ↔
      degreeSection ℬ n ⟨ψ (b : S), ψ.map_mem b.2⟩ = 0
declarations.comment: part (3), the comparison θ : r_ψ^* 𝒪_X(n) ⟶ 𝒪_Y(n) on the canonical twisted sections: for ψ surjective out of a Noetherian graded ring generated in degree one, θ is injective on them, so the pulled-back section of a ∈ 𝒮 n vanishes iff the section of ψ a does. Surjectivity of θ is twist_surjective; sheaf-level isomorphy of θ, and the source's counterexample to it, are not proved.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistEpi.epi_projMapData_twistMap_of_eventually_surjective
declarations.doc:
If `ψ` is surjective on homogeneous components of all sufficiently large degree, then the
twist maps of the bundle `projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ` are epimorphisms of sheaves of modules.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjChain.mapDomain_eq_top_of_eventually_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01N1 (1)**: a graded ring homomorphism surjective in all sufficiently large degrees
is defined on the whole of `Proj ℬ`.

A point of `Proj ℬ` omits some homogeneous `g` of positive degree `m`; a large power `g ^ k` is
homogeneous of degree `k * m`, is still omitted because the point is prime, and is in the image
of `ψ`.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjChain.isClosedImmersion_projMapData_hom_of_eventually_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01N1 (2)** on Tag 01MY's bundle: the underlying morphism of
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.projMapData` is a closed immersion. This is the form
the statements of the chain quantify over, and it is the previous result unchanged, since the bundle's
morphism is `mapHom` by definition.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjChain.isClosedImmersion_projToProjectiveSpaceGradeZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 01N0 at a polynomial ring: a graded ring generated in degree one by `n + 1`
elements is a closed subscheme of `ℙⁿ`.** Let `S` be a graded ring and let `x_0, …, x_n ∈ S_1`
generate `S` as an `S_0`-algebra. Then the induced morphism
`Proj S ⟶ ℙⁿ_{S_0} = Proj S_0[T_0, …, T_n]` is a closed immersion.

This is the source's hypothesis "`S` is generated by `S_1` over `S_0`" together with a choice of
`n + 1` generators, and it is `isClosedImmersion_projToProjectiveSpace` with `R = S_0` and the
inclusion of the degree-zero part as the structure map.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_projToProjectiveSpaceGradeZero (x : Fin (n + 1) → S)
    (hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ 𝒮 1) (hgen : Algebra.adjoin (𝒮 0) (Set.range x) = ⊤) :
    IsClosedImmersion
      (projToProjectiveSpace 𝒮 (R := (𝒮 0)) (fun r => r.2) x hx hgen)
declarations.comment: part (2) at a polynomial ring: closed immersion into ℙⁿ

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistMono.isIso_projMapData_twistMap
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01N1's third assertion.** For a homomorphism of graded rings surjective on homogeneous
components of all large degree, with the source generated in degree one over its degree-zero
part, Tag 01MY's comparison map on the `n`-th twist is an isomorphism for every `n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_projMapData_twistMap (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hψ : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, Function.Surjective (GradedRingHom.gradedAddHom ψ d))
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) (𝒜 1 : Set A) = ⊤) (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso ((ProjTwistCompare.projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).twistMap n)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjChain.mapDomain_eq_top_of_eventually_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01N1 (1)**: a graded ring homomorphism surjective in all sufficiently large degrees
is defined on the whole of `Proj ℬ`.

A point of `Proj ℬ` omits some homogeneous `g` of positive degree `m`; a large power `g ^ k` is
homogeneous of degree `k * m`, is still omitted because the point is prime, and is in the image
of `ψ`.
declarations.comment: part (1): the domain is all of Proj

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjChain.isClosedImmersion_projMapData_hom_of_eventually_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01N1 (2)** on Tag 01MY's bundle: the underlying morphism of
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.projMapData` is a closed immersion. This is the form
the statements of the chain quantify over, and it is the previous result unchanged, since the bundle's
morphism is `mapHom` by definition.

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjBaseChange.mapDomain_isPullback_isIso_twistMap_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01N2].** Let `A` be a graded `R`-algebra with grading `𝒜`, let `S` be an
`R`-algebra, write `X = Proj 𝒜` and `Y = Proj (S ⊗[R] 𝒜)`, and let `ψ : a ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ a` be the
base-change homomorphism of graded rings. Then `U(ψ) = Y`, the square

```
Y = Proj (S ⊗[R] 𝒜) ⟶ Proj 𝒜 = X
         |                 |
         v                 v
      Spec S      ⟶     Spec R
```

is a fibre product, and every comparison map `θ : r_ψ^* 𝒪_X(n) ⟶ 𝒪_Y(n)` is an isomorphism.

The three conjuncts are, in order:

1. **The domain of definition is everything.** The base-changed irrelevant ideal is generated by
  the images of the homogeneous elements of positive degree, so already the standard opens
  `D₊(1 ⊗ₜ f)` cover `Y`. This is
  `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjShared.mapDomain_baseChange`.
2. **The square is a fibre product.** The structure morphism of each projective spectrum is
  written as its morphism to the spectrum of the degree-zero part of its grading followed by the
  spectrum of the structure map of that degree-zero part. This is
  `Stacks.ProjBaseChange.isPullback_map_Spec`.
3. **The comparison maps are isomorphisms.** For every `n : ℤ`, the canonical comparison on the
  `n`-th twist along `r_ψ = AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.map ψ` is an isomorphism. This is
  `Stacks.ProjBaseChange.isIso_twistMap_includeRight`.

The source's data are the graded `R`-algebra and the `R`-algebra `S`, and those are the only
binders here; the identification of the target graded ring with the base change holds by
construction, since the target is the base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem mapDomain_isPullback_isIso_twistMap_baseChange :
    mapDomain 𝒜 (grading 𝒜 S) (includeRight 𝒜 S) = ⊤ ∧
      IsPullback (map 𝒜 S)
          (Proj.toSpecZero (grading 𝒜 S) ≫ Spec.map (ofHom (algebraMap S ↥(grading 𝒜 S 0))))
          (Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 ≫ Spec.map (ofHom (algebraMap R ↥(𝒜 0))))
          (Spec.map (ofHom (algebraMap R S))) ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ, IsIso (Stacks.ProjTwistComparison.twistMap (includeRight 𝒜 S)
        (irrelevant_le_map 𝒜 S) n)
declarations.comment:
the tag's three assertions in one statement, for the base change of a graded
`R`-algebra `A` along an `R`-algebra `S`: the domain of definition of the base-change
homomorphism is the whole of `Proj (S ⊗[R] A)`, the square it forms with the structure morphisms
to `Spec S` and `Spec R` is a fibre product, and the comparison map on every twist is an
isomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjShared.mapDomain_eq_top_of_isLocalizationAway
declarations.doc:
**A graded homomorphism that presents its target as a localization of its source at a
degree-zero element is everywhere defined.**

A homogeneous element `b` of `B` of positive degree becomes, after multiplication by a power of
the image of `g`, the image of some `a ∈ A`; that image is homogeneous of the same degree, so `b`
lies in the ideal generated by the images of the positive-degree homogeneous elements of `A`.
Hence the irrelevant ideal of `ℬ` is contained in that ideal and the standard opens `D₊(ψ f)`
cover `Proj ℬ`.

The algebra structure is an arbitrary one whose structure map is `ψ`, which covers the structure
map `ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra` in particular.

This is the first assertion of Tag 01N3, `U(ψ) = Y`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mapDomain_eq_top_of_isLocalizationAway (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (g : 𝒜 0)
    [Algebra A B] (halg : algebraMap A B = (ψ : A →+* B))
    [IsLocalization.Away (g : A) B] :
    mapDomain 𝒜 ℬ ψ = ⊤

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistBaseChange.isOpenImmersion_mapHom
declarations.doc:
**The induced morphism of a graded localization away from a degree-zero element is an open
immersion.**
declarations.statement:
public theorem isOpenImmersion_mapHom (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) {g : A} (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 0) [Algebra A B]
    (halg : (algebraMap A B : A →+* B) = ψ.toRingHom) [IsLocalization.Away g B] :
    IsOpenImmersion (mapHom 𝒜 ℬ ψ)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistBaseChange.opensRange_mapHom
declarations.doc:
For a graded ring homomorphism exhibiting `B` as a localization of `A` away from an element
`g` of degree `0`, the open immersion `Proj ℬ ⟶ Proj 𝒜` identifies `Proj ℬ` with the inverse
image of the standard open `D(g) ⊆ Spec (𝒜 0)` under the structure morphism
`AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem opensRange_mapHom (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) {g : A} (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 0) [Algebra A B]
    (halg : (algebraMap A B : A →+* B) = ψ.toRingHom) [IsLocalization.Away g B]
    [IsOpenImmersion (mapHom 𝒜 ℬ ψ)] :
    (mapHom 𝒜 ℬ ψ).opensRange =
      Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (⟨g, hg⟩ : 𝒜 0)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistBaseChange.isIso_projMapData_twistMap
declarations.doc:
If `ψ` presents `B` as the localization `A_g` of `A` at a degree-zero element `g`, then the
comparison map `θ : r_ψ^* 𝒪_X(n) → 𝒪_Y(n)` of
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCompare.projMapData` is an isomorphism for every `n : ℤ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_projMapData_twistMap (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) {g : A} (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 0) [Algebra A B]
    (halg : (algebraMap A B : A →+* B) = ψ.toRingHom) [IsLocalization.Away g B] (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso ((projMapData 𝒜 ℬ ψ).twistMap n)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTriple.Triple
declarations.doc:
**A triple `(d, L, ψ)` of Stacks Tag 01N4**, with the integer `d` and the invertible
`𝒪_Y`-module `L` as parameters: a graded ring map `ψ : S^{(d)} ⟶ Γ_*(Y, L)` such that `L` is
generated by the global sections `ψ(f)` for `f` homogeneous of degree `d`.

Generation is the statement that the nonvanishing loci of those sections cover `Y`, which for an
invertible module is exactly generation: at a point of the nonvanishing locus of a section the
section generates the stalk (`Stacks.SectionProduct.mem_nonvanishingLocus_iff_generates`).
declarations.statement: structure Triple

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTriple.BundledTriple
declarations.doc:
**A triple of Stacks Tag 01N4 in the literal shape of the source**: an integer `d ≥ 1`, an
invertible `𝒪_Y`-module `L`, and a graded ring map `ψ : S^{(d)} ⟶ Γ_*(Y, L)` for which `L` is
generated by the sections `ψ(f)`, `f ∈ S_d`.
declarations.statement: structure BundledTriple

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTriple.StrictEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Strict equivalence of two triples with the same `d`**, Stacks Tag 01N4: there is an
isomorphism `β : L ⟶ L'` of invertible `𝒪_Y`-modules with `β ∘ ψ = ψ'`.

The condition `β ∘ ψ = ψ'` is written out degreewise: in degree `n` the induced isomorphism
`L^{⊗ n} ≅ (L')^{⊗ n}` carries the degree `n` component of `ψ` to that of `ψ'`. A graded map is
its family of components, so this is the source's condition and not a weakening of it.
declarations.statement: def StrictEquiv (t : Triple 𝒮 Y L d) (t' : Triple 𝒮 Y L' d) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTripleDegreeFunctor.Fd.functor
declarations.doc:
**The functor `F_d : Sch^{opp} ⟶ Sets`** at a fixed weight `d`. It sends a scheme `Y` to the
set `F_d(Y)` of strict equivalence classes of weight-`d` triples `(d, L, ψ)` over `Y`, and a
morphism of schemes `h : Y' ⟶ Y` to the map sending the class of a triple to the class of its
pullback along `h`.
declarations.statement: def Fd.functor (d : ℕ) : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1)
declarations.comment: the functor F_d : Sch^opp ⟶ Sets of this section at a fixed weight d, with both functor laws proved (Fd.pullback_id and Fd.pullback_comp): on objects the set F_d(Y) of strict equivalence classes of weight-d triples (d, L, ψ) over Y, on morphisms the pullback of a triple. The weight is a parameter rather than a field, so that SectionsEquiv applies with no transport. The target is Type (u+1), not Type u, because a triple carries an 𝒪_Y-module. Representability of F_d by U_d is Tag 01N9 and of the colimit F by Proj(A) is Tag 01NC; neither is proved in this file (Tag 01NC's is the carrier ProjTripleDegreeFunctor.F.representableBy, which is built on top of this functor)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTripleFunctorLaws.sectionsEquiv_pullbackTriple_id
declarations.doc:
The identity functor law for the pullback of a triple: the pullback
`(d, (𝟙 Y)^*L, (𝟙 Y)^* ∘ ψ)` of a triple `(d, L, ψ)` along `𝟙 Y` is strictly equivalent to it.
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionsEquiv_pullbackTriple_id (t : ProjTripleClassifying.Triple 𝒜 Y) :
    ProjTripleClassifying.SectionsEquiv 𝒜 (ProjTriplePullback.pullbackTriple 𝒜 t (𝟙 Y)).psi
      t.psi
declarations.comment: the identity functor law for the pullback of a triple of this section: the pullback along the identity is STRICTLY EQUIVALENT to the triple, in the SectionsEquiv sense of the section; the composition law is sectionsEquiv_pullbackTriple_comp below

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTripleFunctorLaws.sectionsEquiv_pullbackTriple_comp
declarations.doc:
The composition functor law for the pullback of a triple: the pullback along `f` of the
pullback along `g` of a triple is strictly equivalent to its pullback along `f ≫ g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionsEquiv_pullbackTriple_comp (t : ProjTripleClassifying.Triple 𝒜 W'') :
    ProjTripleClassifying.SectionsEquiv 𝒜
      (ProjTriplePullback.pullbackTriple 𝒜 (ProjTriplePullback.pullbackTriple 𝒜 t g) f).psi
      (ProjTriplePullback.pullbackTriple 𝒜 t (f ≫ g)).psi
declarations.comment: the composition functor law for the pullback of a triple of this section: the pullback along f of the pullback along g is STRICTLY EQUIVALENT to the pullback along f ≫ g, in the SectionsEquiv sense of the section

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTriplePullback.pullbackTriple
declarations.doc:
For `h : Y' ⟶ Y`, the pullback of the triple `(d, L, ψ)` over `Y` is the triple
`(d, h^*L, h^* ∘ ψ)` over `Y'`: the same integer `d`, the pullback of the invertible module, and
the degreewise pullback `pullbackSections` of the graded map.
declarations.statement:
def pullbackTriple (t : ProjTripleClassifying.Triple 𝒜 Y) (h : Y' ⟶ Y) :
    ProjTripleClassifying.Triple 𝒜 Y'
declarations.comment: the pullback of a triple along a morphism of schemes h : Y' ⟶ Y: the triple (d, h^*L, h^* ∘ ψ), in the VeroneseSections spelling of the graded map that Tag 01N8 and Tag 01N9 are stated in. The two functor laws — that the pullback along an identity and the pullback along a composite are STRICTLY EQUIVALENT to the triple and to the twice-pulled-back triple — are ProjTripleFunctorLaws.sectionsEquiv_pullbackTriple_id and sectionsEquiv_pullbackTriple_comp. The functor F_d itself, i.e. the quotient of the triples by strict equivalence with this pullback on morphisms, is ProjTripleDegreeFunctor.Fd.functor; it is built at a fixed weight, on a carrier that takes the weight as a parameter rather than as a field, because strict equivalence compares two graded maps of the same weight and a triple-level version would need a transport

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeOpen
declarations.doc:
**The degree `d` open of `Proj 𝒜`**, the union `U_d = ⋃_{f ∈ 𝒜 d} D₊(f)` of the projective
standard opens of the homogeneous elements of degree exactly `d`.
declarations.statement: public def degreeOpen (d : ℕ) : (Proj 𝒜).Opens

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.degreeOpen_le_of_dvd
declarations.doc:
**The degree opens grow along divisibility**: if `d ∣ d'` and `d'` is positive then
`U_d ⊆ U_{d'}`. A homogeneous `f` of degree `d` has `f ^ k` of degree `d' = d * k`, and
`D₊(f ^ k) = D₊(f)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem degreeOpen_le_of_dvd {d d' : ℕ} (hdvd : d ∣ d') (hd' : 0 < d') :
    degreeOpen 𝒜 d ≤ degreeOpen 𝒜 d'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.iSup_degreeOpen_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**The degree opens cover `Proj 𝒜`**: every point lies in `U_d` for some positive `d`, because
a homogeneous prime of `Proj 𝒜` does not contain the irrelevant ideal, which is generated by the
homogeneous elements of positive degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem iSup_degreeOpen_eq_top :
    (⨆ d : ℕ, ⨆ _ : 0 < d, degreeOpen 𝒜 d) = ⊤

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOpenSections.psi
declarations.doc:
The graded ring homomorphism `ψ^d : S^(d) ⟶ Γ_*(Y, 𝒪_Y(d))`, sending a homogeneous element
of degree `nd` to the restriction to `Y` of the global section of `𝒪(nd)` it determines. Taken at
`Y = U_d` this is `ψ^d : S^(d) ⟶ Γ_*(U_d, 𝒪_{U_d}(d))`.
declarations.statement:
public def psi (hd : 0 < d) :
    letI := veroneseGradingGradedRing 𝒮 d hd
    letI := veroneseGradedRing 𝒮 Y d
    veroneseGrading 𝒮 d →+*ᵍ veroneseSectionRingGrading 𝒮 Y d

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOpenSections.nonvanishingLocus_veroneseSection_inter
declarations.doc:
**Global generation of `𝒪_{U_d}(d)` by the image of `ψ^d` in degree one.** The nonvanishing
locus on `U_d` of the section attached to a homogeneous `f` of degree `d` is `D₊(f) ∩ U_d`; since
the `D₊(f)` for `f ∈ 𝒮 d` cover `U_d` by definition, the sections in the image of `ψ^d` in degree
one generate.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonvanishingLocus_veroneseSection_inter (f : 𝒮 (1 * d)) :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.nonvanishingLocus
          (X := (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮).toRingedSpace)
          (twistingSheaf 𝒮 ((1 * d : ℕ) : ℤ))
          (Stacks.SheafOfModules.sectionsOfTop _ (degreeSection 𝒮 (1 * d) f)) ∩
        (Proj.degreeOpen 𝒮 d : Set (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮)) =
      (Proj.basicOpen 𝒮 (f : S) : Set (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮)) ∩
        (Proj.degreeOpen 𝒮 d : Set (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismsIntoProj.psiPullback_gradedRingHom_and_generatesStalks
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a graded ring, `X = Proj(S)`, let `d ≥ 1`, let `U_d ⊂ X` be the degree `d` open and
let `φ : Y ⟶ U_d` be a morphism of schemes. Then the degreewise maps assemble into a graded ring
homomorphism

`ψ^d_φ : S^{(d)} ⟶ Γ_*(Y, φ⁎𝒪_X(d))`,

sending a homogeneous element of degree `nd` to the pullback along `φ` of the global section of
`𝒪_X(nd)` it determines, and the invertible sheaf `φ⁎𝒪_X(d)` is generated by the global sections
in the image of the degree-one component `(S^{(d)})_1 = S_d ⟶ Γ(Y, φ⁎𝒪_X(d))`.

The target is the twist model of `Γ_*`: its degree `n` piece is `Γ(Y, φ⁎𝒪_X(nd))` rather than
`Γ(Y, (φ⁎𝒪_X(d))^{⊗ n})`, and the grading index type lives in the same universe as the ring. The
graded ring homomorphism itself is available as `psiPullback`, and the two conjuncts separately as
`psiPullback_apply_homogeneous` and `generatesStalks_psiPullbackVeroneseHom_one`.
declarations.statement:
theorem psiPullback_gradedRingHom_and_generatesStalks (hd : 0 < d)
    (φ : Y ⟶ (degreeOpen 𝒜 d).toScheme) :
    (letI := veroneseGradingGradedRing 𝒜 d hd
     letI := veroneseSectionGradedRing 𝒜 (toProjRS 𝒜 φ) d (op ⊤)
     ∃ ψ : veroneseGrading 𝒜 d →+*ᵍ veroneseSectionRingGrading 𝒜 (toProjRS 𝒜 φ) d (op ⊤),
       ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : veroneseGrading 𝒜 d n),
         ψ (a : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) =
           DirectSum.of (veroneseSections 𝒜 (toProjRS 𝒜 φ) d (op ⊤)) n
             (psiPullbackVeroneseHom 𝒜 φ n a)) ∧
      Stacks.ProjectiveFromSections.GeneratesStalks
        (L := pullbackTwist 𝒜 φ ((1 * d : ℕ) : ℤ))
        (fun x : ↥(veroneseGrading 𝒜 d 1) => psiPullbackVeroneseHom 𝒜 φ 1 x)
declarations.comment: the graded ring homomorphism ψ^d_φ : S^(d) ⟶ Γ_*(Y, φ⁎𝒪_X(d)) attached to a morphism φ : Y ⟶ U_d, whose degree n component sends a homogeneous element of degree nd to the pullback along φ of the global section of 𝒪_X(nd) it determines, together with the global generation of φ⁎𝒪_X(d) by the sections in the image of its degree-one component S_d

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismToProjSquare.existsUnique_square
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a graded ring, `X = Proj(A)`, let `d ≥ 1` and let `U_d ⊆ X` be the open of
Equation 27.12.0.1. Let `Y` be a scheme, `L` an invertible `𝒪_Y`-module and
`ψ : A^{(d)} → Γ_*(Y, L)` a graded map such that `L` is generated by the sections `ψ(f)`,
`f ∈ A_d` — in the geometric form of Section 27.12, that their nonvanishing opens cover `Y`. Then
there is a **unique** pair `(φ, α)` of a morphism `φ : Y ⟶ U_d` (so the morphism `Y ⟶ X` it
defines has image in `U_d`) and an isomorphism `α : φ⁎𝒪_{U_d}(d) ≅ L` such that `ψ^d_φ` agrees
with `ψ` via `α`: the square

  `α ∘ φ^* ∘ ψ^d = ψ`

commutes in every degree `n`, i.e. `α^{⊗ n}(φ^*(ψ^d(x))) = ψ(x)` in `Γ(Y, L^{⊗ n})` for every
`x ∈ A_{nd}`. Here `ψ^d : A^{(d)} ⟶ Γ_*(U_d, 𝒪_{U_d}(d))` is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOpenUniversalTriple.universalVeroneseSections`, `φ^*` on
sections of tensor powers is `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartRatioPullback.pullSection`, and
`α^{⊗ n}` is `Stacks.AmplePullbackPart1.natTensorPowCongr α n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_square (hd : 0 < d) (ψ : VeroneseSections 𝒜 d L)
    (hgen : ⨆ f : 𝒜 d, nonvanishingOpen Y L (psiSection 𝒜 ψ f) = ⊤) :
    ∃! p : (φ : Y ⟶ (degreeOpen 𝒜 d).toScheme) ×
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback φ).obj (universalTwist 𝒜 d) ≅ L),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : 𝒜 (n * d)),
        (natTensorPowCongr p.2 n).hom.app ⊤
            (pullSection p.1 (universalTwist 𝒜 d) n
              ((universalVeroneseSections 𝒜 d).toFun n x))
          = ψ.toFun n x
declarations.comment: the unique pair (φ, α) of φ : Y ⟶ U_d and α : φ^*O_{U_d}(d) ≅ L making the square α^{⊗n}(φ^*(ψ^d(x))) = ψ(x) commute in every degree n

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartAlphaInstance.isInvertibleModule_pullbackTwist
declarations.doc:
**`φ⁎𝒪_{U_d}(d)` is an invertible `𝒪_Y`-module.** The twist `𝒪_X(d)` is invertible only after
restriction to `U_d` ([Stacks, Tag 01MU]), the pullback along `φ` of an invertible module is
invertible ([Stacks, Tag 0B8L]), and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp` identifies the iterated pullback with the
pullback along `φ ≫ U_d.ι`. At `φ = 𝟙` this is the invertibility of `𝒪_{U_d}(d)`, the module of
the universal family of [Stacks, Tag 01N9].
declarations.statement:
instance isInvertibleModule_pullbackTwist (φ : Y ⟶ (degreeOpen 𝒜 d).toScheme) :
    Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule Y (pullbackTwist 𝒜 φ (d : ℤ))
declarations.comment: the universal family (d, 𝒪_{U_d}(d), ψ^d): 𝒪_{U_d}(d) is an invertible 𝒪_{U_d}-module

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOpenRepresents.iSup_nonvanishingOpen_universalSection_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**The universal family of [Stacks, Tag 01N9] is generated in degree one.** The nonvanishing
open of `ψ^d(f)` on `U_d` is the preimage of `D₊(f)` under the open immersion `U_d ⟶ X`
(`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismToProjUniversal.preimage_basicOpen_eq_nonvanishingOpen`, which
is [Stacks, Tag 01MV] together with [Stacks, Tag 0H78]), and those preimages cover `U_d` because
the `D₊(f)`, `f ∈ 𝒜 d`, are what `U_d` is the union of. So `𝒪_{U_d}(d)` is generated by the
global sections `ψ^d(f)`, in the geometric form Section 27.12 uses that condition.
declarations.statement:
theorem iSup_nonvanishingOpen_universalSection_eq_top :
    (⨆ f : 𝒜 d, nonvanishingOpen (degreeOpen 𝒜 d).toScheme (universalTwist 𝒜 d)
      (universalSection 𝒜 d f)) = ⊤
declarations.comment: the universal family (d, 𝒪_{U_d}(d), ψ^d): the degree-one values ψ^d(f), f ∈ A_d, generate 𝒪_{U_d}(d), their nonvanishing opens covering U_d

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOpenRepresents.existsUnique_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 01N9, Lemma 27.12.2.** Let `A` be a graded ring, `X = Proj(A)`, let `d > 0` and
let `U_d ⊆ X` be the open of Equation 27.12.0.1. The open subscheme `U_d` **represents the
functor `F_d`**, the triple `(d, 𝒪_{U_d}(d), ψ^d)` being the universal family: for a scheme `Y`
and a triple `(d, L, ψ)` over `Y` — an invertible `𝒪_Y`-module `L` and a graded map
`ψ : A^{(d)} ⟶ Γ_*(Y, L)` whose degree-`d` part generates `L`, in the geometric form that the
nonvanishing opens of the sections `ψ(f)`, `f ∈ A_d`, cover `Y` — there is **one and only one**
morphism `φ : Y ⟶ U_d` for which the pullback `φ⁎(d, 𝒪_{U_d}(d), ψ^d)` of the universal family is
strictly equivalent to `(d, L, ψ)`, i.e. for which some isomorphism
`α : φ⁎𝒪_{U_d}(d) ≅ L` identifies `ψ^d_φ` with `ψ`.

That is the bijection `Mor(Y, U_d) ≅ F_d(Y)`: the existence of `φ` is its surjectivity and the
uniqueness of `φ` its injectivity, the map being `φ ↦ [φ⁎(d, 𝒪_{U_d}(d), ψ^d)]`.

The source's proof is *"this is a reformulation of Lemma 27.12.1"*, and so is this one:
[Stacks, Tag 01N8] (`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.MorphismToProjUniversal.existsUnique_pair`) gives a
unique *pair* `(φ, α)`, and a pair is its first component together with the compatibility, so the
morphism is unique among those admitting a compatible `α`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_hom (hd : 0 < d) (ψ : VeroneseSections 𝒜 d L)
    (hgen : ⨆ f : 𝒜 d, nonvanishingOpen Y L (psiSection 𝒜 ψ f) = ⊤) :
    ∃! φ : Y ⟶ (degreeOpen 𝒜 d).toScheme,
      ∃ α : pullbackTwist 𝒜 φ (d : ℤ) ≅ L, IsCompatible 𝒜 ψ ⟨φ, α⟩
declarations.comment: U_d represents F_d, with (d, 𝒪_{U_d}(d), ψ^d) the universal family: a unique morphism Y ⟶ U_d for every triple over Y. The strict equivalence between the pullback of the universal family and the given triple is IsCompatible, whose degree-n clause for n ≥ 2 is the source's local identity ψ(a)|_V = φ♯(a/f^n)·ψ(f)^n|_V rather than the tensor-power square α^{⊗n}(ψ^d_φ(x)) = ψ(x); the square implies it, so the uniqueness assertion is at least as strong as the source's, and the caveat is inherited verbatim from Tag 01N8. Degree 1 is the square itself. The source quantifies over strict equivalence classes; this statement quantifies over representatives, which is stronger.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOneRepresents.degreeOpen_one_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**`X = U_1`.** When `A` is generated as an `𝒜 0`-algebra by its degree-one part, the open
`U_1 = ⋃_{f ∈ 𝒜 1} D₊(f)` of Equation 27.12.0.1 is all of `Proj A`. This is the one input the
source's proof of [Stacks, Tag 01NA] names, and it is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOne.iSup_basicOpen_degreeOne_eq_top` read through the
definition of `U_1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem degreeOpen_one_eq_top (hgen : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) ((𝒜 1 : Set A)) = ⊤) :
    degreeOpen 𝒜 1 = ⊤

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOneRepresents.isInvertibleModule_twistingSheafOne
declarations.doc:
**`𝒪_X(1)` is an invertible `𝒪_X`-module on all of `Proj A`** when `A` is generated in degree
one over `𝒜 0`. Without that hypothesis the twist is invertible only on `U_1`; this is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOne.isInvertible_twistingSheaf`, read in the
`Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule` spelling that triples and their trivializations are stated
in.
declarations.statement:
theorem isInvertibleModule_twistingSheafOne
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) ((𝒜 1 : Set A)) = ⊤) :
    Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒜)
      (twistingSheaf 𝒜 ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
declarations.comment: the universal family on X: 𝒪_X(1) is invertible

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOneRepresents.exists_mem_nonvanishingLocus_degreeSection
declarations.doc:
**The universal family of [Stacks, Tag 01NA] generates `𝒪_X(1)` on all of `X`.** The global
section of `𝒪_X(1)` attached to a degree-one element `f` is nonvanishing exactly on `D₊(f)`
([Stacks, Tag 01MV], available because `U_1 ⊆ W_1`), and those opens cover `Proj A` by
`degreeOpen_one_eq_top`. So the degree-one part of `ψ^1` generates `𝒪_X(1)`, which is the second
assertion of [Stacks, Tag 01N9] transported to `X` by `X = U_1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_mem_nonvanishingLocus_degreeSection
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) ((𝒜 1 : Set A)) = ⊤) (x : ProjectiveSpectrum.top 𝒜) :
    ∃ f : 𝒜 1, x ∈ Stacks.Ample.nonvanishingLocus (X := AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒜)
      (twistingSheaf 𝒜 ((1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (degreeSection 𝒜 1 f)
declarations.comment: the universal family on X: global generation in degree one

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjDegreeOneRepresents.existsUnique_classifies
declarations.doc:
**The universal property of `Proj A` of [Stacks, Tag 01NA].** Let `A` be a graded ring
generated as an `𝒜 0`-algebra by its degree-one part, let `Y` be a scheme, `L` an invertible
`𝒪_Y`-module and `ψ : A ⟶ Γ_*(Y, L)` a graded map whose degree-one part generates `L`. Then
there is one and only one pair `(φ, α)` consisting of a morphism `φ : Y ⟶ Proj A` and an
isomorphism `α : φ⁎𝒪_X(1) ≅ L ^⊗ 1` classifying `(L, ψ)`.

This is [Stacks, Tag 01N8] at `d = 1` with the target raised from `U_1` to the whole of
`Proj A`, which is the content of [Stacks, Tag 01NA]: `X = U_1` by `degreeOpen_one_eq_top`, so
every morphism into `X` is a morphism into `U_1` and the uniqueness assertion holds among all
morphisms into `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_classifies (hgen : Algebra.adjoin (𝒜 0) ((𝒜 1 : Set A)) = ⊤)
    (ψ : VeroneseSections 𝒜 1 L) (hcover : ⨆ f : 𝒜 1, nvOpen 𝒜 ψ f = ⊤) :
    ∃! p : Pair 𝒜 L, Classifies 𝒜 ψ p

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjEquivalenceCycle.tfae_triple
declarations.doc:
For two triples `t`, `t'` over a scheme the following are equivalent: the agreement condition
at the weights `(lcm(d, d') / d, lcm(d, d') / d')`; the agreement condition at the weights
`(d', d)`; the agreement condition at some positive weights `(a, a')` with `a * d = a' * d'`; the
two triples classify the same morphism. Here `d = t.deg` and `d' = t'.deg`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_triple (t t' : Triple 𝒜 Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [AgreeAt t t' (Nat.lcm t.deg t'.deg / t.deg) (Nat.lcm t.deg t'.deg / t'.deg),
        AgreeAt t t' t'.deg t.deg,
        ∃ a a' : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < a' ∧ a * t.deg = a' * t'.deg ∧ AgreeAt t t' a a',
        SameMorphism 𝒜 t t']
declarations.comment:
all four clauses of the tag are equivalent, for two triples over a scheme, as a
single statement; the list entries are clauses (1), (2), (3), (4) in that order

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTripleDegreeFunctor.F.representableBy
declarations.doc:
**`Proj(A)` represents the functor `F` of Section 01N4.** Let `A` be a graded ring and
`X = Proj(A)`. The functor `F : Sch^{opp} ⟶ Sets` which sends a quasi-compact scheme `T` to
`⋃_{d ≥ 1} F_d(T)`, the colimit of the sets of strict equivalence classes of triples of positive
weight along the weight transitions, and a general scheme to the limit of those over its
quasi-compact opens, is represented by `X`: there is a bijection `Mor(T, X) ≃ F(T)` natural in `T`.

The bijection is `F.classifyingEquiv`, whose two halves are the injectivity of [Stacks, Tag 01NB]
and the surjectivity coming from [Stacks, Tag 01N9]'s universal family; its naturality is
`F.ofHom_comp`.
declarations.statement: def F.representableBy : (F.functor 𝒮).RepresentableBy (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮)
declarations.comment: the FULL statement of this tag: Proj(A) represents the functor F of Section 01N4. F.functor is F as a functor Sch^opp ⟶ Type (u+1) on ALL schemes (the colimit Fcolim of the F_d along divisibility on a quasi-compact T, by F.fcolimEquiv, and the limit over the quasi-compact test objects in general, which is the limit over the quasi-compact opens the source writes — see the module docstring for why the index is the morphisms out of quasi-compact schemes), F.classifyingEquiv is the bijection F(T) ≃ Mor(T, Proj(A)) for every scheme T, and this is the RepresentableBy datum. The two halves of the bijection remain available separately as Fd.veronese_eq_weightCongr_veronese_of_classifyingMorphism_eq (injectivity) and Fd.exists_pos_classifyingMorphism_eq (surjectivity for a quasi-compact Y). The grading is taken with its index type in the same universe as the graded ring, which is the generality of Tag 01N9's universal family here; the functor F itself and F.fcolimEquiv are unrestricted.

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveFromSections.toProjectiveSpaceOver
declarations.doc:
**The morphism `φ_{(L, (s₀, …, sₙ))} : X ⟶ ℙⁿ_S` of Section 27.13**, attached to a structure
morphism `f : X ⟶ S`, an invertible `𝒪_X`-module `L` and a generating family of `n + 1` global
sections of `L`. It is the morphism to the integral model paired with `f`; no compatibility has
to be checked, `ℙⁿ_S` being a fibre product over the terminal scheme.
declarations.statement: def toProjectiveSpaceOver {S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) : X ⟶ projectiveSpaceOver n S
declarations.comment: the notation phi_(L, (s_0, ..., s_n)) of the section, as data: the morphism to P^n_S attached to an invertible module with n + 1 generating global sections, pinned on each standard chart. The scheme P^n_S itself is Tag 01NF (AlgebraicGeometry.projectiveSpaceOver). The section's characterisation of the morphism by L = phi^* O(1) and s_i = phi^* T_i is NOT proved: the comparison of L with the pullback of the hyperplane sheaf is the twist identification recorded as missing in StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/AmpleProjectiveImmersion/Basic.lean. The representability statement Tag 01NE is likewise not proved, only this direction of it

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpaceModuli.pointsOfHom_comp

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartGradedTripleTag.tag01NK
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a graded ring, `X = Proj A`, `T` a scheme, `L` an invertible `𝒪_T`-module and
`ψ : A → Γ_*(T, L)` a homomorphism of graded rings. Put
`U(ψ) = ⋃_{f ∈ A_+ homogeneous} T_{ψ(f)}`. Then `ψ` induces the canonical morphism
`r_{L, ψ} = ψ.glued : U(ψ) ⟶ X` and the map of `ℤ`-graded algebras
`θ = theta 𝒜 ψ : r_{L, ψ}^*(⨁_{d ∈ ℤ} 𝒪_X(d)) ⟶ ⨁_{d ∈ ℤ} L^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}`, and:

1. `U(ψ)` is the union of the `T_{ψ(f)}` (by definition);
2. `θ` preserves the unit;
3. **property (1)**: `r_{L, ψ}^{-1}(D₊(f)) = T_{ψ(f)}` for `f ∈ A_+` homogeneous;
4. **property (2)**: for every `d ≥ 0` and `a ∈ A_d`, `θ` carries the pullback of the global
   section of `𝒪_X(d)` attached to `a` (the map of [Stacks, Tag 01MP]) to `ψ(a)|_{U(ψ)}` — the
   commutativity of the square of the tag;
5. **the characterization**: every triple `(U', r', θ')` — an open of `T`, a morphism
   `U' ⟶ X` and a map of graded algebras `r'^*(⨁ 𝒪_X(d)) ⟶ ⨁ L^{⊗ d}|_{U'}` — with properties
   (1) and (2) is `(U(ψ), r_{L, ψ}, θ)`;
6. **the final assertion**: for `d ≥ 1` and an open `V ⊆ T` on which the sections `ψ(A_d)`
   generate `L^{⊗ d}|_V`, the pair `(φ, α)` of [Stacks, Tag 01N8] for
   `ψ|_{A^{(d)}} : A^{(d)} → Γ_*(V, L^{⊗ d})` exists and is unique, and for it
   `r_{L, ψ}|_V = φ` and the restriction of the degree-`d` part of `θ` to `V`, read through the
   canonical identifications `(r_{L, ψ}|_V)^*𝒪_X(d) = φ^*𝒪_X(d)` and
   `L^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}|_V = L|_V^{⊗ d}`, is `α`.

The value `ψ(a)` is read in the tensor powers of [Stacks, Tag 01CU] that the Laurent algebra is
made of, through the canonical comparison
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartGradedDivision.intValue`.
The sections `ψ(A_d)` generate `L^{⊗ d}|_V` exactly when their nonvanishing opens cover `V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tag01NK :
    ψ.coveringOpen
        = ⨆ p : (e : ℕ) × 𝒜 (e + 1),
            nonvanishingOpen T (natTensorPow L (p.1 + 1)) (ψ.toFun (p.1 + 1) p.2)
      ∧ SheafOfModules.sectionsMap ((theta 𝒜 ψ).app 0)
          (Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback ψ.glued
            (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjConeTwist.integerTwistAlgebra 𝒜)).one
        = (laurentRestrict 𝒜 ψ).one
      ∧ (∀ {e : ℕ} {f : A} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 e), 0 < e →
          ψ.coveringOpen.ι ''ᵁ (ψ.glued ⁻¹ᵁ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen 𝒜 f)
            = nonvanishingOpen T (natTensorPow L e) (ψ.toFun e ⟨f, hf⟩))
      ∧ (∀ (d : ℕ) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 d),
          ((theta 𝒜 ψ).app (d : ℤ)).val.app (op ⊤)
              (Scheme.Modules.pullbackSection ψ.glued (twistM 𝒜 (d : ℤ)) ⊤ ⊤
                (fun _ _ => trivial) (degreeSection 𝒜 d ⟨a, ha⟩))
            = resTop (tensorPowerModule T L (d : ℤ)) (intValue ψ d ⟨a, ha⟩)
                (ψ.coveringOpen.ι ''ᵁ ⊤))
      ∧ (∀ t : Triple 𝒜 L, IsTriple ψ t → t = canonicalTriple ψ)
      ∧ (∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {V : T.Opens}
          (hVgen : V ≤ ⨆ g : 𝒜 d, nonvanishingOpen T (natTensorPow L d) (ψ.toFun d g)),
          (∃! p : Pair 𝒜 (natTensorPow ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).obj L) d) d,
              IsCompatible 𝒜 (veroneseAt 𝒜 (GradedSections.pullback V.ι ψ) d) p) ∧
          ∀ p : Pair 𝒜 (natTensorPow ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).obj L) d) d,
            IsCompatible 𝒜 (veroneseAt 𝒜 (GradedSections.pullback V.ι ψ) d) p →
            ∃ h : T.homOfLE (hVgen.trans (iSup_nonvanishingOpen_le_coveringOpen 𝒜 ψ hd))
                ≫ ψ.glued = toProj 𝒜 p.1,
              (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h.symm).hom.app (twistM 𝒜 (d : ℤ))
                ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
                    (T.homOfLE (hVgen.trans (iSup_nonvanishingOpen_le_coveringOpen 𝒜 ψ hd)))
                    ψ.glued).inv.app (twistM 𝒜 (d : ℤ))
                ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback
                    (T.homOfLE (hVgen.trans (iSup_nonvanishingOpen_le_coveringOpen 𝒜 ψ hd)))).map
                    ((theta 𝒜 ψ).app (d : ℤ))
                ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback
                    (T.homOfLE (hVgen.trans (iSup_nonvanishingOpen_le_coveringOpen 𝒜 ψ hd)))).map
                    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback ψ.coveringOpen.ι).hom.app
                      (tensorPowerModule T L (d : ℤ)))
                ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
                    (T.homOfLE (hVgen.trans (iSup_nonvanishingOpen_le_coveringOpen 𝒜 ψ hd)))
                    ψ.coveringOpen.ι).hom.app (tensorPowerModule T L (d : ℤ))
                ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (T.homOfLE_ι _)).hom.app
                    (tensorPowerModule T L (d : ℤ))
                ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).map (powCompare L d).inv
                ≫ (pullbackNatTensorPowIso V.ι L d).inv
                = p.2.hom)
declarations.comment: the open U(psi), the morphism r_{L,psi} : U(psi) -> Proj A and the unital map of Z-graded algebras theta : r^*(sum_d O_X(d)) -> sum_d L^{tensor d}|_{U(psi)}; properties (1) and (2); every triple (U', r', theta') with (1) and (2) equals (U(psi), r, theta); and for d >= 1 and an open V on which psi(A_d) generates L^{tensor d}, the pair (phi, alpha) attached to the Veronese restriction of psi to V exists uniquely, r|_V = phi, and theta|_V in degree d equals alpha

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjInvertibleLocusEscape.not_range_subset_whereInvertible
declarations.doc:
Let `k` be a field, let `S = k[A, B, C]` be graded by
`deg A = 1`, `deg B = 2`, `deg C = 3` and set `X = Proj S`. Let `T = 𝐏²_k = Proj k[X₀, X₁, X₂]`
with `𝓛 = 𝒪_T(1)`, so `𝒪_T(n) = 𝓛^{⊗ n}`, and let `ψ : S → Γ_*(T, 𝓛)` be the composite of the
degree-preserving homomorphism `A ↦ X₀`, `B ↦ X₁²`, `C ↦ X₂³` with the canonical graded ring map
of Tag 01MP. The image of the induced morphism `r_{𝓛, ψ} : T → X` is **not** contained in the
invertible locus `W₁` of `𝒪_X(1)` — the largest open of `X` on which all the twists `𝒪_X(n)` are
invertible and all their multiplication maps are isomorphisms, Tag 01MU. Indeed the point of `X`
given by the homogeneous prime `(A, B)` is in the image, and a homogeneous element of `S` outside
`(A, B)` has degree divisible by `3`, so no two of them have degrees differing by `1`.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjBridge.SheafGradedAlgebra.instGCommRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01NN, the graded rings of local sections.** The homogeneous sections of a
quasi-coherent graded algebra over an open form a graded commutative ring, whose multiplication
and unit are the algebra's own: see the characterizing equations below.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable instance instGCommRing : DirectSum.GCommRing (A.sectionPieces U)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjBridge.SheafGradedAlgebra.strHom

of `A`: a function is sent to its multiple of the unit.
