declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativeProjChartAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**The restriction `𝒜|_V` of a graded algebra on an algebraic space to an étale scheme chart,
as graded algebra data in the sense of Situation 01NN.**  This is the object the scheme-level
theory of the relative Proj consumes, so it is what makes a reduction to the case of schemes on
an étale chart possible.

Commutativity and concentration in nonnegative degrees are transported from `𝒜`.  Quasi-coherence
of the restricted pieces is the hypothesis `hqc`; see the implementation notes for why it is
carried and why it is an input rather than a disguised conclusion.
declarations.statement:
def relativeProjChartAlgebra
    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ℤ) (W : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ) (a : (A.piece i).val.obj W)
      (b : (A.piece j).val.obj W), HEq ((A.mul i j).app W a b) ((A.mul j i).app W b a))
    (hneg : ∀ (n : ℤ), n < 0 → ∀ (W : (SmallEtale B S hS X.1)ᵒᵖ)
      (y : (A.piece n).val.obj W), y = 0)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (restrictToChartScheme B S hS X.1 X.2 (A.piece n) V).IsQuasicoherent) :
    SheafGradedAlgebra (chartScheme V)
declarations.comment: the restriction of a graded algebra on an algebraic space to an étale scheme chart, as graded algebra data on the chart; granted quasi-coherence of the module restrictions of the homogeneous pieces, which is the étale-to-Zariski direction of Descent 03DX and is carried here in the same form as in the neighbouring Tag 060Q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativeProjChartSituation
declarations.doc:
**The tie: the relative Proj situation of Stacks 01NN carried by the restriction of `𝒜` to an
étale scheme chart.**

The base is the scheme underlying the chart and the graded algebra is the restriction `𝒜|_V` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartSheafAlgebra`.  Commutativity and concentration in nonnegative
degrees are the corresponding fields of the space-level situation, transported; quasi-coherence of
the restricted pieces is the hypothesis `hqc`, for the reason given in the implementation notes.

This is the datum that `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.RelativeProjChart` lacks: that structure takes an
arbitrary situation `t` on the chart, with no field relating it to the graded algebra on the
space.
declarations.statement:
def relativeProjChartSituation
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (restrictToChartScheme s.site s.base s.containsBase s.space.1 s.space.2
      (s.algebra.piece n) V).IsQuasicoherent) :
    Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.{u}
declarations.comment: the relative Proj situation carried on an étale scheme chart by the restriction of a graded algebra on an algebraic space, granted quasi-coherence of the module restrictions of the homogeneous pieces, which is the étale-to-Zariski direction of Descent 03DX

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.isOpenImmersion_proj_map_reesRestrict
declarations.doc:
For affine opens `U ≤ V`, the comparison morphism of charts
`Proj (Γ(S, U)[ℐ(U)t]) ⟶ Proj (Γ(S, V)[ℐ(V)t])` is an open immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_proj_map_reesRestrict {U V : S.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    IsOpenImmersion (Proj.map (reesRestrict ℐ h) (reesIrrelevant_le ℐ h))
declarations.comment: open immersion, for the Rees algebra of a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.opensRange_proj_map_reesRestrict
declarations.doc:
For affine opens `U ≤ V`, the image of the comparison morphism of charts is the preimage of
`U` in the chart over `V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem opensRange_proj_map_reesRestrict {U V : S.affineOpens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    Stacks.RelativeProj.chartToOpen (fun W : S.affineOpens ↦ reesGrading (ℐ.ideal W)) V
        (reesBase ℐ V) ⁻¹ᵁ (S.homOfLE h).opensRange =
      (Proj.map (reesRestrict ℐ h) (reesIrrelevant_le ℐ h)).opensRange
declarations.comment: image is the preimage, for the Rees algebra of a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjInclusionTwist.isIso_projInclusionTwistMap
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01NO's transported comparison map on the `n`-th twist is an isomorphism**, for every
`n : ℤ` and for an arbitrary inclusion of affine opens of the base, with no hypothesis beyond
that situation.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.projInclusionDomain_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01NO, the everywhere-defined morphism.** For an inclusion `U ⊆ V` of affine opens of
the base, the morphism of projective spectra induced by restriction of homogeneous sections is
defined on all of `Proj Γ(U, A)`.

This is `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjGeneral.mapDomain_res_eq_top_of_le_opens` for the
graded algebra the bridge produces.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.projInclusion_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01NO, the cartesian square.** For an inclusion `U ⊆ V` of affine opens of the base,
the square formed by the induced morphism of projective spectra, the two structure morphisms to
the affine opens and the inclusion `U ⊆ V` is cartesian.

This is `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjGeneral.isPullback_transition_of_le_opens` for the
graded algebra the bridge produces.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projInclusion_isPullback (U V : S.Opens) (h : U ≤ V)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsPullback (projInclusionMap A U V h hU hV) (projInclusionToOpen A U hU)
      (projInclusionToOpen A V hV) (S.homOfLE h)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.projInclusionDomain_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01NO.** The morphism of projective spectra induced by restriction of
homogeneous sections along an inclusion of affine opens is defined on all of
`Proj (s.sectionRingGrading U)`.

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.projInclusion_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01NO.** The square formed by the comparison morphism of charts, the two
chart structure morphisms and the inclusion of affine opens of the base is cartesian.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projInclusion_isPullback {W W' : s.base.Opens} (h : W ≤ W')
    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hW' : IsAffineOpen W') :
    IsPullback (projInclusionMap s W W' h hW hW') (projInclusionToOpen s W hW)
      (projInclusionToOpen s W' hW') (s.base.homOfLE h)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.isIso_twistMap_gradedSectionRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01NO.** The canonical comparison
`θ : r^* 𝒪_{Proj 𝒜(W')}(n) ⟶ 𝒪_{Proj 𝒜(W)}(n)` attached to an inclusion `W ≤ W'` of affine opens
of the base is an isomorphism, for every `n : ℤ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistMap_gradedSectionRestriction {W W' : s.base.Opens} (h : W ≤ W')
    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hW' : IsAffineOpen W') (n : ℤ) :
    IsIso (twistMap (gradedSectionRestriction s W W' h)
      (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s W W' h hW hW') n)
declarations.comment: the canonical twist isomorphisms θ, for an arbitrary inclusion of affine opens of the base; their compatibility with the multiplication maps is not covered

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjTwistComparison.isIso_twistMap
declarations.doc:
**The canonical twist comparison of a degreewise localization is an isomorphism.** If `φ` is,
in each degree, the localization of `𝒜` away from a degree-zero element `g`, then for every `n`
the comparison `θ : r^* 𝒪_{Proj 𝒜}(n) ⟶ 𝒪_{Proj ℬ}(n)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistMap {g : A} (h : Stacks.GradedLocalization.IsAwayDegreewise φ g)
    (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 0) : IsIso (twistMap φ hφ n)
declarations.comment: the twist comparison is an isomorphism, for a degreewise localization away from a degree-zero element; the descent to a general affine open and the compatibility with the multiplication maps are not covered

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjTwistComparison.sectionsMap_twistSectionsMul
declarations.doc:
**The twist comparison is compatible with the multiplication of twisted sections.** The
comparison of a product of a degree-`p` and a degree-`q` section is the product of the
comparisons; this is the multiplicativity of the comparison of local rings, applied at each
point.
declarations.statement:
theorem sectionsMap_twistSectionsMul (p q : ℤ) (U : Opens (ProjectiveSpectrum.top 𝒜))
    (a : moduleSections 𝒜 (twistGrading (S := A) 𝒜 p) U)
    (b : moduleSections 𝒜 (twistGrading (S := A) 𝒜 q) U) :
    sectionsMap φ hφ (p + q) U (twistSectionsMul 𝒜 p q U a b) =
      twistSectionsMul ℬ p q (U.comap (ProjectiveSpectrum.comap φ hφ))
        (sectionsMap φ hφ p U a) (sectionsMap φ hφ q U b)
declarations.comment: the compatibility of the twist comparison with the multiplication of twisted sections, i.e. with the pointwise product of fraction families; the compatibility with the sheaf-level multiplication maps 𝒪(p) ⊗ 𝒪(q) ⟶ 𝒪(p + q) is not covered

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistMultCompat.projInclusionTwistIso_preserves_products
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01NO, multiplication compatibility of twist isomorphisms.** For an inclusion `U ⊆ V` of
affine opens of the base of a quasi-coherent graded algebra and any two twist indices `n, m : ℤ`,
the canonical isomorphisms on the twists of the induced morphism of projective spectra are
compatible with the multiplication maps of Tag 01MU: the pulled-back multiplication followed by
the comparison on the `(n + m)`-th twist is the tensor product of the comparisons on the `n`-th
and the `m`-th twists followed by the multiplication map downstairs.

The hypotheses are exactly those of the tagged statement: a quasi-coherent graded algebra on a scheme, two affine
opens, an inclusion between them, and two unrestricted twist indices.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projInclusionTwistIso_preserves_products :
    pullbackTwistMultiplication (A.grading V) (projInclusionMap A U V h hU hV) n m ≫
        (projInclusionTwistIso A U V h hU hV (n + m)).hom =
      ((Functor.uncurry.obj (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor.{u, u, u, u, u}
          ⟨(((AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (A.grading U)).toRingedSpace)).presheaf,
            (((AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (A.grading U)).toRingedSpace)).IsSheaf⟩)).map
          (X := ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projInclusionMap A U V h hU hV)).obj
            (twistingSheaf (A.grading V) n),
            (Scheme.Modules.pullback (projInclusionMap A U V h hU hV)).obj
              (twistingSheaf (A.grading V) m)))
          (Y := (twistingSheaf (A.grading U) n, twistingSheaf (A.grading U) m))
          (((projInclusionTwistIso A U V h hU hV n).hom,
            (projInclusionTwistIso A U V h hU hV m).hom) : (_, _) ⟶ (_, _))) ≫
        twistMultiplicationMap (A.grading U) n m

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.projInclusionMap_and_twistMap_trans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01NP, both of its assertions as one statement.** In Situation 01NN, let
`U ⊆ U' ⊆ U''` be affine opens of the base and put `A = 𝒜(U)`, `A' = 𝒜(U')`, `A'' = 𝒜(U'')` for
the graded rings of local sections. Then:

* the composition of the tag-01NO morphisms `r : Proj A ⟶ Proj A'` and `r' : Proj A' ⟶ Proj A''`
  is the tag-01NO morphism `r'' : Proj A ⟶ Proj A''` of the inclusion `U ⊆ U''`;
* the similar statement holds for the tag-01NO comparison isomorphisms `θ`: for every degree `n`,
  every open `V` of `Proj A''`, every section `a` of `𝒪_{Proj A''}(n)` over `V` and every point of
  `Proj A` lying over `V`, the composite of `θ` and `θ'` and the comparison `θ''` of the outer
  inclusion read the same degree-`n` fraction.

The two conjuncts are `Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.projInclusionMap_trans` and
`Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.twistMap_gradedSectionRestriction_trans`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem projInclusionMap_and_twistMap_trans (U U' U'' : s.base.Opens) (hUU' : U ≤ U')
    (hU'U'' : U' ≤ U'') (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hU' : IsAffineOpen U')
    (hU'' : IsAffineOpen U'') :
    (projInclusionMap s U U' hUU' hU hU' ≫ projInclusionMap s U' U'' hU'U'' hU' hU'' =
        projInclusionMap s U U'' (hUU'.trans hU'U'') hU hU'') ∧
      ∀ (n : ℤ) (V : Opens (ProjectiveSpectrum.top (s.sectionRingGrading U'')))
          (a : moduleSections (s.sectionRingGrading U'')
            (twistGrading (S := s.sectionRing U'') (s.sectionRingGrading U'') n) V)
          (y : V.comap (ProjectiveSpectrum.comap
            (gradedSectionRestriction s U U'' (hUU'.trans hU'U''))
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s U U'' (hUU'.trans hU'U'') hU hU''))),
        (sectionsMap (gradedSectionRestriction s U U'' (hUU'.trans hU'U''))
            (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s U U'' (hUU'.trans hU'U'') hU hU'')
            n V a).1 y
          = (sectionsMap (gradedSectionRestriction s U U' hUU')
              (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s U U' hUU' hU hU') n
              (V.comap (ProjectiveSpectrum.comap (gradedSectionRestriction s U' U'' hU'U'')
                (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s U' U'' hU'U'' hU' hU'')))
              (sectionsMap (gradedSectionRestriction s U' U'' hU'U'')
                (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s U' U'' hU'U'' hU' hU'') n V a)).1
              ⟨y.1, mem_comap_comap_of_eq_comp (gradedSectionRestriction s U' U'' hU'U'')
                (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s U' U'' hU'U'' hU' hU'')
                (gradedSectionRestriction s U U' hUU')
                (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s U U' hUU' hU hU')
                (irrelevant_le_map_gradedSectionRestriction s U U'' (hUU'.trans hU'U'') hU hU'')
                (gradedSectionRestriction_comp s U U' U'' hUU' hU'U'') y.2⟩
declarations.comment:
both assertions of the tag as one statement, in the shape of Situation 01NN: the
composition law for the tag-01NO morphisms r, and the similar law for the comparison
isomorphisms θ

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.relativeProj
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01NQ.** The relative homogeneous spectrum of a quasi-coherent graded algebra on a
scheme, together with its structure morphism to the base and its canonical affine charts.

The scheme is the colimit of the chart functor on the small affine Zariski site of the base; the
chart over an affine open is the colimit inclusion, and it is cartesian over that affine open
because the relative glueing datum's squares are. Compatibility of the charts with the
transitions holds for the arrows of the site by the defining equation of the colimit, and for an
arbitrary inclusion of affine opens by
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjGeneral.transition_comp_chart_of_le_opens`.
declarations.statement: public def relativeProj : RelativeProjData A

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01NQ.** The relative projective spectrum of a quasi-coherent
nonnegatively graded algebra on a scheme: the scheme glued from the projective spectra of the
graded rings of local sections over the affine opens of the base.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def relativeProj : Scheme.{u}

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProjToBase
declarations.doc: The structure morphism of the relative projective spectrum to its base.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def relativeProjToBase : relativeProj s ⟶ s.base

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProjChart
declarations.doc:
The chart over an affine open of the base, as a morphism into the relative projective
spectrum.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def relativeProjChart (W : s.base.affineOpens) :
    Proj (s.sectionRingGrading W.1) ⟶ relativeProj s

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProjChart_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**The chart over `W` is the part of the relative projective spectrum lying over `W`.** This
is the defining property of a relative projective spectrum.

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProjChart_transition
declarations.doc: The charts are compatible with the comparison morphisms of charts.
declarations.statement:
public theorem relativeProjChart_transition {W W' : s.base.affineOpens} (h : W ≤ W') :
    projInclusionMap s W.1 W'.1 h W.2 W'.2 ≫ relativeProjChart s W' = relativeProjChart s W

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**The twists on the relative projective spectrum of a quasi-coherent graded algebra exist**,
on no hypothesis beyond the graded algebra itself: the nested cocycle of Tag 01MZ that the glued
twists are indexed by is discharged in every integer degree by
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistCocycle.isNestedCocycle`.
declarations.statement: public def twistDataOfGradedAlgebra : TwistData A
declarations.comment: the existence assertion: the graded twists and the homogeneous-section map, for a quasi-coherent graded algebra on any scheme, with no hypothesis beyond the algebra itself. The two uniqueness assertions are carried by `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistExistence.isUniqueTwistData` and `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistRigidity.determinesChartIso`, which were vacuous until this term existed

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistExistence.isUniqueTwistData
declarations.doc:
**Tag 01NR's first uniqueness assertion.** Any two sets of twist data on a relative Proj are
carried into each other by a *unique* isomorphism of graded algebras commuting with the
homogeneous-section maps. The existence half is the glued comparison of this file; the
uniqueness half is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistUnique.isUniqueTwistData_of_exists`.
declarations.statement: public theorem isUniqueTwistData (A : SheafGradedAlgebra S) : IsUniqueTwistData A

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistRigidity.determinesChartIso
declarations.doc:
An isomorphism of the glued graded algebras of two twist data which commutes with the
homogeneous-section maps determines every chart identification, in every integer degree.
declarations.statement: public theorem determinesChartIso (A : SheafGradedAlgebra S) : DeterminesChartIso A

registrations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjTwists.TwistData.chartIso_mul
registrations.comment: multiplication on affine charts

registrations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjTwists.TwistData.chartIso_one
registrations.comment: the unit on affine charts

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd.toBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 01NS: the projection `F_d ⟹ h_S`.** A point of `F_d(T)` is the
strict equivalence class of a quadruple `(d, f : T → S, L, ψ)`, and this is the natural
transformation sending it to the morphism `f` it records.

Naturality is the computation `Fd.pullback_fst` of the morphism to the base of a pulled-back
class: it is the composite of the morphism of test schemes with the old one, which is exactly the
action of `h_S` on a morphism.
declarations.statement: def Fd.toBase : Fd.functor A d ⟶ yoneda.obj S ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}
declarations.comment: the projection of F_d to the functor of points of the base, as a natural transformation F_d ⟹ h_S: a class in F_d(T) records a morphism T ⟶ S and the identification is natural in the test scheme. This is the structure that makes `representable by a scheme over S` (Tag 01NV) and the fibre product h_{S'} ×_{h_S} F_d (Tag 01NT) statable; neither of those is proved here

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd.overFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 01NS: the functor `F_d : (Sch/S)^{opp} ⟶ Sets`.** On an object
`f : T ⟶ S` of the category of schemes over `S` its value is the fibre of `F_d(T)` over `f`,
that is, the set of strict equivalence classes of quadruples `(d, f, L, ψ)` with that structure
morphism; on a morphism of `Sch/S` it is the pullback of a quadruple, which lands in the fibre
over the new structure morphism because the morphism to the base of a pulled-back class is the
composite.

This is the form of `F_d` the source's phrase "a functor on schemes over `S`" refers to; the
form fibred over `Hom(-, S)` on all of `Sch` is
`...RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd.functor` together with the projection `Fd.toBase`.
declarations.statement: def Fd.overFunctor : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1)
declarations.comment: the functor F_d on the category of schemes OVER S, for an arbitrary base scheme: on an object f : T ⟶ S the set of strict equivalence classes of quadruples (d, f, L, psi) with that structure morphism, on a morphism of Sch/S the pullback of a quadruple. The two functor laws are Fd.pullback_id and Fd.pullback_comp. Representability of F_d is Tag 01NV and is not proved here

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 01NS.** A quadruple `(d, f : T → S, L, ψ)` over the test scheme
`T`: an invertible `𝒪_T`-module `L`, a homomorphism `ψ` of graded `𝒪_T`-algebras from the
pullback of the `d`-th Veronese regrading of `𝒜` to the Laurent algebra of `L`, and the
requirement that the degree-one component `f^*𝒜_d ⟶ L` of `ψ` be surjective.

The integer `d` and the morphism `f` are parameters; the pair `(L, ψ)` is the data.
declarations.statement:
structure Quadruple (f : T ⟶ S)
    (A : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.{u, u} (structureRingSheaf S.toRingedSpace)) (d : ℤ)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple.StrictlyEquivalent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 01NS.** Two quadruples over the same morphism `f` are *strictly
equivalent* when there is an isomorphism `β : L ≅ L'` of their invertible modules with
`β ∘ ψ = ψ'`.

The composite `β ∘ ψ` is spelled through the isomorphism `γ` of Laurent algebras induced by `β`:
the condition is that `γ` be an isomorphism of sheaves of graded algebras whose degree-one
component is `β` and which carries `ψ` to `ψ'` in every degree.
declarations.statement: def StrictlyEquivalent (P Q : Quadruple f A d) : Prop

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple.strictlyEquivalent_equivalence
declarations.doc: **Strict equivalence of quadruples is an equivalence relation.**
declarations.statement:
theorem strictlyEquivalent_equivalence :
    Equivalence (StrictlyEquivalent (f := f) (A := A) (d := d))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 01NS.** The set `F_d(T)` of strict equivalence classes of
quadruples `(d, f : T → S, L, ψ)` over the test scheme `T`.

Strict equivalence relates only quadruples over the same morphism `f : T ⟶ S`, so the set of
classes is fibred over the morphisms `T ⟶ S`, which is the morphism recorded by a quadruple.
declarations.statement:
def Fd (A : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.{u, u} (structureRingSheaf S.toRingedSpace)) (d : ℤ)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) : Type (u + 1)
declarations.comment: the set of strict equivalence classes of quadruples over a test scheme

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple.strictlyEquivalent_pullback_id
declarations.doc: The pullback of a quadruple along an identity is strictly equivalent to the quadruple.
declarations.statement:
theorem strictlyEquivalent_pullback_id (P : Quadruple f A d) :
    StrictlyEquivalent (P.pullback (𝟙 T)) P
declarations.comment: the pullback of a quadruple along the identity morphism of the test scheme is strictly equivalent to the quadruple

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple.strictlyEquivalent_pullback_comp
declarations.doc:
The pullback of a quadruple along a composite of morphisms of test schemes is strictly
equivalent to the twice-pulled-back quadruple.
declarations.statement:
theorem strictlyEquivalent_pullback_comp (P : Quadruple f A d) (g : T' ⟶ T) (g' : T'' ⟶ T') :
    StrictlyEquivalent ((P.pullback g).pullback g') (P.pullback (g' ≫ g))
declarations.comment: the pullback of a quadruple along a composite of morphisms of test schemes is strictly equivalent to the twice-pulled-back quadruple

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd.functor
declarations.doc:
The functor `F_d : Sch^{opp} ⟶ Sets` at a fixed degree `d`. It sends a test scheme `T` to the
set `F_d(T)` of strict equivalence classes of quadruples `(d, f : T → S, L, ψ)` of degree `d`, and
a morphism `g : T' ⟶ T` of test schemes to the map sending the class of a quadruple to the class
of its pullback along `g`.
declarations.statement:
def Fd.functor (A : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.{u, u} (structureRingSheaf S.toRingedSpace))
    (d : ℤ) : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1)
declarations.comment: the functor F_d : Sch^opp -> Sets at a fixed degree d, with both functor laws proved (Fd.pullback_id and Fd.pullback_comp): on objects the set F_d(T) of strict equivalence classes of quadruples of degree d, on morphisms the pullback of a quadruple. Representability of F_d by a scheme is Tag 01NV and is not proved here

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple.StrictlyEquivalent.pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 01NS: the pullback of a quadruple respects strict equivalence.**
Strict equivalence is witnessed by an isomorphism of the Laurent algebras carrying `ψ` to `ψ'`;
`laurentPullbackIso` carries that witness to one for the pullbacks, and
`Twisting.pullbackApp_comp_laurentTransport_of_app` is the compatibility with `ψ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem StrictlyEquivalent.pullback {P Q : Quadruple f A d} (h : StrictlyEquivalent P Q)
    (g : T' ⟶ T) : StrictlyEquivalent (P.pullback g) (Q.pullback g)
declarations.comment: the pullback of a quadruple along a morphism of test schemes respects strict equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple.Equivalent.pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 01NS: the pullback of a quadruple respects equivalence of quadruples
of possibly different degrees.** Equivalence is the comparison at the common multiple `d d'` of the
two degrees, and the pullback leaves both degrees unchanged.
declarations.statement:
theorem Equivalent.pullback {P : Quadruple f A d} {Q : Quadruple f A d'} (h : Equivalent P Q)
    (g : T' ⟶ T) : Equivalent (P.pullback g) (Q.pullback g)
declarations.comment: the pullback of a quadruple along a morphism of test schemes respects equivalence of quadruples of possibly different degrees

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd.pullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 01NS: the map `F_d(T) → F_d(T')` of a morphism `g : T' ⟶ T` of test
schemes**, at a fixed degree `d`. A point of `F_d(T)` over `f : T ⟶ S` is a quadruple of degree
`d` over `f` taken modulo strict equivalence; its image is the pullback of that quadruple, again
of degree `d`, over `g ≫ f`. This is well defined because the pullback respects strict
equivalence (`Quadruple.StrictlyEquivalent.pullback`), and no identification across degrees is
involved.
declarations.statement:
def Fd.pullback {A : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.{u, u} (structureRingSheaf S.toRingedSpace)}
    {d : ℤ} (g : T' ⟶ T) (ξ : Fd A d T) : Fd A d T'
declarations.comment: the map F_d(T) → F_d(T') of a morphism of test schemes at a fixed degree d, the pullback of a quadruple descended to the strict equivalence classes

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd.baseChangePullbackIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01NT: the canonical isomorphism `F'_d ≅ h_{S'} ×_{h_S} F_d`**, with the
right-hand side the categorical fibre product of the cospan `h_{S'} ⟶ h_S ⟵ F_d` in the functor
category. It is canonical: `Fd.baseChangePullbackIso_hom_fst` and `..._hom_snd` identify its
composites with the two projections as the projection of `F'_d` to the functor of points of `S'`
and the canonical map `F'_d ⟹ F_d`.
declarations.comment: the canonical isomorphism F'_d = h_{S'} x_{h_S} F_d of functors on Sch^opp read off at the categorical fibre product, with its compatibility with both projections (baseChangePullbackIso_hom_fst and _hom_snd), so that it is the canonical isomorphism and not merely some isomorphism. Stated for every integer d

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd.representableByDegreeOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01NU: the functor `F_d` of Section 01NS is represented by the open
`U_d ⊆ Proj Γ(S, 𝒜)` of Equation 27.12.0.1.** Let `S` be affine, `𝒜` a graded `𝒪_S`-algebra with
quasi-coherent homogeneous pieces (Situation 01NN) and `d ≥ 1`. The bijections
`...RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple.fdEquiv` of
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/RelativeProjQcohSheaf/AffineQuadrupleBijection.lean`, one for each
test scheme, form a natural isomorphism `Mor(−, U_d) ≅ F_d`: the naturality clause is
`Quadruple.classifyingHomOfClass_pullback`, transported across the bijection.

The hypotheses are exactly `IsAffine S`, the quasi-coherence of the homogeneous pieces, and
`0 < d`; the naturality statements the proof rests on are unconditional.
declarations.statement:
public def Fd.representableByDegreeOpen [IsAffine S] (hk : 0 < k)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℤ, ((situationAlgebra B).piece n).IsQuasicoherent) :
    (Fd.functor (situationAlgebra B) (k : ℤ)).RepresentableBy
      (degreeOpen (B.grading (⊤ : S.Opens)) k).toScheme
declarations.comment: THE TAG, for an AFFINE base: for S affine, A with quasi-coherent homogeneous pieces (Situation 01NN) and d >= 1, the functor F_d of strict equivalence classes of quadruples of Section 01NS is REPRESENTABLE by the open U_d of Equation 27.12.0.1 inside Proj Gamma(S, A) a CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy for Fd.functor, i.e. the bijections Quadruple.fdEquiv together with their naturality in the test scheme (Quadruple.classifyingHomOfClass_pullback, which rests on the unconditional veroneseSections_pullback).

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Fd.exists_representableBy_functor_of_pos
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01NV.** Let `S` be a scheme, `𝒜` a quasi-coherent graded
`𝒪_S`-algebra (Situation 01NN) and `d ≥ 1`. The functor `F_d` of Section 01NS is representable
by a scheme over `S`: there are a scheme `Y`, a morphism `p : Y ⟶ S` and a representation of
`F_d` by `Y` under which the morphism `T ⟶ Y` representing a class `ξ ∈ F_d(T)`, composed with
`p`, is the morphism `T ⟶ S` recorded by `ξ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Fd.exists_representableBy_functor_of_pos :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y ⟶ S)
      (e : (Fd.functor (situationAlgebra A) (k : ℤ)).RepresentableBy Y),
      ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (ξ : Fd (situationAlgebra A) (k : ℤ) T),
        e.homEquiv.symm ξ ≫ p = ξ.1
declarations.comment: THE TAG, UNCONDITIONALLY: for S a scheme, A a quasi-coherent graded O_S-algebra (Situation 01NN) and d = k with 0 < k, the functor F_d of Section 01NS is representable by a scheme over S. The conclusion is about Fd.functor, the genuine functor whose restriction maps are the pullback of a quadruple, and it records that the representing morphism composed with p : Y -> S is the class's own morphism to S.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Quadruple.tfae_compatibleAt_lcm
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01NW].** In Situation 01NN, let `T` be a scheme and let `(d, f, L, ψ)` and
`(d', f, L', ψ')` be two quadruples over `T` with `d` and `d'` positive, and write the least
common multiple `m` of `d` and `d'` as `m = a₀ d = a₀' d'`. Then the following three conditions
are equivalent:

1. the two quadruples are compatible at `(a₀, a₀')`, that is, there is an isomorphism
   `β : L^{⊗ a₀} ⟶ (L')^{⊗ a₀'}` for which `β ∘ ψ|_{f^*𝒜^{(m)}}` and `ψ'|_{f^*𝒜^{(m)}}` agree as
   graded ring maps;
2. the two quadruples are equivalent, that is, compatible at `(d', d)`;
3. the two quadruples are compatible at `(a, a')` for some positive common multiple
   `m = a d = a' d'` of their degrees.

The source's remaining clause `f = f'` is not a separate condition here: both quadruples are
taken over the same morphism `f : T ⟶ S`, which is a parameter of the type `Quadruple f 𝒜 d`,
so the two morphisms are equal by construction in all three conditions.

The five implications of the cycle are the five declarations above and in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Equivalence`:
`equivalent_of_lcm_compatible`, `exists_compatible_of_equivalent`,
`lcm_compatible_of_exists_compatible`, `lcm_compatible_of_equivalent` and
`equivalent_of_exists_compatible`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_compatibleAt_lcm (hd : 0 < d) (hd' : 0 < d') {a₀ a₀' : ℤ}
    (ha₀ : (Int.lcm d d' : ℤ) = a₀ * d) (ha₀' : (Int.lcm d d' : ℤ) = a₀' * d') :
    List.TFAE
      [CompatibleAt P Q a₀ a₀',
        Equivalent P Q,
        ∃ m a a' : ℤ, 0 < m ∧ m = a * d ∧ m = a' * d' ∧ CompatibleAt P Q a a']
declarations.comment: for two quadruples over the same morphism with positive degrees d and d', and the least common multiple m of d and d' written as m = a d = a' d', these three conditions are equivalent: compatibility at the cofactors (a, a') of the least common multiple; equivalence of the two quadruples, i.e. compatibility at (d', d); and compatibility at the cofactors of some positive common multiple of the two degrees

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.F.limFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, display 01NX, on all of `Sch`.** The functor sending a test scheme `T` to
the union `F(T) = ⋃_{d ≥ 1} F_d(T)` when `T` is quasi-compact, and to the inverse limit of those
unions over the quasi-compact opens of `T` in general.

It is the quasi-compact extension `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QcExtension.functor` of
`F.functor`, the union taken at every test scheme; `F.limEquiv` says the two agree on a
quasi-compact test scheme, and `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QcExtension.equivQcOpen` that the
extension is the limit over the quasi-compact opens the source writes.
declarations.statement:
def F.limFunctor (A : SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.{u, u} (structureRingSheaf S.toRingedSpace)) :
    Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (u + 1)
declarations.comment: the functor F of the display for EVERY test scheme, which closes the second qualification recorded on F.functor: the source defines F(T) as the union over d >= 1 of the F_d(T) only for a quasi- compact T and as the inverse limit of those over the quasi-compact opens of T in general, and that inverse limit, previously NOT CONSTRUCTED, is this functor. Both functor laws come from AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QcExtension.pullback_id and pullback_comp; F.limEquiv is the identification with the union on a quasi-compact test scheme, and AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QcExtension.equivQcOpen the identification of the index used here (all morphisms out of quasi-compact schemes, which makes the functoriality in T a reindexing) with the quasi-compact opens of T that the source indexes by. The FIRST qualification recorded on F.functor is DISCHARGED and is NOT inherited: the value of this functor on a quasi-compact test scheme is the source's F(T) itself, not a quotient of it. UnionRel IS an equivalence relation, being cofinal equality ...UnionEquivalenceRelation.unionRel_iff_cofinallyEqual and ...UnionEquivalenceRelation.unionRel_equivalence so two quadruples of positive degree have the same point of F(T) EXACTLY when they are equivalent (...UnionEquivalenceRelation.F.mk_eq_mk_iff_equivalent, and ...UnionEquivalenceRelation.F.mk_eq_mk_iff_strictlyEquivalent when the two degrees agree). The brick that had been missing was NOT the implication (3) => (1) of Tag 01NW, which was already proved as ...EquivalenceDescent.Quadruple.lcm_compatible_of_exists_compatible, but the converse of ...PowerTransitionColimit.Quadruple.strictlyEquivalent_scale_of_compatibleAt, namely ...UnionEquivalenceRelation.Quadruple.compatibleAt_of_strictlyEquivalent_scale; neither Tag 01NB nor Tag 01NU is used for it.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.F.isRepresentable_limFunctor
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01NY].** In Situation 01NN — a scheme `S` and a quasi-coherent graded
`𝒪_S`-algebra `𝒜` — the functor `F` of the display 01NX is representable by a scheme.

This is the tag's sentence itself, with no datum quantified over beyond `S` and `𝒜`: the
representing scheme is `Proj_S(𝒜)` of [Stacks, Tag 01NQ], and the representation is
`F.representableByRelativeProjOfCharts` at that scheme. The functor is `F.limFunctor`, the
display on *every* test scheme — the union over `d ≥ 1` of the `F_d` on a quasi-compact one and
the inverse limit of those over the quasi-compact opens in general — so the statement is about
the source's `F` and not about one `F_d`.

The sibling `F.representableByRelativeProjOfCharts` is the sharper form, naming the representing
scheme and allowing it to be an arbitrary relative homogeneous spectrum of `𝒜`; this is the bare
existential the tag states. Nothing is assumed beyond Situation 01NN, which `𝒜` carries.
declarations.statement:
theorem F.isRepresentable_limFunctor :
    (F.limFunctor (situationAlgebra A)).IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: the tag's sentence in one statement, with no datum beyond the scheme and the graded algebra: the functor F of the display 01NX is representable by a scheme, the representing scheme being the constructed relative homogeneous spectrum Proj_S(A)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.representableBy_and_existsUnique_isoOver
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01NZ].** In Situation 01NN, let `P` be any scheme over `S` carrying
projective-spectrum charts on the affine opens of `S` — for instance the scheme representing the
functor `F`, which is such a datum by the source's *"over each affine open of `S` we can identify
`X` with the homogeneous spectrum of the sections of `𝒜` over that open"*. Then

1. the relative homogeneous spectrum `π : Proj_S(𝒜) → S` of [Stacks, Tag 01NQ] represents `F`,
   and
2. there is exactly one isomorphism `Proj_S(𝒜) ≅ P` compatible with the charts, and it is an
   isomorphism over `S`.

Together these say that `Proj_S(𝒜)` and the scheme representing `F` are canonically isomorphic
as schemes over `S`, which is the source's statement: the first assertion identifies `Proj_S(𝒜)`
as a representing object and the second produces the canonical comparison with any other
chart-carrying scheme over `S`, uniquely.

The first assertion is a representation, hence data rather than a proposition, so the two are
packaged by `PProd` rather than `And`. The chart datum `P` is the only binder beyond Situation
01NN, and it is data the statement needs in order to speak of the second scheme at all; it is not
a hypothesis of the source, since `relativeProj A` is itself a `RelativeProjData A` and so is
every projective bundle of `...SheafSymmetricAlgebra`.

The two assertions are `relativeProjRepresentableByFunctorUnconditional` of this file and
`...RelativeProjQcohSheaf.existsUnique_isoOver` of
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.GluedRepresents`.
declarations.statement:
def representableBy_and_existsUnique_isoOver (P : RelativeProjData A) :
    PProd ((F.limFunctor (situationAlgebra A)).RepresentableBy (relativeProj A).scheme)
      (∃! e : (relativeProj A).scheme ≅ P.scheme,
        (∀ U : S.affineOpens, (relativeProj A).chart U.1 U.2 ≫ e.hom = P.chart U.1 U.2) ∧
          e.hom ≫ P.toBase = (relativeProj A).toBase)
declarations.comment: for a scheme S and a quasi-coherent graded O_S-algebra A (Situation 01NN) and any scheme over S carrying projective-spectrum charts on the affine opens of S, the constructed relative homogeneous spectrum Proj_S(A) represents the functor F.limFunctor of the display 01NX, and there is exactly one isomorphism from Proj_S(A) to that scheme compatible with the charts, which is an isomorphism over S

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.relativeHomogeneousSpectrum
declarations.doc:
The relative homogeneous spectrum `Proj_S(A)`, or relative Proj, of a quasi-coherent sheaf
of graded `𝒪_S`-algebras `A` over a scheme `S`: the scheme glued from the projective spectra of
the graded rings of sections of `A` over the affine opens of `S`.
declarations.statement: public def relativeHomogeneousSpectrum : Scheme.{u}
declarations.comment: the scheme Proj_S(A) itself. The tag NAMES the scheme constructed in Lemma 01NQ, which in this repository is the field `scheme` of `Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.relativeProj`, a construction (a colimit over the small affine Zariski site of S) and not a choice; the structure morphism pi the tag's last sentence names is `relativeHomogeneousSpectrumToBase`, which carries this tag too. NOT re-asserted here: the tag's reference to the functor F of the display 01NX and to Lemma 01NZ, namely that this scheme REPRESENTS F. The functor F is not constructed in this repository; that representability is carried, with the source's inputs to it, in `...RelativeProjQcohSheaf.RepresentingProjData` and proved there as `...RepresentingProjData.relativeProjRepresentableBy`

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.relativeHomogeneousSpectrumToBase
declarations.doc: The structure morphism `π : Proj_S(A) → S` of the relative homogeneous spectrum.
declarations.statement:
public def relativeHomogeneousSpectrumToBase :
    relativeHomogeneousSpectrum A ⟶ S
declarations.comment: ONLY the structure morphism pi : Proj_S(A) → S of the tag's last sentence; the scheme itself is `relativeHomogeneousSpectrum`, whose clause string describes the covering set and what the tag's reference to 01NX/01NZ is and where it lives

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjTwistChartBridge.tag01O1
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O1.** In Situation 01NN — `S` a scheme and `𝒜` a quasi-coherent
graded `𝒪_S`-algebra — let `(f : T → S, d, ℒ, ψ)` be a quadruple of Section 01NS, so `d ≥ 1`, and
let `r = r_{d, ℒ, ψ} : T → Proj_S(𝒜)` be the associated morphism
(`...RelativeProjTwistChartBridge.thetaMorphism`: the morphism into `U_d` that the class of the
quadruple defines, followed by `U_d ⊆ Proj_S(𝒜)`). Write `𝒪(n)` for the twists of `Proj_S(𝒜)`
with their homogeneous-section map `ψ_univ` (`...GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra`).
Then

1. `r` is the morphism the representability of `F` attaches to the quadruple: the image of its
   class in `F(T)` under the representation
   `...RelativeProjQcohSheaf.relativeProjRepresentableByFunctorUnconditional` of the functor `F`
   of the display 01NX by `Proj_S(𝒜)`, which is the representation of [Stacks, Tag 01NZ];
2. `r` is a morphism over `S`;
3. there is an isomorphism of sheaves of `ℤ`-graded `𝒪_T`-algebras
   `θ : r^*(⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} 𝒪(nd)) ≅ ⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} ℒ^{⊗ n}`, which preserves the unit;
4. the triangle commutes: `ψ = θ ∘ ψ_univ` in every degree, the maps out of
   `𝒜^{(d)}` being read through the adjunction `f^* ⊣ f_*`, so that `ψ_univ` becomes
   `...RelativeProjTwists.TwistData.psiLegVeronese`; and
5. the triangle determines `θ`: any homomorphism of graded algebras
   `r^*(⨁_n 𝒪(nd)) ⟶ ⨁_n ℒ^{⊗ n}` making it commute is `θ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tag01O1 (hd : 0 < d) (P : Quadruple f (situationAlgebra A) (d : ℤ)) :
    thetaMorphism hd P =
        (relativeProjRepresentableByFunctorUnconditional A).homEquiv.symm
          (RelativeProjInvertibleMorphism.F.toLim A (F.mk f (by exact_mod_cast hd) P)) ∧
    thetaMorphism hd P ≫ (relativeProj A).toBase = f ∧
      ∃ θ : pullbackTwistVeronese (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A) (d : ℤ)
          (thetaMorphism hd P) ≅ laurent P.L,
        SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.oneHom
              (pullbackTwistVeronese (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A) (d : ℤ)
                (thetaMorphism hd P)) ≫ θ.hom.app 0 =
            SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.oneHom (laurent P.L) ∧
          (∀ n : ℤ, (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).psiLegVeronese
              (thetaMorphism hd P) (thetaMorphism_comp_toBase hd P) (d : ℤ) n ≫ θ.hom.app n =
                P.twisting.app n) ∧
          ∀ Θ : pullbackTwistVeronese (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A) (d : ℤ)
              (thetaMorphism hd P) ⟶ laurent P.L,
            (∀ n : ℤ, (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).psiLegVeronese
              (thetaMorphism hd P) (thetaMorphism_comp_toBase hd P) (d : ℤ) n ≫ Θ.app n =
                P.twisting.app n) → Θ = θ.hom
declarations.comment: for a quadruple (f : T -> S, d, L, psi) with associated morphism r : T -> Proj_S(A), the morphism the representation of F by Proj_S(A) attaches to the class of the quadruple: r lies over S, and there is an isomorphism theta of Z-graded O_T-algebras from r^*((+)_n O(nd)) to (+)_n L^(x)n, preserving the unit, with psi = theta o psi_univ in every degree, and every homomorphism of graded algebras with psi = Theta o psi_univ is theta

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Data.isSeparated_toBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O2.** The structure morphism of a relative `Proj` is separated.

Separatedness is local on the target, so it suffices to check it over the affine opens of the
base; over an affine open `U` the preimage is the chart `Proj (𝒜 U)`, a separated scheme, and a
morphism out of a separated scheme is separated.
declarations.statement: instance isSeparated_toBase (d : Data 𝒜) : IsSeparated d.toBase

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.isSeparated_relativeProjToBase
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O2.** The structure morphism of the relative `Proj` of a
quasi-coherent, commutative, nonnegatively graded algebra on a scheme is separated.

Separatedness is local at the target, and over an affine open `W` of the base the restriction of
`relativeProjToBase` is the chart structure morphism `Proj Γ(W, 𝒜) ⟶ W`, because both are
pullbacks of `relativeProjToBase` along `W.ι`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem _root_.Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.isSeparated_relativeProjToBase
    (s : Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.{u}) :
    IsSeparated (Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProjToBase s)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjBaseChangeTwist.relativeProj_baseChange_twist
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O3.** Let `S` be a scheme, `A` a quasi-coherent sheaf of graded
`𝒪_S`-algebras and `g : S' → S` a morphism of schemes. The canonical isomorphism
`r : Proj_{S'}(g^*A) ≅ S' ×_S Proj_S(A)` (`baseChangeIso`) lies over `S'` and has second
component the base change `Proj_{S'}(g^*A) → Proj_S(A)`, and `θ` (`baseChangeTheta`) is an
isomorphism of `ℤ`-graded algebras
`r^* pr₂^* (⨁_d 𝒪_{Proj_S(A)}(d)) ≅ ⨁_d 𝒪_{Proj_{S'}(g^*A)}(d)`, which preserves the unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeProj_baseChange_twist :
    (baseChangeIso A g).hom ≫
          pullback.fst g (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.relativeProj A).toBase =
        (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.relativeProj (A.pullback g)).toBase ∧
      (baseChangeIso A g).hom ≫
          pullback.snd g (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.relativeProj A).toBase =
        baseChangeHom A g ∧
      ∀ U, ((baseChangeTheta A g).hom.app 0).val.app U
          ((pbAlgS (baseChangeIso A g).hom
            (Stacks.RingedSpace.pullbackGradedAlgebra
              (pullback.snd g
                (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProj.relativeProj A).toBase).toLRSHom.toShHom
              (twistAlgebra A))).one.eval U) =
        (twistAlgebra (A.pullback g)).one.eval U
declarations.comment: the canonical isomorphism r : Proj_S'(g^*A) -> S' x_S Proj_S(A) over S', and the isomorphism theta : r^* pr_2^* ((+)_d O(d)) -> (+)_d O_{Proj_S'(g^*A)}(d) of Z-graded algebras, preserving the unit

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.twistSheafPullbackIso
declarations.doc:
**The twist assertion of [Stacks, Tag 01O3].** For a morphism `g : S' ⟶ S`, relative `Proj`
situations `s` over `S` and `s'` over `S'`, and an identification `Φ` of the graded algebra of
`s'` with the pullback along `g` of that of `s`, degreewise invertible, the base-change morphism
`r : Proj_{S'}(g^*𝒜) ⟶ Proj_S(𝒜)` carries the `n`-th twisting sheaf to the `n`-th twisting sheaf:

`θ n : r^* 𝒪_{Proj_S(𝒜)}(n) ≅ 𝒪_{Proj_{S'}(g^*𝒜)}(n)`,

for every `n : ℤ` and with no hypothesis beyond the two situations and the datum `Φ`.

The scheme half of the tag — the isomorphism `r` itself, and the cartesian square — is
`Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProjBaseChangeIso` and
`isPullback_relativeProjBaseChange`.

Multiplicativity of `θ` is not proved: this is the degreewise isomorphism, exactly as clause (3)
of Tag 01N2 is carried by `Stacks.ProjBaseChange.isIso_twistMap_includeRight` with the same
restriction.
declarations.comment: the graded isomorphism θ on the twisting sheaves, in each degree separately, as clause (3) of Tag 01N2 is carried with the same reading

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TwistMapsInvertible.f1Bundle_and_twists
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01O4].** Let `S` be a scheme and `𝒜` a quasi-coherent sheaf of graded
`𝒪_S`-modules generated as an `𝒜_0`-algebra by `𝒜_1`. Then, for `X = Proj_S(𝒜)`:

1. `X` represents the functor `F_1` of pairs `(L, ψ)` with `L` invertible and `f^*𝒜_1 ⟶ L`
   surjective, up to strict equivalence — the bijections between the morphisms `T ⟶ X` over `S`
   and the strict isomorphism classes of such pairs, normalised at the identity of `X` and
   natural in the test scheme;
2. every homogeneous piece `𝒪_X(n)` of the canonical twist datum on `X` is an invertible
   `𝒪_X`-module; and
3. the multiplication maps `𝒪_X(n) ⊗ 𝒪_X(m) ⟶ 𝒪_X(n + m)` are isomorphisms in all integer
   degrees.

The first assertion is a family of bijections, hence data rather than a proposition, so it is
joined to the other two by `PProd` rather than `And`.

The hypothesis `hgen` is the source's own degree-one generation. The binder `TA` is the choice of
tensor algebras, which is data the library needs in order to state the first assertion at all,
and the comparison of its pullbacks is the canonical `tensorAlgebraPullbackIsos`. The twists are
the canonical twist datum `twistDataOfGradedAlgebra`, constructed from `𝒜` alone.

The three assertions are `...ProjRepresentsF1.f1Bundle`,
`twistDataOfGradedAlgebra_isInvertible` and `isIso_mulSheaf_twistDataOfGradedAlgebra`.
declarations.statement:
def f1Bundle_and_twists {S : Scheme.{u}} (A : SheafGradedAlgebra.{u} S) (TA : TensorAlgebras.{u})
    (hgen : IsGeneratedInDegreeOne A) :
    PProd (F1Bundle A TA (tensorAlgebraPullbackIsos TA))
      ((∀ n : ℤ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible (relativeProj A).scheme.presheaf
            (relativeProj A).scheme.ringCatSheaf.2
            ((twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).algebra.piece n)) ∧
        ∀ n m : ℤ, IsIso (_root_.SheafOfModules.GradedAlgebra.mulSheaf
          (twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).algebra n m))
declarations.comment: for a scheme S and a quasi-coherent sheaf of graded O_S-modules A generated as an A_0-algebra by A_1, three things hold of X = Proj_S(A): X represents the functor F_1 sending f : T -> S to the strict isomorphism classes of pairs (L, psi) with L an invertible O_T-module and psi : f^*A -> ⨁_{n >= 0} L^{⊗ n} a graded algebra homomorphism whose degree-one component f^*A_1 -> L is surjective, by bijections normalised at the identity of X and natural in the test scheme; every homogeneous piece O_X(n) of the canonical twist datum on X is an invertible O_X-module; and the multiplication maps O_X(n) (x) O_X(m) -> O_X(n+m) are isomorphisms in all integer degrees

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQcohSheaf.Twisting.associatedSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O6, equation (27.17.0.1).** The `𝒪_T`-module

`ℳ̃_T = (f^*ℳ^{(d)} ⊗_{f^*𝒜^{(d)}} (⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} L^{⊗ n}))₀`

attached to a graded `𝒜`-module `ℳ` and a quadruple `(d, f : T → S, L, ψ)`: the degree-zero
part of the tensor product, over the pullback of the `d`-th Veronese regrading of `𝒜`, of the
pullback of the `d`-th Veronese regrading of `ℳ` with the Laurent algebra of `L`. It is the
quotient of `⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} f^*ℳ_{nd} ⊗ L^{⊗ (-n)}` by the balancing relations
`(x · a) ⊗ l = x ⊗ (ψ(a) · l)`.
declarations.statement: def associatedSheaf : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureRingSheaf T.toRingedSpace)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.tensorModuleSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map `ℳ̃ ⊗_𝒪 𝒩̃ ⟶ (ℳ ⊗_𝒜 𝒩)~` of property (6) of Tag 01O7**, for two left
graded modules with quasi-coherent homogeneous pieces over the graded algebra of a relative `Proj`
situation. It is glued from the chart members
`Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafTensorChartMap`, to each of which it restricts, and it
is the only morphism that does so.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def tensorModuleSheafMap :
    (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor
        ⟨(((relativeProj s).toRingedSpace)).presheaf,
          (((relativeProj s).toRingedSpace)).IsSheaf⟩).obj ((moduleSheaf ℳ))).obj
        ((moduleSheaf 𝒩))) ⟶ s.tensorModuleSheaf ℳ 𝒩
declarations.comment:
property (6): the canonical map from the tensor product of the sheaves attached to
two left graded modules with quasi-coherent homogeneous pieces to the sheaf attached to the
tensor product of those modules, on a relative projective spectrum

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQuadrupleTilde.tag01O7_property1
declarations.statement:
theorem tag01O7_property1 :
    letI := P.isInvertible
    (∀ t : T, ∃ V : T.Opens, t ∈ V ∧ Nonempty (ChartDatum (V.ι ≫ f) (P.twisting.pullback V.ι)
      (V.ι ≫ classifyingHom s (by exact_mod_cast hd) P))) ∧
    (∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Z ⟶ T) (D : ChartDatum (a ≫ f) (P.twisting.pullback a)
        (a ≫ classifyingHom s (by exact_mod_cast hd) P)),
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback a).map (Quadruple.tildeComparison ℳ hd P).hom =
        localHom ℳ hd a D) ∧
    (∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (a : Z ⟶ T) (D : ChartDatum (a ≫ f) (P.twisting.pullback a)
        (a ≫ classifyingHom s (by exact_mod_cast hd) P)) (n : ℤ),
      Twisting.pureTensor (ℳ.toGradedModule s.mul_comm) (P.twisting.pullback a) n ≫
          (D.iso ℳ hd).hom =
        bmap ℳ D.U D.c (a ≫ f) D.hf D.g D.hg D.hgf D.w n ≫
          (moduleSheafPullbackChartIso ℳ D.U D.g D.fac).inv) ∧
    (∀ Φ : Twisting.associatedSheaf (ℳ.toGradedModule s.mul_comm) P.twisting ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback (classifyingHom s (by exact_mod_cast hd) P)).obj (moduleSheaf ℳ),
      (∀ (V : T.Opens) (D : ChartDatum (V.ι ≫ f) (P.twisting.pullback V.ι)
          (V.ι ≫ classifyingHom s (by exact_mod_cast hd) P)),
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).map Φ.hom = localHom ℳ hd V.ι D) →
        Φ = Quadruple.tildeComparison ℳ hd P)
declarations.comment: property (1): the canonical isomorphism M~_T ≅ h^*M~

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjQuadrupleTilde.Quadruple.tildeComparison_pullback
declarations.doc:
**Property (2) of [Stacks, Tag 01O7]: the isomorphisms of property (1) are compatible with
pullbacks.** For a quadruple `P = (f : T → S, d, L, ψ)` classifying `h : T ⟶ Proj_S(𝒜)` and a
morphism `g : T' ⟶ T`, the pulled-back quadruple `P.pullback g` classifies `g ≫ h`, and its
isomorphism `ℳ̃_{T'} ≅ (g ≫ h)^*ℳ̃` of property (1) is the pullback along `g` of the isomorphism
`ℳ̃_T ≅ h^*ℳ̃` of `P`, read through the canonical comparisons `ℳ̃_{T'} ≅ g^*ℳ̃_T` and
`g^*h^*ℳ̃ ≅ (g ≫ h)^*ℳ̃`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Quadruple.tildeComparison_pullback {T : Scheme.{u}} {f : T ⟶ s.base}
    (P : Quadruple f s.algebra (d : ℤ)) {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ T) :
    letI := P.isInvertible
    (Quadruple.tildeComparison ℳ hd (P.pullback g)).hom =
      (Quadruple.associatedSheafPullbackIso (M := ℳ.toGradedModule s.mul_comm) (P := P)
          (g := g)).inv ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (Quadruple.tildeComparison ℳ hd P).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g (classifyingHom s (by exact_mod_cast hd) P)).hom.app
            (moduleSheaf ℳ) ≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
              (classifyingHom_pullback s (by exact_mod_cast hd) P g).symm).hom.app
                (moduleSheaf ℳ)
declarations.comment:
property (2): the isomorphisms of property (1) are compatible with pullback along
every morphism of test schemes

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafPullbackIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O7, property (8).** **The formation of `ℳ̃` commutes with base
change.** For a morphism of schemes `g : S' ⟶ S`, put `𝒜' = g^* 𝒜` and `ℳ' = g^* ℳ`, and let
`r : Proj_{S'}(𝒜') ⟶ Proj_S(𝒜)` be the induced morphism of relative projective spectra. Then the
canonical comparison `r^* ℳ̃ ⟶ ℳ̃'` is an isomorphism.

The comparison is `Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafBaseChangeHom`, the unique morphism
restricting on the chart of `Proj_{S'}(𝒜')` over each pair `W' ⊆ g⁻¹W` of affine opens to the
comparison of the sheaves of Tag 01M6 across the base change of the graded section rings
(`Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.restrictFunctor_map_moduleSheafBaseChangeHom`); it is invertible by
`Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.isIso_moduleSheafBaseChangeHom`.
declarations.comment:
property (8): the canonical isomorphism r^* ℳ̃ ≅ (g^* ℳ)~ on the relative
projective spectrum of g^* 𝒜, for any morphism of schemes g : S' ⟶ S

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafFibreProductIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O7, property (8), on the fibre product.** For a morphism of schemes
`g : S' ⟶ S`, the pullback of `ℳ̃` along the projection `S' ×_S Proj_S(𝒜) ⟶ Proj_S(𝒜)` is
canonically isomorphic to the sheaf `(g^* ℳ)~`, transported to the fibre product along the
canonical identification `e : Proj_{S'}(g^* 𝒜) ≅ S' ×_S Proj_S(𝒜)` of
`Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.relativeProjBaseChangeIso`.

It is `Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafPullbackIso` read through `e`: the projection is
`e⁻¹` followed by the base-change morphism `r`, so its inverse image is `e⁻¹`'s of `r^* ℳ̃`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def moduleSheafFibreProductIso :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (Limits.pullback.fst (relativeProjToBase s) g)).obj (moduleSheaf ℳ) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullbackRelativeProjIso s g).inv).obj
        (moduleSheaf (s := s.pullback g) (Stacks.Conormal.leftGradedPullback g ℳ))
declarations.comment:
property (8) on the fibre product: the canonical isomorphism between the pullback
of ℳ̃ along S' ×_S Proj_S(𝒜) ⟶ Proj_S(𝒜) and (g^* ℳ)~ carried to S' ×_S Proj_S(𝒜)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.degreeZeroSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O7, property (3).** The canonical map

`π^*ℳ_0 ⟶ ℳ̃`

on the relative projective spectrum `π : Proj_S(𝒜) ⟶ S`, for a graded `𝒜`-module `ℳ` with
quasi-coherent homogeneous pieces. It is the transpose, across the adjunction `π^* ⊣ π_*`, of
`Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.degreeZeroPushforwardHom`, the morphism `ℳ_0 ⟶ π_* ℳ̃` which on
the sections over an affine open `W` of the base carries `m` to the section `m / 1` of `ℳ̃` over
`π⁻¹(W)`: under the identification of `ℳ̃` over `π⁻¹(W)` with the sheaf of the graded module of
sections of `ℳ` over `W` on `Proj 𝒜(W)`, this is the global section `m / 1` of Tag 01M7.
declarations.statement:
public def degreeZeroSheafMap :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relativeProjToBase s)).obj (ℳ.piece 0) ⟶ moduleSheaf ℳ
declarations.comment:
property (3): the canonical map from the pullback of the degree-zero part of a
graded module to its associated sheaf on the relative projective spectrum

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafFunctor_exact
declarations.doc:
The functor `Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafFunctor`, from the abelian category of
quasi-coherent graded modules over the graded algebra `𝒜` of the situation to the modules on the
relative projective spectrum `Proj_S(𝒜)`, is additive, preserves finite limits and preserves
finite colimits; equivalently, it carries short exact sequences of quasi-coherent graded modules
to short exact sequences of modules on `Proj_S(𝒜)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem moduleSheafFunctor_exact :
    (moduleSheafFunctor s).Additive ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits (moduleSheafFunctor s) ∧
      PreservesFiniteColimits (moduleSheafFunctor s) ∧
      ∀ S : ShortComplex (QcohGradedModule s), S.ShortExact →
        (S.map (moduleSheafFunctor s)).ShortExact
declarations.comment:
property (5): the construction ℳ ↦ ℳ̃ is an exact functor from the abelian
category of quasi-coherent graded modules over 𝒜 to modules on the relative projective spectrum

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafFunctor
declarations.doc:
The construction `ℳ ↦ ℳ̃` is functorial in `ℳ`: it is a functor from the quasi-coherent
graded modules over the graded algebra `𝒜` to the modules over the relative projective spectrum
`Proj_S(𝒜)`, sending `ℳ` to the sheaf `Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheaf ℳ` and a
homomorphism to the glued morphism `Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.moduleSheafMap` of the chart
morphisms.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable def moduleSheafFunctor : QcohGradedModule s ⥤ (relativeProj s).Modules
declarations.comment:
property (4): the construction ℳ ↦ ℳ̃ is a functor from quasi-coherent graded
modules over 𝒜 to modules on the relative projective spectrum

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.shiftedSumSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01O7, property (7).** The canonical map

`π^*ℳ ⟶ ⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} (ℳ(n))~`

on the relative projective spectrum `π : Proj_S(𝒜) ⟶ S`, out of the pullback of the
`𝒪_S`-module `ℳ = ⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} ℳ_n` underlying a graded `𝒜`-module with quasi-coherent homogeneous
pieces. On the summand `π^*ℳ_n` it is the degree-`n` component
`Stacks.RelativeProj.Situation.shiftedDegreeSheafMap`, the canonical map of property (3) for the
shift `ℳ(n)`, followed by the inclusion of the `n`-th summand; on the sections over an affine
open of the base it is the map of Tag 01MR, `m ↦ m / 1` in degree `n`.
declarations.comment:
property (7): the canonical map from the pullback of a graded module to the direct
sum of the sheaves associated to its shifts on the relative projective spectrum

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjInvertibleMorphism.GradedPowerMap.value_mul
declarations.doc:
`ψ` is multiplicative across degrees on values: `ψ(a · b) = ψ(a) · ψ(b)` in
`Γ(f^{-1}(V), ℒ^{⊗ (n + m)})`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem value_mul (n m : ℕ) (V : S.Opens) (a : Γ(A.piece (n : ℤ), V))
    (b : Γ(A.piece (m : ℤ), V)) :
    P.value (n + m) V ((A.mul (n : ℤ) (m : ℤ)).app V a b)
      = Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.NatTensorPowLocalMul.localMulSections P.L
          (P.value n V a) (P.value m V b)
declarations.comment: item (6): the components of psi are multiplicative across degrees, the value at a product of homogeneous sections over an open of the base being the product of the values in the tensor powers of L over the preimage of that open

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjInvertibleMorphism.GradedPowerMap.coveringOpen
declarations.doc:
The open `U(ψ) = ⋃_{(U, V, a)} U_{ψ(a)}`: the union of the opens on which the values of `ψ`
at the homogeneous sections of positive degree over the affine opens of the base do not
vanish.
declarations.statement: public def coveringOpen : T.Opens
declarations.comment: the open U(psi) = union over triples (U, V, a) -- V affine open of the base, U = f^{-1}(V), a a homogeneous section of positive degree of A over V -- of the open U_{psi(a)} on which the section psi(a) of L^{tensor deg(a)} over U does not vanish

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeProjInvertibleMorphism.tag01O9
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01O9].** For `ψ : f^*𝒜 ⟶ ⨁_{d} ℒ^{⊗ d}` with `ℒ` invertible, put
`P = toGradedPowerMap ψ`, `U(ψ) = P.coveringOpen`, `r = P.globalMorphism (relativeProj A)` and
`θ = P.theta`. Then:

1. `r` is a morphism over `S`: `r ≫ π = (U(ψ) ⊆ X) ≫ f`;
2. `θ` preserves the unit, and its components in degrees `d, e ≥ 0` are multiplicative, so that
   they form a map of graded algebras `r^*(⨁_{d ≥ 0} 𝒪(d)) ⟶ ⨁_{d ≥ 0} ℒ^{⊗ d}|_{U(ψ)}`;
3. **property (1)**: for every open `V ⊆ S`, `d ≥ 0` and `a ∈ 𝒜_d(V)`, `θ` carries the pullback
   along `r` of the section `ψ(a)` of `𝒪(d)` over `π^{-1}(V)` to `ψ(a)` restricted to
   `f^{-1}(V) ∩ U(ψ) = r^{-1}(π^{-1}(V))`;
4. **property (2)**: for every `d ≥ 1` and every open `W ⊆ X` on which
   `ψ_d : f^*𝒜_d|_W ⟶ ℒ^{⊗ d}|_W` is surjective, `W ⊆ U(ψ)` and `r|_W` is the morphism
   `W ⟶ Proj_S(𝒜)` which the representation of the functor of quadruples by `Proj_S(𝒜)` attaches
   to `(d, f|_W, ℒ^{⊗ d}|_W, ψ|_W)`;
5. **property (3)**, for the open and the morphism: for every affine open `V ⊆ S`, with
   `ψ' : 𝒜(V) ⟶ Γ_*(f^{-1}(V), ℒ)` the induced map, `U(ψ') = U(ψ) ∩ f^{-1}(V)` and `r`
   restricted along `U(ψ') ⟶ U(ψ)` is `i_V ∘ r_{ℒ, ψ'}`; and any morphism `U(ψ) ⟶ Proj_S(𝒜)` with
   that restriction property over every affine `V` is `r`;
6. the triple `(U(ψ), r, θ)` (with `θ` in degrees `d ≥ 0`) is `Triple.canonical P`, and it has
   properties (1), (2) and (3), property (3) including that `θ` restricted along
   `U(ψ') ⟶ U(ψ)` is the `θ'` of the induced map, read through `i_V`;
7. **the characterization**: every triple `(U', r', θ')` with properties (1), (2) and (3) is
   `(U(ψ), r, θ)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem tag01O9 :
    (toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A) ≫ (relativeProj A).toBase
        = (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι ≫ f
      ∧ SheafOfModules.sectionsMap (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta).app 0)
          (Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A))
            (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).algebra).one
        = (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartGradedTriple.laurentOn L
            (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).one
      ∧ (∀ (d e : ℕ) (U : (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.toScheme.Opens)
          (x : ((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
            ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A))
            (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).algebra).piece (d : ℤ)).val.obj (op U))
          (y : ((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
            ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A))
            (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).algebra).piece (e : ℤ)).val.obj (op U)),
          (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app ((d : ℤ) + (e : ℤ))).val.app (op U)
              (((Stacks.Conormal.gradedPullback
                ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A))
                (GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).algebra).mul d e).app (op U) x y))
            = ((Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjChartGradedTriple.laurentOn L
                (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen).mul d e).app (op U)
                (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app d).val.app (op U) x)
                (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app e).val.app (op U) y))
      ∧ (∀ (V : S.Opens) (d : ℕ) (a : Γ(A.piece (d : ℤ), V)),
          ((tensorPowerModule X L (d : ℤ)).restrict
            (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι).presheaf.map
              (eqToHom ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).toBase_preimage_eq V)).op
              (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta.app d).val.app
                (op ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A) ⁻¹ᵁ
                  ((relativeProj A).toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V)))
                (Stacks.RingedSpace.pullbackUnit
                  ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A)).toLRSHom.toShHom
                  ((GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).algebra.piece (d : ℤ))
                  (op ((relativeProj A).toBase ⁻¹ᵁ V))
                  (((GluedTwistAlgebra.twistDataOfGradedAlgebra A).ψ d).app V a)))
            = (tensorPowerModule X L (d : ℤ)).presheaf.map
                (homOfLE ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι.image_preimage_le (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).op
                ((Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentMulSections.powCompare L d).hom.app (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
                  (valueSec ψ d V a)))
      ∧ (∀ {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (W : X.Opens) [Epi ((ψ.pullback W.ι).app (k : ℤ))],
          ∃ h : W ≤ (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen,
            X.homOfLE h ≫ (toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A)
              = F.classifyingMorphism A (F.mk (W.ι ≫ f) (by exact_mod_cast hk)
                  (restrictQuadruple ψ W k)))
      ∧ (∀ V : S.affineOpens,
          (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι ''ᵁ ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).affineDatum V.1).coveringOpen
              = (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1
            ∧ ∀ j : (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).affineDatum V.1).coveringOpen).toScheme ⟶
                (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.toScheme,
              j ≫ (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι
                  = (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).affineDatum V.1).coveringOpen).ι ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι →
                j ≫ (toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A)
                  = ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).affineDatum V.1).glued ≫ (relativeProj A).chart V.1 V.2)
      ∧ (∀ R : (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.toScheme ⟶ (relativeProj A).scheme,
          (∀ V : S.affineOpens,
            ∀ j : (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).affineDatum V.1).coveringOpen).toScheme ⟶
                (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.toScheme,
              j ≫ (toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen.ι
                  = (((toGradedPowerMap ψ).affineDatum V.1).coveringOpen).ι ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι →
                j ≫ R = ((toGradedPowerMap ψ).affineDatum V.1).glued
                  ≫ (relativeProj A).chart V.1 V.2) →
          R = (toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A))
      ∧ Triple.canonical (toGradedPowerMap ψ)
          = ⟨(toGradedPowerMap ψ).coveringOpen,
              (toGradedPowerMap ψ).globalMorphism (relativeProj A),
              GradedNonnegHom.ofHom (toGradedPowerMap ψ).theta⟩
      ∧ Triple.IsTriple ψ (Triple.canonical (toGradedPowerMap ψ))
      ∧ (∀ t : Triple A L, Triple.IsTriple ψ t → t = Triple.canonical (toGradedPowerMap ψ))
declarations.comment: the open U(psi), the morphism r_{L,psi} : U(psi) -> Proj_S(A) over S and the unital map of graded algebras theta : r^*(sum_d O(d)) -> sum_d L^d|_{U(psi)}; properties (1), (2) and (3) for them; and every triple (U', r', theta') with properties (1), (2) and (3) is (U(psi), r_{L,psi}, theta)

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveBundle.Noninjective.isSymmetricAlgebra_toQuotientAlgebra
declarations.doc:
**`Sym(M) = A[x, y] / (ū x + v̄ y)`.** This is the displayed identity of Stacks 01OC that
makes the example concrete: `M` is `A x ⊕ A y` modulo the single relation `ū x + v̄ y`, so its
symmetric algebra is the polynomial ring `A[x, y]` modulo the ideal generated by that same
linear form, which `symmetricAlgebra_relationForm_eq` identifies.

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveBundle.Noninjective.iSup_basicOpen_symGen_eq_top
declarations.doc:
**`P = D₊(x) ∪ D₊(y)`**: the two standard opens of the degree-one generators cover the
projective bundle. This is the affine open covering Stacks 01OC records.
declarations.comment: the two-chart affine open covering of the projective bundle

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveBundle.Noninjective.basicOpen_symGen_sup_eq_top
declarations.doc: `P = D₊(x) ∪ D₊(y)`, written as a binary union.
declarations.statement:
public theorem basicOpen_symGen_sup_eq_top :
    Proj.basicOpen (SymmetricAlgebra.grading (coefficientRing R) (presentedModule R))
        (symGen R 0) ⊔
      Proj.basicOpen (SymmetricAlgebra.grading (coefficientRing R) (presentedModule R))
        (symGen R 1) = ⊤
declarations.comment: the two-chart affine open covering of the projective bundle

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveBundle.Noninjective.not_injective_toTwistSections
declarations.doc:
**The map `M = Sym¹(ℰ) → Γ(P, 𝒪_P(1))` is not injective.** This is the conclusion of
Stacks 01OC: `m` is a nonzero global section of `ℰ` whose image in `Γ(P, 𝒪_P(1))` is zero, so
the canonical map `Sym¹(ℰ) → π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(ℰ)}(1)` of Stacks 01OB is not injective, and in
particular not an isomorphism.
declarations.comment: the map from the first symmetric power is not injective

declarations.statement: public theorem counterexampleSection_ne_zero : counterexampleSection R ≠ 0

declarations.name: Stacks.SymGraded.isSeparated_projectiveBundleToBase
declarations.doc:
**The structure morphism of the projective bundle of a quasi-coherent module on an arbitrary
scheme is separated.**

This is `Stacks.SymGraded.isSeparated_schemeProjectiveBundleToBase` with its quasi-coherence
hypothesis discharged, and it is the single assertion of Tag 01OD.

declarations.name: Stacks.SymGraded.projectiveBundleIsoProjectiveSpace
declarations.doc:
**`ℙⁿ_X` is a projective bundle over `X`**: the projective bundle of the free module sheaf
`𝒪_X^{n+1}` — that is `Proj_X(Sym(𝒪_X^{n+1}))` — is projective `n`-space over `X`.

This is the isomorphism; `Stacks.SymGraded.projectiveBundleIsoProjectiveSpace_hom_comp_fst` is
the other half of the statement, that it is an isomorphism **over `X`**.

declarations.name: Stacks.SymGraded.projectiveBundleIsoProjectiveSpace_hom_comp_fst
declarations.doc:
**The isomorphism of Tag 01OE is an isomorphism over `X`**: it carries the structure morphism
of `ℙⁿ_X` to the projection of the bundle. Together with
`Stacks.SymGraded.projectiveBundleIsoProjectiveSpace` this is the whole assertion of the tag,
which is that `ℙⁿ_X` is a projective bundle **over `X`** and not merely abstractly isomorphic to
one.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectiveBundleIsoProjectiveSpace_hom_comp_fst :
    (projectiveBundleIsoProjectiveSpace (X := X) n).hom ≫
        pullback.fst (terminal.from X)
          (terminal.from (AlgebraicGeometry.projectiveSpaceAtUniverse.{u} n)) =
      (freeProjectiveBundle (X := X) n).toBase

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.blowUp
declarations.doc:
The blowup of a scheme `S` in a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals
`ℐ`: the relative `Proj` of the Rees algebra `⨁_{n ≥ 0} ℐⁿ`.
declarations.statement: def blowUp : Scheme.{u}

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.blowUpToBase

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.isPullback_blowUpChart
declarations.doc:
The blowup restricted to an affine open `U` of the base is `Proj` of the Rees algebra of
`ℐ(U)`: the chart over `U` is the preimage of `U` under the blowup morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_blowUpChart (U : S.affineOpens) :
    IsPullback (Stacks.RelativeProj.chartToOpen (fun W : S.affineOpens ↦ reesGrading (ℐ.ideal W))
      U (reesBase ℐ U)) (blowUpChart ℐ U) U.1.ι (blowUpToBase ℐ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.irreducibleSpace_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01OM.** A scheme is irreducible if and only if it
has a nonempty affine open cover by irreducible opens whose members meet
pairwise, if and only if it is nonempty and every nonempty affine open is
irreducible.
declarations.statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace_tfae (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    List.TFAE [
      IrreducibleSpace X,
      ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens),
        Nonempty ι ∧
          IsOpenCover U ∧
          (∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) ∧
          (∀ i, IrreducibleSpace (U i)) ∧
          ∀ i j, Set.Nonempty ((U i : Set X) ∩ (U j : Set X)),
      Nonempty X ∧
        ∀ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U → Nonempty U → IrreducibleSpace U]

declarations.name: CommRing.PropertyIsLocal
declarations.doc:
A property of commutative rings is local if it is preserved by localization away from
an element and descends from every finite family of such localizations whose elements
generate the unit ideal.
declarations.statement: structure PropertyIsLocal (P : ∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R], Prop) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocally
declarations.doc:
A scheme is locally `P` if every point belongs to an affine open whose ring of sections
satisfies `P`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev IsLocally (P : (R : Type u) → [CommRing R] → Prop) (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocally_iff_forall_affineOpens
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01OR (part (1) iff part (2)).** A scheme locally satisfies a local ring
property precisely when the ring of sections over every affine open satisfies it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocally_iff_forall_affineOpens (hP : CommRing.PropertyIsLocal P) (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    IsLocally P X ↔ ∀ U : X.affineOpens, P Γ(X, U.1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocally_iff_exists_affineOpenCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01OR (part (1) iff part (3)).** A scheme locally satisfies a ring
property precisely when it has an affine open cover on whose rings of sections the property
holds.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocally_iff_exists_affineOpenCover (P : (R : Type u) → [CommRing R] → Prop)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    IsLocally P X ↔
      ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.affineOpens),
        IsOpenCover (fun i ↦ (U i : X.Opens)) ∧ ∀ i, P Γ(X, (U i).1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocally_open
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01OR (open subschemes).** Every open subscheme of a scheme locally
satisfying a local ring property also locally satisfies that property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocally_open (hP : CommRing.PropertyIsLocal P) (X : Scheme.{u}) (hX : IsLocally P X)
    (U : X.Opens) : IsLocally P U.toScheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isLocally_iff_exists_openCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01OR (part (1) iff part (4)).** A scheme locally satisfies a local ring
property precisely when it has an open cover by open subschemes locally satisfying the
property.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocally_iff_exists_openCover (hP : CommRing.PropertyIsLocal P) (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    IsLocally P X ↔
      ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens),
        IsOpenCover U ∧ ∀ i, IsLocally P (U i).toScheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isReduced_iff_isLocally_isReduced
declarations.doc:
A scheme is reduced exactly when it is locally reduced: every point has an affine open
neighbourhood whose ring of sections is a reduced ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isReduced_iff_isLocally_isReduced (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    IsReduced X ↔ IsLocally (fun (R : Type u) [CommRing R] => _root_.IsReduced R) X
declarations.comment:
Both directions, for an arbitrary scheme and with no further hypotheses:
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced X` is equivalent to `IsLocally` applied to reducedness of rings,
which is `locally reduced` in the sense of Definition 01OQ.

declarations.name: CommRing.finiteType_int_isLocal
declarations.doc:
Being a finite-type algebra over the integers is a local property of
commutative rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteType_int_isLocal :
    PropertyIsLocal
      (fun (R : Type u) [CommRing R] => Algebra.FiniteType ℤ R)
declarations.comment: part (3) (absolutely Noetherian): being of finite type over ℤ is a local property

declarations.name: CommRing.isNoetherianCohenMacaulayRing_propertyIsLocal
declarations.doc: The property of a commutative ring of being Noetherian and Cohen–Macaulay is local.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNoetherianCohenMacaulayRing_propertyIsLocal :
    PropertyIsLocal
      (fun (R : Type u) [hR : CommRing R] =>
        ∃ hN : IsNoetherianRing R, @IsCohenMacaulayRing R hR hN)
declarations.comment: part (1) (Cohen-Macaulay): being Noetherian and Cohen-Macaulay is a local property

declarations.name: CommRing.isRegularRing_propertyIsLocal
declarations.doc: Being a Noetherian regular ring is local on the spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRegularRing_propertyIsLocal :
    PropertyIsLocal (fun (R : Type u) [CommRing R] => IsRegularRing R)
declarations.comment: part (2) (regular): being Noetherian and regular is a local property

registrations.comment: a Jacobson scheme is `JacobsonSpace` of its underlying space

registrations.name: PrimeSpectrum.isJacobsonRing_iff_jacobsonSpace
