declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.totalQuotientSheafIsoConstant
declarations.doc:
An isomorphism between the sheaf of meromorphic functions on an integral scheme and the
constant sheaf on its function field, carrying a regular section to the constant section
determined by its germ at the generic point.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalQuotientSheafIsoConstant (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] :
    { e : totalQuotientSheaf X.sheaf ≅
        constantSheafOnSpace X CommRingCat.{u} X.functionField //
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (s : X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))
        (h : genericPoint X ∈ U),
        (e.hom.hom.app (Opposite.op U)).hom
          ((toTotalQuotientSheaf X.sheaf).hom.app (Opposite.op U) s) =
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          ((Functor.const (Opens X)ᵒᵖ).obj X.functionField)).app (Opposite.op U)
            (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) h s) }

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.nonempty_meromorphicSectionSheafIsoConstant
declarations.doc:
On an integral scheme the sheaf of meromorphic sections of a quasi-coherent module `F` is the
constant sheaf on the stalk of `F` at the generic point, read as a sheaf of modules over the sheaf
of meromorphic functions through `AlgebraicGeometry.totalQuotientSheafIsoConstant`. For every
adjunction `adj` between extension and restriction of scalars, the isomorphism may be chosen to
carry the image of a section under the unit of `adj` to the constant section determined by its
germ at the generic point.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_meromorphicSectionSheafIsoConstant [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Nonempty { e : meromorphicSectionSheaf X.sheaf F ≅
      (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
        ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat.{u})).map
            (totalQuotientSheafIsoConstant X).val.hom)).obj
        (constantGenericStalkModuleSheaf X F) //
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (m : F.val.obj (Opposite.op U))
        (h : genericPoint X ∈ U),
        (e.hom.val.app (Opposite.op U))
          ((adj.unit.app F).val.app (Opposite.op U) m) =
          constantGenericStalkModuleSection X F U
            (F.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) h m) }

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.MeromorphicConstant.totalQuotientSheafIsoConstant
declarations.doc:
On an integral scheme the sheaf of meromorphic functions is the constant sheaf with value the
function field, by an isomorphism carrying the image of a regular function to the constant
section given by its germ at the generic point.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def totalQuotientSheafIsoConstant :
    { e : totalQuotientSheaf X.sheaf ≅ constantSheafOnSpace X CommRingCat.{u} X.functionField //
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (s : X.presheaf.obj (op U)) (h : genericPoint X ∈ U),
        (e.hom.hom.app (op U)).hom
          ((toTotalQuotientSheaf X.sheaf).hom.app (op U) s) =
        (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          ((Functor.const (Opens X)ᵒᵖ).obj X.functionField)).app (op U)
            (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) h s) }

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.MeromorphicConstantModule.meromorphicSectionSheafIsoConstant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01X5, part (2).** On an integral scheme the sheaf of meromorphic
sections of a quasi-coherent module `F` is the constant sheaf of modules with value the stalk of
`F` at the generic point, over the sheaf of meromorphic functions, compatibly with the germ at
the generic point.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def meromorphicSectionSheafIsoConstant :
    { e : meromorphicSectionSheaf.{u, u} X.sheaf F ≅ constGenericStalkSheaf F //
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (m : (pmod F).obj (op U)) (h : genericPoint X ∈ U),
        (e.hom.val.app (op U)).hom (toMeromorphicSection F U m) =
          constGenericStalkSection F U (F.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) h m) }

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Cech.isZero_cechCohomology_of_isStandardOpenCover
declarations.doc:
**Positive-degree Čech cohomology of a quasi-coherent module vanishes on a finite standard
open cover of an affine open.** Here `F` is a quasi-coherent module on the ambient scheme `X`,
the affine open `U` is covered by the ambient basic opens `X.basicOpen (g i)` attached to a
finite family `g` of sections over `U` whose basic opens cover `Spec Γ(X, U)`, and Čech
cohomology is the homology of Mathlib's `cechComplexFunctor` applied to the underlying abelian
sheaf of `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cechCohomology_of_isStandardOpenCover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {n : ℕ} (g : Fin n → Γ(X, U))
    (hg : PrimeSpectrum.IsStandardOpenCoverOfSpectrum g) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (((cechComplexFunctor fun i ↦ X.basicOpen (g i)).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).obj).homology p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Cech.isZero_hgroup_of_isAffineOpen
declarations.doc:
**Serre vanishing on affine schemes.** The positive-degree cohomology of a
quasi-coherent module on an affine open of a scheme vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_hgroup_of_isAffineOpen (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    IsZero (Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf U p F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.Coherator.affineAmplitudeIn_zero_zero_single
declarations.doc:
**A quasi-coherent module has affine amplitude in `[0, 0]`.** Placed in degree zero, a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module has hypercohomology over every affine open of `X` concentrated in
degree zero: this is the vanishing in negative degrees of
`Stacks.Duality.Coherator.isZero_homology_derivedSectionsLocallySmall_single_of_neg` together with
Serre vanishing ([Stacks, Tag 01XB]) in positive degrees.

It is the hypothesis of [Stacks, Tag 0CSA] at `a = b = 0`, which is what Example
[Stacks, Tag 0CSB] feeds that tag.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineAmplitudeIn_zero_zero_single (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    AffineAmplitudeIn X 0 0 ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj M)
declarations.comment: the vanishing in positive degrees, together with left exactness in negative degrees, in the hypercohomology spelling of Coherator.AffineAmplitudeIn at the locally small model

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Affine.isZero_rightDerived_pushforward_of_isAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XC].** If `f : X ⟶ S` is an affine morphism of schemes and `F` is a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module, then `Rⁱ f_* F` vanishes for every `i > 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_pushforward_of_isAffineHom {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (F : X.Modules) [IsAffineHom f] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus i).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.AffineHigherDirectImage.isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XC].** If `f : X ⟶ S` is an affine morphism of schemes and `F` is a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module, then `R ⁱ f_* F = 0` for every `i > 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward [IsAffineHom f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus i).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Affine.isIso_cechCohomologyToCohomology_of_isAffineOpen
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XD].** A covering of an open subset of a scheme whose finite intersections
are all affine opens computes the cohomology of a quasi-coherent module by its Čech complex: the
canonical comparison of [Stacks, Tag 01EQ] from Čech cohomology to sheaf cohomology is an
isomorphism of `Γ(U, 𝒪_X)`-modules in every degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_cechCohomologyToCohomology_of_isAffineOpen
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type u} (U : X.Opens) (Ui : I → X.Opens) (hU : U = ⨆ i, Ui i)
    (haffine : ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : Fin (r + 1) → I), IsAffineOpen (⨅ k, Ui (s k)))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((cechCohomologyToCohomology X.ringCatSheaf U Ui hU (p : ℤ)).app F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.CechAffineCover.isIso_cechCohomologyToCohomology_app_of_isAffineOpen
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XD]: a cover of a scheme whose finite intersections are affine computes the
cohomology of a quasi-coherent module by its Čech complex.** The canonical comparison
`Ȟᵖ(𝒰, F) ⟶ Hᵖ(U, F)` of [Stacks, Tag 01EQ] is an isomorphism of `Γ(U, 𝒪_X)`-modules for every
`p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_cechCohomologyToCohomology_app_of_isAffineOpen
    (haff : ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : Fin (r + 1) → I), IsAffineOpen (⨅ k, Ui (s k)))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((cechCohomologyToCohomology X.ringCatSheaf U Ui hU (p : ℤ)).app F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.Cech.isIso_cechCohomologyToCohomology_app_of_isAffineOpen
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XD].** Let `X` be a scheme and let `U` be an open covering of `X` such
that every intersection `U_{i₀} ⊓ … ⊓ U_{iₚ}` is affine. For a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ`
the canonical comparison from the Čech cohomology of the covering to the cohomology of `ℱ` is
an isomorphism of `Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`-modules in every degree.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_cechCohomologyToCohomology_app_of_isAffineOpen (X : Scheme.{u})
    {I : Type u} (U : I → X.Opens) (hU : IsOpenCover U)
    (hUaffine : ∀ (p : ℕ) (i : Fin (p + 1) → I), IsAffineOpen (⨅ j, U (i j)))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ) :
    IsIso ((Stacks.Cohomology.CechDerived.cechCohomologyToCohomology X.ringCatSheaf
      (⊤ : X.Opens) U hU.symm (p : ℤ)).app F)

declarations.name: Stacks.SerreCriterion.isAffine_of_forall_isZero_H1_ideal
declarations.doc:
**Serre's criterion for affineness.** A quasi-compact scheme on which the first cohomology
of every quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals vanishes is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffine_of_forall_isZero_H1_ideal (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X]
    (hH₁ : ∀ I : Subobject (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf),
      (Subobject.underlying.obj I).IsQuasicoherent →
        IsZero (((SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).rightDerived 1).obj
          (Subobject.underlying.obj I))) :
    IsAffine X

declarations.name: Stacks.SerreCriterion.isAffine_of_forall_isZero_H1_finiteType_ideal
declarations.doc:
**Serre's criterion for affineness, finite type form.** Vanishing of the first cohomology on
the finite type quasi-coherent sheaves of ideals suffices for affineness of a quasi-compact,
quasi-separated scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffine_of_forall_isZero_H1_finiteType_ideal (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (hH₁ : ∀ I : Subobject (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf),
      (Subobject.underlying.obj I).IsQuasicoherent →
        (Subobject.underlying.obj I).IsFiniteType →
          IsZero (((SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).rightDerived 1).obj
            (Subobject.underlying.obj I))) :
    IsAffine X

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AffineCover.isZero_cohomology_of_finite_affine_cover
declarations.doc:
If `X` has affine diagonal and is covered by `t` affine opens, then the
cohomology of a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module vanishes in every degree at least `t`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_of_finite_affine_cover (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    {t : ℕ} (U : Fin t → X.Opens) (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i))
    (hUcover : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) (hn : t ≤ n) :
    IsZero (Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf (⊤ : X.Opens) n F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AffineCover.isZero_cohomologyPresheaf_of_affineCoveringNumber_le
declarations.doc:
If `X` is quasi-compact with affine diagonal — for example if `X` is
separated — then the cohomology of a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module vanishes in every degree at
least the least number of affine opens needed to cover `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomologyPresheaf_of_affineCoveringNumber_le (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ)
    (hn : minimalAffineCoverCardinality (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ n) :
    IsZero ((((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F).cohomologyPresheaf n).obj
      (op (⊤ : X.Opens)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isZero_cohomology_of_affineCoverNum_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XI.** Let `X` be a quasi-compact scheme with affine diagonal — for
instance a separated scheme — and let `t = t(X)` be the minimal number of affine opens needed to
cover `X`. Then `H^p(X, F) = 0` for every `p ≥ t` and every quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_cohomology_of_affineCoverNum_le (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : X.affineCoverNum ⊤ ≤ p) :
    IsZero (Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.FiniteCover.isZero_Hgroup_of_finite_affine_cover
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XI], finite-cover form.** On a scheme with affine diagonal covered by `t`
affine opens, the cohomology of a quasi-coherent module vanishes in every degree at least `t`.

This is the library-spelling counterpart of `isZero_H'_of_finite_affine_cover`. The tag's own
phrasing bounds the degree by the
*minimal* number of affine opens needed to cover the scheme; that follows from this by applying
it to a cover realizing the minimum, and is not stated here because the affine covering number
has no name in the library yet.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_Hgroup_of_finite_affine_cover
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {t : ℕ} (U : Fin t → X.Opens) (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (W : X.Opens)
    (hcover : ⨆ i, U i = W) (n : ℕ) (hn : t ≤ n) :
    IsZero (Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf W n F)

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.minimalAffineCoverCardinality
registrations.comment: affine covering number

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageQcoh.isQuasicoherent_higherDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XJ (quasicoherence).** The higher direct images of a
quasi-coherent module under a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes are
quasi-coherent.
declarations.statement:
instance isQuasicoherent_higherDirectImage {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℤ) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F).IsQuasicoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageQcoh.exists_isZero_rightDerived_pushforward
declarations.doc:
For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes whose target is quasi-compact
there is an integer, depending on the morphism alone, above which every higher direct image of
every quasi-coherent module vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_rightDerived_pushforward {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [CompactSpace S] :
    ∃ n : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, n ≤ p → ∀ (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent],
      IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageQcoh.exists_isZero_rightDerivedNat_pushforward
declarations.doc:
For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes whose target is quasi-compact
there is a natural number, depending on the morphism alone, above which `(Rⁿ f_*) F` vanishes for
every quasi-coherent module `F`, where `Rⁿ f_*` is Mathlib's `ℕ`-indexed
`CategoryTheory.Functor.rightDerived (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_rightDerivedNat_pushforward {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [CompactSpace S] :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ F : X.Modules, F.IsQuasicoherent → ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n →
      IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerived n).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageQcoh.exists_isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward
declarations.doc:
For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes whose target is quasi-compact
there is an integer, depending on the morphism alone, above which every higher direct image of
every quasi-coherent module vanishes, for the `ℤ`-indexed right derived functors at an arbitrary
model of the bounded below derived category.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [CompactSpace S]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.Modules] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} S.Modules] :
    ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ p : ℤ, N ≤ p → ∀ F : X.Modules, F.IsQuasicoherent →
      IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag01XJQcohInduction.higherDirectImage_isQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XJ (quasicoherence).** The higher direct images of a quasi-coherent
module under a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes are quasi-coherent.

Quasi-coherence is local on the base
(`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageQcoh.isQuasicoherent_rightDerivedPlus_of_affineOpens`,
which is [Stacks, Tag 01E5] for schemes), and `f ∣_ V` is again quasi-compact and quasi-separated
with affine target, so the statement reduces to
`isQuasicoherent_rightDerivedPlus_of_isAffine`.
declarations.statement:
instance higherDirectImage_isQuasicoherent (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℤ) :
    (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F).IsQuasicoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag01XJUniformVanishing.exists_isZero_rightDerived_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XJ (uniform_vanishing).** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated morphism of schemes with `S` quasi-compact.  Then there is an integer `n`,
depending only on `f`, such that `R ᵖ f_* F = 0` for every `p ≥ n` and every quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `F`.

`S` is covered by finitely many affine opens `B j` (`exists_fin_affineOpen_cover`), each
`f ∣_ B j` is again quasi-compact and quasi-separated with affine target, so
`exists_isZero_rightDerived_pushforward_of_isAffine` supplies a bound `n j`; the bound is
`⨆ j, (n j).toNat`.  Above it every restriction of `R ᵖ f_* F` to a `B j` vanishes — by
[Stacks, Tag 01E5] for schemes, `higherDirectImageRestrictObjIso` — and vanishing is local,
`isZero_of_isZero_restrict`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_rightDerived_pushforward (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [CompactSpace S] :
    ∃ n : ℤ, ∀ (p : ℤ), n ≤ p → ∀ (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent],
      IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_uniform_isZero_rightDerived_pushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XJ (3).** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
morphism of schemes with `S` quasi-compact. There is an integer `n = n(X, S, f)` such that for
every morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` the base change `f' : X' = X ×_S S' ⟶ S'` satisfies
`R ᵖ f'_* F' = 0` for every `p ≥ n` and every quasi-coherent module `F'` on `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_uniform_isZero_rightDerived_pushforward {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [CompactSpace S] :
    ∃ n : ℤ, ∀ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (g : S' ⟶ S) (F : (pullback f g).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent],
      ∀ p : ℤ, n ≤ p →
        IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f g)).rightDerivedPlus p).obj F)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AffineBase.cohomologyIsoGlobalSectionsRightDerivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XK].** For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism `f : X ⟶ S` with
affine target, the cohomology of a quasi-coherent module on `X` is naturally isomorphic, as a
module over `Γ(S, ⊤)`, to the global sections of its higher direct image.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def cohomologyIsoGlobalSectionsRightDerivedPushforward (q : ℤ) :
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).ι ⋙
        (moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerivedPlus q ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars f.appTop.hom ≅
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).ι ⋙
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus q ⋙
        moduleGlobalSections S

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AffineBase.cohomologyIsoSectionsRightDerivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of
schemes with `S` affine. For every `q : ℤ` the cohomology `H^q(X, F)` of a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `F`, regarded as a `Γ(S, 𝒪_S)`-module by restriction of scalars along
`f^\# : Γ(S, 𝒪_S) ⟶ Γ(X, 𝒪_X)`, is the module of global sections of the higher direct image
`R^qf_*F`, naturally in `F`.
declarations.statement:
def cohomologyIsoSectionsRightDerivedPushforward (q : ℤ) :
    quasicoherentInclusion X ⋙
        (sectionsFunctor X ⊤).rightDerivedPlus q ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars f.appTop.hom ≅
      quasicoherentInclusion X ⋙
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus q ⋙ sectionsFunctor S ⊤

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.Tag01XLDerivedIso.relativeCechIsoDerivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
**The relative Čech complex of [Stacks, Tag 01XL] computes `Rf_*ℱ`.**  In `D⁺(S)`,

`Č ⁼(𝒰, f, ℱ) ≅ Rf_*ℱ`,

functorially in the quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ`.  The hypotheses are those of
[Stacks, Tag 01XL]: `T` a finite affine open cover of `X` — so `X` is quasi-compact and covered
by finitely many affine opens — and `X`, `S` of affine diagonal.  Nothing is assumed about `f`.

This is `relativeCechComputesDerivedPushforward` composed with the resolution
`ℱ[0] ≅ 𝔠 ⁼(𝒰, ℱ)` of [Stacks, Tag 02FU].
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def relativeCechIsoDerivedPushforward (f : X ⟶ S) (T : X.AffineOpenCover.{u, u})
    [Fintype T.I₀]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from S))] :
    relativeCechComplex f T ⋙ HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient S.Modules ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh ≅
      ObjectProperty.ι (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor X.Modules 0 ⋙
          (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedFunctorPlus

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeCech.relativeCechPresheaf
declarations.doc:
The coefficient presheaf of the relative Čech complex of Tag 01XL: the functor sending a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `F` to the presheaf on `Over X` whose value at `A`, with structure
morphism `a`, is `(a ≫ f)_* a^* F`, with the canonical restriction maps.

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeCechComplex.relativeCechComplex
declarations.doc:
**The bounded-below relative Čech complex of a finite affine open cover (Stacks 01XL).**
The alternating Čech complex, for the family `Over.mk (T.f i)` in `Over X`, of the coefficient
presheaf of `f`, extended from `ℕ`-indexing to `ℤ`-indexing and regarded as a bounded-below
complex.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def relativeCechComplex (f : X ⟶ S) (T : X.AffineOpenCover)
    [Fintype T.I₀] :
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory ⥤
      CochainComplex.Plus S.Modules

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeCechComplex.relativeCechComplex_obj_isQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XL:** every term of the relative Čech complex of a finite affine
open cover is a quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-module.
declarations.statement:
public theorem relativeCechComplex_obj_isQuasicoherent (f : X ⟶ S) (T : X.AffineOpenCover)
    [Fintype T.I₀]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from S))]
    (F : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory) (p : ℤ) :
    (((relativeCechComplex f T).obj F).obj.X p).IsQuasicoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeCechBaseChange.baseChangeRelativeCechIsoDerivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XM], the canonical isomorphism.**  For a cartesian square
```
X' --g'--> X
|f'        |f
S' --g-->  S
```
with `X` and `S` of affine diagonal, a finite affine open cover `𝒰` of `X` and a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module `ℱ`, there is a canonical isomorphism

`g^* Č ⁼(𝒰, f, ℱ) ≅ Rf'_* (g')^*ℱ`

in `D⁺(S')`: the termwise inverse image of the relative Čech complex is the relative Čech complex
of the cover `X' = ⋃ Uᵢ ×_X X'` (the base change map of [Stacks, Tag 02KG] on each finite
intersection), whose finite intersections are affine over `X'` and over `S'`, so that it computes
`Rf'_*` as in [Stacks, Tag 01XL].
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangeRelativeCechIsoDerivedPushforward :
    DerivedCategory.Plus.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient S'.Modules).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapCochainComplexPlus.obj
          ((relativeCechComplex f T).obj F))) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj F.obj))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeCechBaseChange.baseChangeRelativeCechComplexIsoOfIsAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XM], the affine case.**  For a cartesian square as in
`baseChangeRelativeCechIsoDerivedPushforward` with `g : S' ⟶ S` affine, the members
`U'ᵢ = (g')^{-1}(Uᵢ) = Uᵢ ×_X X'` of the inverse-image cover `𝒰'` are affine, and the termwise
inverse image of the relative Čech complex is the relative Čech complex of this affine open cover:

`g^* Č ⁼(𝒰, f, ℱ) ≅ Č ⁼(𝒰', f', (g')^*ℱ)`

as bounded below complexes of `𝒪_{S'}`-modules.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def baseChangeRelativeCechComplexIsoOfIsAffineHom [IsAffineHom g] :
    letI : IsAffineHom g' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback hw.flip inferInstance
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).mapCochainComplexPlus.obj ((relativeCechComplex f T).obj F) ≅
      (relativeCechComplex f' (inverseImageAffineOpenCover g' T)).obj (pullbackQcohObj g' F)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.UniversalPushforward.universalPushforwardComplexOfQuasiSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XN.**  Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
morphism of schemes with `S` quasi-compact and separated, and let `𝓕` be a quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-module.  There is a bounded below complex `𝓚⁼` of quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-modules such that
for every morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` the complex `g^*𝓚⁼` represents `Rf'_*𝓕'` in `D⁺(S')`, with the
notation of the cartesian square of [Stacks, Tag 02KF].

The complex is `𝓚⁼(K, f, 𝓕) = ( ∏_{i ∈ I₀} f_{i,*}𝓕|_{U_i} ⟶ ∏_{i ∈ I₁} f_{i,*}𝓕|_{U_i} ⟶ ⋯ )`
for a hypercovering `K = (I, {U_i})` of `X` finite in every degree by affine opens
(`exists_finite_affine_hypercovering_isAffineHom`, [Stacks, Tag 01H7]); its terms are
quasi-coherent because each `f_i : U_i ⟶ S` is affine, `S` being separated, and the
base-change isomorphisms are `nonempty_baseChangeIso`.
declarations.statement:
def universalPushforwardComplexOfQuasiSeparated (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f]
    [QuasiSeparated f] [CompactSpace S] [S.IsSeparated]
    (F : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory) :
    UniversalPushforwardComplex f F

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.UniversalPushforward.universalPushforwardComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XN, for an affine morphism.**  Let `f : X ⟶ S` be an affine morphism
of schemes and `𝓕` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then `f_*𝓕` placed in degree zero is a bounded
below complex of quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-modules whose ordinary inverse image along *every*
`g : S' ⟶ S` represents `Rf'_*𝓕'` in `D⁺(S')`, with the notation of the cartesian square of
[Stacks, Tag 02KF].

The three fields are discharged separately.  The complex is the single complex, so its terms are
`f_*𝓕` in degree zero — quasi-coherent because `f` is affine ([Stacks, Tag 01XD]) — and zero
objects elsewhere.  The base-change isomorphism for every `g` is `affineBaseChangeSingleIso`:
affineness is stable under base change, so no hypothesis on `S'` is needed and the universal
quantification over `g` is genuine.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def universalPushforwardComplex (f : X ⟶ S) [IsAffineHom f]
    (F : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory) :
    UniversalPushforwardComplex f F

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.UniversalPushforward.nonempty_universalPushforwardComplex_of_isAffineHom_diagonal
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism of schemes, let `S` be
quasi-compact and separated and let `𝓕` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. If `X` has affine
diagonal then there is a bounded below complex `𝓚⁼` of quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-modules such that
for every `g : S' ⟶ S` the ordinary inverse image `g^*𝓚⁼` represents `Rf'_*𝓕'` in `D⁺(S')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_universalPushforwardComplex_of_isAffineHom_diagonal (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [CompactSpace S] [S.IsSeparated]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))]
    (F : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory) :
    Nonempty (UniversalPushforwardComplex f F)
declarations.comment: for a source of affine diagonal

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.UniversalPushforward.nonempty_universalPushforwardComplex_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a quasi-compact, separated morphism of schemes, let `S` be quasi-compact
and separated and let `𝓕` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Then there is a bounded below
complex `𝓚⁼` of quasi-coherent `𝒪_S`-modules such that for every `g : S' ⟶ S` the ordinary
inverse image `g^*𝓚⁼` represents `Rf'_*𝓕'` in `D⁺(S')`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_universalPushforwardComplex_of_isSeparated (f : X ⟶ S)
    [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] [CompactSpace S] [S.IsSeparated]
    (F : (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).FullSubcategory) :
    Nonempty (UniversalPushforwardComplex f F)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.homLocalizationMap_bijective
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XQ] part (2).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let
`L` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, let `s` be a global section of `L`, let `ℱ` be an
`𝒪_X`-module of finite presentation and let `𝒢` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. The comparison
map of Tag 0B5M
`(⨁_n Hom(ℱ, 𝒢 ⊗ L^{⊗ n}))_{(s)} ⟶ Hom_{𝒪_{X_s}}(ℱ|_{X_s}, 𝒢|_{X_s})` is bijective.

The quasi-coherence of `ℱ` that the source assumes throughout the lemma is not carried
separately: finite presentation implies it, and implies the finite type that part (1) of the tag
asks for.
declarations.statement:
theorem homLocalizationMap_bijective [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] [G.IsQuasicoherent] (s : L.sections) :
    Function.Bijective (homLocalizationMap X L F G s)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.homLocalizationMap_injective
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XQ] part (1).** Let `X` be a quasi-compact scheme, let `L` be an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module, let `s` be a global section of `L` and let `ℱ`, `𝒢` be quasi-coherent
`𝒪_X`-modules with `ℱ` of finite type. The comparison map of Tag 0B5M
`(⨁_n Hom(ℱ, 𝒢 ⊗ L^{⊗ n}))_{(s)} ⟶ Hom_{𝒪_{X_s}}(ℱ|_{X_s}, 𝒢|_{X_s})` is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem homLocalizationMap_injective (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X]
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))
    [IsInvertible X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
      (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L]
    (F G : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType]
    (s : L.sections) :
    Function.Injective (homLocalizationMap X L F G s)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exists_sectionPowerAction_eq_zero_of_isAffine
declarations.doc:
**The conclusion of [Stacks, Tag 01XR] for an affine ambient scheme.** On an affine scheme the
positive-degree cohomology of a quasi-coherent module vanishes, so every class is annihilated
already by the zeroth power of a global section of an invertible module.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sectionPowerAction_eq_zero_of_isAffine [IsAffine X] (s : L.sections)
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (_hU : IsAffineOpen (nonvanishingOpen L s))
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (ξ : Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p F) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
        TensorPower.tensorPower X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
          (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L n),
      IsSectionPowerHom X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
          (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L s n t ∧
        (Hfunctor X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p).map
          (sectionPowerAction X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
            (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L F n t) ξ = 0
declarations.comment: the case of an affine ambient scheme

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exists_sectionPowerAction_eq_zero_of_finite_affine_cover
declarations.doc:
**The conclusion of [Stacks, Tag 01XR] above the size of a finite affine cover.** On a scheme
with affine diagonal covered by `t` affine opens the cohomology of a quasi-coherent module
vanishes in every degree at least `t`, so in those degrees every class is annihilated already by
the zeroth power of a global section of an invertible module.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sectionPowerAction_eq_zero_of_finite_affine_cover
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal (terminal.from X))] (s : L.sections)
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (_hU : IsAffineOpen (nonvanishingOpen L s))
    {t : ℕ} (U : Fin t → X.Opens) (hUaff : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (hUcover : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤)
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ) (_hp : 0 < p) (ht : t ≤ p)
    (ξ : Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p F) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t' : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
        TensorPower.tensorPower X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
          (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L n),
      IsSectionPowerHom X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
          (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L s n t' ∧
        (Hfunctor X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p).map
          (sectionPowerAction X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
            (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L F n t') ξ = 0
declarations.comment: the degrees at least the size of a finite affine cover

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exists_sectionPowerAction_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen_nonvanishingOpen
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XR].** Let `X` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, `ℒ` an invertible
`𝒪_X`-module and `s ∈ Γ(X, ℒ)` a global section whose nonvanishing open `X_s` is affine. Then
every cohomology class of a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module in a positive degree is annihilated by
some power of `s`.

This is the general case; `./Basic.lean` has the two cases in which the cohomology group itself
vanishes. The conclusion quantifies over the morphisms `𝒪_X ⟶ ℒ^{⊗ k}` representing `s^k`, as
those statements do, and is witnessed by the canonical representative
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.sectionPowerHom`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sectionPowerAction_eq_zero_of_isAffineOpen_nonvanishingOpen [CompactSpace X]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (hU : IsAffineOpen (nonvanishingOpen L s)) (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (ξ : (Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p F : Type u)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
        TensorPower.tensorPower X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
          (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L n),
      IsSectionPowerHom X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
          (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L s n t ∧
        (Hfunctor X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p).map
          (sectionPowerAction X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
            (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L F n t) ξ = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.exists_sectionPowerAction_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XR].** Let `X` be a scheme, `ℒ` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and
`s ∈ Γ(X, ℒ)` a global section. If `X` is quasi-compact and quasi-separated and
`X_s` is affine, then for every quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ`, every `p > 0` and every
`ξ ∈ Hᵖ(X, ℱ)` there is `n ≥ 0` with `sⁿ ξ = 0` in `Hᵖ(X, ℱ ⊗ ℒ^{⊗ n})`.

Multiplication by `sⁿ` is `Stacks.SheafOfModules.sectionPowerAction` along the morphism
`t : 𝒪_X ⟶ ℒ^{⊗ n}` representing `sⁿ` (`Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsSectionPowerHom`; such a `t` is
unique, by `Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsSectionPowerHom.unique`, and exists, by
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isSectionPowerHom_sectionPowerHom`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_sectionPowerAction_eq_zero (X : Scheme.{u})
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace))
    [IsInvertible X.toRingedSpace.presheaf (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (s : L.sections)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen (nonvanishingOpen L s)) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (ξ : Hgroup X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p F) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ (t : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶
        TensorPower.tensorPower X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
          (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L n),
      IsSectionPowerHom X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
          (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L s n t →
        (Hfunctor X.ringCatSheaf ⊤ p).map
          (sectionPowerAction X.toRingedSpace.presheaf
            (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L F n t) ξ = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.twistCohomologyIsoHomogeneous
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XT], the degree-zero row.** For `d ≥ 0` the module `H⁰(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d))` is the
module of degree-`d` homogeneous polynomials in `T₀, …, Tₙ`, for every `n ≥ 0`.

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.twistCohomologyIsoNegative
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XT], the top-degree row.** For `d < 0` the module `Hⁿ(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d))` is the
degree-`d` part of `(T₀ ⋯ Tₙ)⁻¹ R[T₀⁻¹, …, Tₙ⁻¹]`, the free `R`-module on the degree-`d` Laurent
monomials with every exponent negative, for every `n ≥ 0`.
declarations.statement:
def twistCohomologyIsoNegative (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0) :
    twistCohomology R n d n ≅ ModuleCat.of R (negativeTwistPart R n d)

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.isZero_twistCohomology
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XT], the vanishing row.** Outside the two cases `q = 0, d ≥ 0` and
`q = n, d < 0` the module `H^q(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d))` is zero, for every `n ≥ 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_twistCohomology (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : ¬ ((q = 0 ∧ 0 ≤ d) ∨ (q = n ∧ d < 0))) :
    IsZero (twistCohomology R n d q)

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.twistCohomologyMonomial
declarations.doc:
**The cohomology of the twists of the structure sheaf on projective space.** For every
commutative ring `R`, every `n ≥ 0` and every integer `d`, `H^q(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d))` is the degree-`d`
part of `R[T₀, …, Tₙ]` when `q = 0` and `d ≥ 0`, is the degree-`d` part of
`(T₀ ⋯ Tₙ)⁻¹ R[T₀⁻¹, …, Tₙ⁻¹]` when `q = n` and `d < 0`, and is zero otherwise, as
`R`-modules.
declarations.statement:
def twistCohomologyMonomial (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    TwistCohomologyMonomial R n d

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.bijective_degreeSection_line
declarations.doc:
**`Γ(𝐏¹_k, 𝒪(d))` is the module of binary forms of degree `d`, through the canonical map
of Equation [Stacks, Tag 01MP].**

For `k` a field and every `d ≥ 0`, the degree-`d` section map
`(k[T₀, T₁])_d ⟶ Γ(𝐏¹_k, 𝒪(d))` is bijective. This is the `n = 1` case of
`Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.bijective_degreeSection`, which is injective because
`k[T₀, …, Tₙ]` is a domain and surjective because
`Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.homogeneousIsoTwistSections` makes the two sides `k`-vector
spaces of the same finite dimension.

Together with the multiplicativity across degrees of
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistSectionRing.mul_degreeSection` this is the identification of
the graded ring `⨁_d Γ(𝐏¹_k, 𝒪(d))` with `k[T₀, T₁]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_degreeSection_line (k : Type u) [Field k] (d : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (degreeSection (polyGrading k 1) d)
declarations.comment: degree zero, nonnegative twist, for the projective line over a field: the canonical map of Equation 01MP from the degree-d binary forms to the sections of O(d) is bijective

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.serreTwistCohomology
declarations.doc:
**Serre's computation of the cohomology of the twists of the structure sheaf on projective
space.** For a commutative ring `R`, `n = m + 1 ≥ 1` and every integer `d`,
`H^q(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d))` is the degree-`d` part of `R[T₀, …, Tₙ]` for `q = 0`, is zero for
`q ≠ 0, n`, and is `Hom_R((R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{-n-1-d}, R)` for `q = n`, as `R`-modules.
declarations.statement:
def serreTwistCohomology (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    SerreTwistCohomology R m d

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.serreTwistCohomology_degreeZero_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XV], base change on `H⁰`.** For a ring map `φ : R → S`, the base-change map
`H⁰(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d)) ⟶ H⁰(ℙⁿ_S, 𝒪(d))` — the map on cohomology attached to the pullback along
`ℙⁿ_S ⟶ ℙⁿ_R` and the identification of the pullback of `𝒪(d)` with `𝒪(d)` — is, through the
identifications of [Stacks, Equation 01XU] of `H⁰(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d))` with `(R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_d` and of
`H⁰(ℙⁿ_S, 𝒪(d))` with `(S[T₀, …, Tₙ])_d`, the coefficientwise base change
`(R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_d ⟶ (S[T₀, …, Tₙ])_d`. Here `n = N + 1` and `d` is any integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem serreTwistCohomology_degreeZero_baseChange (N : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (x : twistCohomology R (N + 1) d 0) :
    ConcreteCategory.hom (serreTwistCohomology S N d).degreeZero.hom
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (Stacks.Cohomology.CechIso.fMapCohomology (projModelMap (N + 1) φ)
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (polyGrading S (N + 1)) d)
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (polyGrading R (N + 1)) d)
          (twistBaseChangeFMap φ (N + 1) d) 0) x) =
      baseChangeChart φ (N + 1) d ∅
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (serreTwistCohomology R N d).degreeZero.hom x)
declarations.comment: base change along R → S on H^0, through Equation 01XU

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.serreTwistCohomology_degreeTop_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XV], base change on `Hⁿ`.** For a ring map `φ : R → S`, the base-change map
`Hⁿ(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d)) ⟶ Hⁿ(ℙⁿ_S, 𝒪(d))` is, through the identifications of
[Stacks, Equation 01XU] of `Hⁿ` with `Hom((R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{-n-1-d}, R)` and with
`Hom((S[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{-n-1-d}, S)`, the base change of functionals: the functional attached to the
base change of a class takes the value `φ (λ h)` on the base change of `h`, where `λ` is the
functional attached to the class. Since the base changes of the monomials span
`(S[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{-n-1-d}`, this determines it. Here `n = N + 1` and `d` is any integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem serreTwistCohomology_degreeTop_baseChange (N : ℕ) (d : ℤ)
    (x : twistCohomology R (N + 1) d (N + 1))
    (h : twistChart R (N + 1) (-d - (((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1)) (∅ : Set (Fin (N + 1 + 1)))) :
    ConcreteCategory.hom (serreTwistCohomology S N d).degreeTop.hom
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (Stacks.Cohomology.CechIso.fMapCohomology (projModelMap (N + 1) φ)
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (polyGrading S (N + 1)) d)
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (polyGrading R (N + 1)) d)
          (twistBaseChangeFMap φ (N + 1) d) (N + 1)) x)
        (baseChangeChart φ (N + 1) (-d - (((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1)) ∅ h) =
      φ (ConcreteCategory.hom (serreTwistCohomology R N d).degreeTop.hom x h)
declarations.comment: base change along R → S on H^n, through Equation 01XU

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.zeroDim_degreeZero_mul
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XV] for `n = 0`, multiplication on `H⁰`, corrected.** On `ℙ⁰_R` the two
rows of [Stacks, Equation 01XU] both concern `H⁰` and hold only under the side conditions of
[Stacks, Tag 01XT]. For `d ≥ 0`, through the identification of `H⁰(ℙ⁰_R, 𝒪(d))` with
`(R[T₀])_d`, the map induced by multiplication by `f`, homogeneous of degree `m`, is
multiplication by `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroDim_degreeZero_mul {m : ℕ} {d e : ℤ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (0 + 1)) R)
    (hf : f.IsHomogeneous m) (hde : d + m = e) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (x : twistCohomology R 0 d 0) :
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (twistChart_univ_eq_empty_zeroDim R (show 0 ≤ e by omega))
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (twistCohomologyIsoChartUnivZeroDim R e).hom
          (ConcreteCategory.hom ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (coeffScalar R 0)).map
          (((Stacks.Cohomology.sectionsFunctor (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (polyGrading R 0))
            ⊤).rightDerived 0).map (twistScalarSheafMap (polyGrading R 0) m d e
              (by omega) ⟨f, (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule m f).2 hf⟩))) x)) =
      chartMul (chartOfHomogeneous R 0 f hf) hde ∅
        (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (twistChart_univ_eq_empty_zeroDim R hd)
          (ConcreteCategory.hom (twistCohomologyIsoChartUnivZeroDim R d).hom x))
declarations.comment: n = 0: multiplication by a homogeneous f on H^0, d ≥ 0, through Tag 01XT

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.zeroDim_degreeTop_mul
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XV] for `n = 0`, multiplication on `Hⁿ`, corrected.** For `d + m < 0`,
through the identification of `H⁰(ℙ⁰_R, 𝒪(d))` with `Hom_R((R[T₀])_{-1-d}, R)` by the residue
pairing, the map induced by multiplication by `f`, homogeneous of degree `m`, is the
contragredient of multiplication by `f`, `(R[T₀])_{-1-(d+m)} ⟶ (R[T₀])_{-1-d}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroDim_degreeTop_mul {m : ℕ} {d e : ℤ} (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (0 + 1)) R)
    (hf : f.IsHomogeneous m) (hde : d + m = e) (he : e < 0) (x : twistCohomology R 0 d 0)
    (h : twistChart R 0 (-e - (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1)) (∅ : Set (Fin (0 + 1)))) :
    topDualEquiv R 0 e (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (twistChart_univ_eq_negativeTwistPart_zeroDim R he)
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (twistCohomologyIsoChartUnivZeroDim R e).hom
          (ConcreteCategory.hom ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (coeffScalar R 0)).map
          (((Stacks.Cohomology.sectionsFunctor (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (polyGrading R 0))
            ⊤).rightDerived 0).map (twistScalarSheafMap (polyGrading R 0) m d e
              (by omega) ⟨f, (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule m f).2 hf⟩))) x))) h =
      topDualEquiv R 0 d (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _
          (twistChart_univ_eq_negativeTwistPart_zeroDim R (show d < 0 by omega))
          (ConcreteCategory.hom (twistCohomologyIsoChartUnivZeroDim R d).hom x))
        (chartMul (chartOfHomogeneous R 0 f hf) (show -e - (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) + m =
          -d - (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1) by omega) ∅ h)
declarations.comment: n = 0: multiplication on H^n is the contragredient, d + m < 0, through Tag 01XT

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.zeroDim_degreeZero_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XV] for `n = 0`, base change on `H⁰`, corrected.** For `d ≥ 0`, through the
identifications of `H⁰(ℙ⁰, 𝒪(d))` with `(R[T₀])_d` and `(S[T₀])_d`, the base-change map is the
coefficientwise base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroDim_degreeZero_baseChange (d : ℤ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (x : twistCohomology R 0 d 0) :
    LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (twistChart_univ_eq_empty_zeroDim S hd)
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (twistCohomologyIsoChartUnivZeroDim S d).hom
          (ConcreteCategory.hom (Stacks.Cohomology.CechIso.fMapCohomology (projModelMap 0 φ)
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (polyGrading S 0) d)
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (polyGrading R 0) d)
          (twistBaseChangeFMap φ 0 d) 0) x)) =
      baseChangeChart φ 0 d ∅ (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (twistChart_univ_eq_empty_zeroDim R hd)
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (twistCohomologyIsoChartUnivZeroDim R d).hom x))
declarations.comment: n = 0: base change along R → S on H^0, d ≥ 0, through Tag 01XT

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.zeroDim_degreeTop_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XV] for `n = 0`, base change on `Hⁿ`, corrected.** For `d < 0`, through the
identifications of `H⁰(ℙ⁰, 𝒪(d))` with `Hom_R((R[T₀])_{-1-d}, R)` and with
`Hom_S((S[T₀])_{-1-d}, S)` by the residue pairing, the functional attached to the base change of a
class takes the value `φ (λ h)` on the base change of `h`.
declarations.statement:
theorem zeroDim_degreeTop_baseChange (d : ℤ) (hd : d < 0) (x : twistCohomology R 0 d 0)
    (h : twistChart R 0 (-d - (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1)) (∅ : Set (Fin (0 + 1)))) :
    topDualEquiv S 0 d (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (twistChart_univ_eq_negativeTwistPart_zeroDim S hd)
        (ConcreteCategory.hom (twistCohomologyIsoChartUnivZeroDim S d).hom
          (ConcreteCategory.hom (Stacks.Cohomology.CechIso.fMapCohomology (projModelMap 0 φ)
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (polyGrading S 0) d)
          (ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (polyGrading R 0) d)
          (twistBaseChangeFMap φ 0 d) 0) x)))
        (baseChangeChart φ 0 (-d - (((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) + 1)) ∅ h) =
      φ (topDualEquiv R 0 d (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _
        (twistChart_univ_eq_negativeTwistPart_zeroDim R hd)
          (ConcreteCategory.hom (twistCohomologyIsoChartUnivZeroDim R d).hom x)) h)
declarations.comment: n = 0: base change along R → S on H^n, d < 0, through Tag 01XT

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.serreTwistCohomology_degreeZero_mul
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XV], multiplication on `H⁰`.** For `f ∈ R[T₀, …, Tₙ]` homogeneous of degree
`m`, the map `H⁰(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d)) ⟶ H⁰(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d + m))` induced by the morphism of sheaves
`𝒪(d) ⟶ 𝒪(d + m)` given by multiplication by `f` is, through the identification of
[Stacks, Equation 01XU] of `H⁰(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d))` with `(R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_d`, multiplication by `f`
`(R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_d ⟶ (R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{d+m}`. Here `n = N + 1` and `d` is any integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem serreTwistCohomology_degreeZero_mul (N : ℕ) {m : ℕ} {d e : ℤ}
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1 + 1)) R) (hf : f.IsHomogeneous m) (hde : d + m = e) :
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (coeffScalar R (N + 1))).map
          (((Stacks.Cohomology.sectionsFunctor (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (polyGrading R (N + 1)))
            ⊤).rightDerived 0).map (twistScalarSheafMap (polyGrading R (N + 1)) m d e
              (by omega) ⟨f, (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule m f).2 hf⟩)) ≫
        (serreTwistCohomology R N e).degreeZero.hom =
      (serreTwistCohomology R N d).degreeZero.hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (chartMul (chartOfHomogeneous R (N + 1) f hf) hde ∅)
declarations.comment: multiplication by a homogeneous f on H^0, through Equation 01XU

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.serreTwistCohomology_degreeTop_mul
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XV], multiplication on `Hⁿ`.** For `f ∈ R[T₀, …, Tₙ]` homogeneous of degree
`m`, the map `Hⁿ(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d)) ⟶ Hⁿ(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d + m))` induced by the morphism of sheaves
`𝒪(d) ⟶ 𝒪(d + m)` given by multiplication by `f` is, through the identifications of
[Stacks, Equation 01XU] of `Hⁿ(ℙⁿ_R, 𝒪(d))` with `Hom_R((R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{-n-1-d}, R)`, the
contragredient of multiplication by `f`
`(R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{-n-1-(d+m)} ⟶ (R[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{-n-1-d}`. Here `n = N + 1` and `d` is any
integer.
declarations.statement:
theorem serreTwistCohomology_degreeTop_mul (N : ℕ) {m : ℕ} {d e : ℤ}
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1 + 1)) R) (hf : f.IsHomogeneous m) (hde : d + m = e) :
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (coeffScalar R (N + 1))).map
          (((Stacks.Cohomology.sectionsFunctor (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (polyGrading R (N + 1)))
            ⊤).rightDerived (N + 1)).map (twistScalarSheafMap (polyGrading R (N + 1)) m d e
              (by omega) ⟨f, (MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule m f).2 hf⟩)) ≫
        (serreTwistCohomology R N e).degreeTop.hom =
      (serreTwistCohomology R N d).degreeTop.hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom
          (chartMul (chartOfHomogeneous R (N + 1) f hf)
            (dualDegree_add_of_add N hde) ∅).dualMap
declarations.comment: multiplication by a homogeneous f on H^n is the contragredient, through Equation 01XU

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHigherDirectImage.isIso_app_structureMorphism_projectiveSpaceOver
declarations.doc:
**The degree-zero identification `f_* 𝒪_{ℙⁿ_S} = 𝒪_S`.** For the structure morphism
`f : ℙⁿ_S ⟶ S` over an arbitrary scheme `S` and an arbitrary `n`, the canonical map
`𝒪_S ⟶ f_* 𝒪_{ℙⁿ_S}` is an isomorphism on the sections over every affine open `V` of the base:
`f` induces an isomorphism `Γ(S, V) ≅ Γ(ℙⁿ_S, f⁻¹V)`.

Since the affine opens form a basis of `S` and a morphism of sheaves that is invertible on a
basis is invertible, this is the full assertion that the direct image of the structure sheaf of
`ℙⁿ_S` is the structure sheaf of `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_app_structureMorphism_projectiveSpaceOver (n : ℕ) (S : Scheme.{u}) {V : S.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) : IsIso ((projectiveSpaceOver n S ↘ S).app V)
declarations.comment: the degree-zero clause at the zeroth twist, sectionwise and for the underived direct image: the structure morphism of ℙⁿ_S induces an isomorphism Γ(S, V) ≅ Γ(ℙⁿ_S, f⁻¹V) for every affine open V of the base, which is f_* 𝒪 = 𝒪_S on a basis of opens. The degree-zero row at every twist, assembled as an isomorphism of module sheaves on S and in the R⁰ f_* spelling, is ProjectiveSpaceHigherDirectImage.baseDegreeSheafIsoPushforwardTwistOver and ...baseDegreeSheafIsoRightDerivedPushforwardTwistOver in ...DegreeZeroRow; the whole display, its three rows in one statement at n >= 1, is ...rightDerivedPlusPushforwardTwistOverDisplay in ...Display

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHigherDirectImage.rightDerivedPlusPushforwardTwistOverDisplay
declarations.doc:
**The display of [Stacks, Tag 01XW].** For the structure morphism `f : ℙⁿ_S ⟶ S` of
projective `n`-space over an arbitrary scheme `S`, with `n = m + 1 ≥ 1`, and for every integer
twist `d`:

* `R⁰ f_* 𝒪(d) ≅ (𝒪_S[T₀, …, Tₙ])_d`, the degree-`d` part of the polynomial algebra on the base;
* `Rᵠ f_* 𝒪(d) = 0` for every integer `q` with `q ≠ 0` and `q ≠ n`;
* `Rⁿ f_* 𝒪(d) ≅ Hom_{𝒪_S}((𝒪_S[T₀, …, Tₙ])_{-n-1-d}, 𝒪_S)`.

The three components are `baseDegreeSheafIsoRightDerivedPushforwardTwistOver`, whose hypothesis
`0 ≤ d ∨ 0 < n` is discharged by `n = m + 1 ≥ 1`, then
`MiddleVanishing.isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward_twistOver_of_ne`, then
`rightDerivedPlusTopIsoDualBaseDegreeSheaf`.

The source's display is inconsistent at `n = 0`, where its first and third rows apply to the same
degree and disagree, so `n ≥ 1` is the range in which it asserts something; see the module
docstring.
declarations.statement:
def rightDerivedPlusPushforwardTwistOverDisplay (m : ℕ) (S : Scheme.{u}) (d : ℤ) :
    PProd (baseDegreeSheaf (m + 1) S d ≅
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (projectiveSpaceOver (m + 1) S ↘ S)).rightDerivedPlus 0).obj
          (twistOver (m + 1) S d))
      (PProd (∀ q : ℤ, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) →
            IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
              (projectiveSpaceOver (m + 1) S ↘ S)).rightDerivedPlus q).obj
                (twistOver (m + 1) S d)))
        (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (projectiveSpaceOver (m + 1) S ↘ S)).rightDerivedPlus
              ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).obj (twistOver (m + 1) S d) ≅
          dualSheaf (baseDegreeSheaf (m + 1) S (-((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 - d))))
declarations.comment: the display whole, at n = m + 1 >= 1, for every scheme S and every integer twist d: R^0 f_* O(d) = (O_S[T_0, ..., T_n])_d, R^q f_* O(d) = 0 for every q /= 0, n, and R^n f_* O(d) = Hom_{O_S}((O_S[T_0, ..., T_n])_{-n-1-d}, O_S). At n = 0 the display's first and third rows speak about the same degree and disagree, so n >= 1 is the range in which it is a consistent assertion

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceHigherDirectImage.MiddleVanishing.isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward_twistOver_of_ne
declarations.doc:
**The vanishing row of [Stacks, Tag 01XW].** For the structure morphism `f : ℙⁿ_S ⟶ S` over
an arbitrary scheme `S`, an arbitrary `n` and an arbitrary integer `d`, the higher direct image
`Rᵠ f_* 𝒪(d)` is zero in every degree `q` with `q ≠ 0` and `q ≠ n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward_twistOver_of_ne (n : ℕ) (S : Scheme.{u}) (d : ℤ)
    (q : ℤ) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hqn : q ≠ (n : ℤ)) :
    IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (projectiveSpaceOver n S ↘ S)).rightDerivedPlus q).obj
      (twistOver n S d))
declarations.comment: the vanishing row, whole: R^q f_* 𝒪(d) = 0 for every q ≠ 0, n, every scheme S, every n and every integer d. The q = 0 row is ProjectiveSpaceHigherDirectImage.baseDegreeSheafIsoRightDerivedPushforwardTwistOver in ...DegreeZeroRow; the q = n row is ...rightDerivedPlusTopIsoDualBaseDegreeSheaf in ...TopDegreeRowGeneral, for every twist d over an arbitrary base. The whole display, its three rows in one statement at n >= 1, is ...rightDerivedPlusPushforwardTwistOverDisplay in ...Display

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.higherDirectImageZeroIso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XX], compatibility with base change, the row `q = 0`**: for a morphism of
schemes `g : S' ⟶ S`, `E` finite locally free of constant rank `n + 1` with `n ≥ 1`, `E' ≅ g^*E`
and every `d ≥ 0`, the base change map `g^* R⁰π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d) ⟶ R⁰π'_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E')}(d)` corresponds,
under the identifications `R⁰π_* 𝒪(d) ≅ Sym^d(E)` and `R⁰π'_* 𝒪(d) ≅ Sym^d(E')`, to
`g^* Sym^d(E) ≅ Sym^d(E')`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem higherDirectImageZeroIso_baseChange (hn : 1 ≤ n) (d : ℕ) :
    bundleTwistBaseChange g E hfree E' hE D D' 0 (d : ℤ) ≫
        (higherDirectImageZeroIso E' (isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_iso_pullback g E hfree E' hE)
          D' hn d).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (higherDirectImageZeroIso E hfree D hn d).hom ≫
        bundleSymBaseChange g E hfree E' hE (d : ℤ)
declarations.comment: compatibility with base change, the q = 0 row: for g : S' → S and E' ≅ g^*E, the base change map g^* R^0 π_* O(d) → R^0 π'_* O(d) followed by R^0 π'_* O(d) ≅ Sym^d(E') is g^*(R^0 π_* O(d) ≅ Sym^d(E)) followed by g^* Sym^d(E) ≅ Sym^d(E'), for every d ≥ 0 and n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.higherDirectImageTopIso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XX], compatibility with base change, the row `q = n`**: for a morphism of
schemes `g : S' ⟶ S`, `E` finite locally free of constant rank `n + 1` with `n ≥ 1`, `E' ≅ g^*E`
and every integer `d`, the base change map `g^* Rⁿ π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d) ⟶ Rⁿ π'_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E')}(d)`
corresponds, under the identifications `Rⁿ π_* 𝒪(d) ≅ SheafHom(Sym^{-n-1-d}(E) ⊗ ⋀ⁿ⁺¹ E, 𝒪_S)`
and `Rⁿ π'_* 𝒪(d) ≅ SheafHom(Sym^{-n-1-d}(E') ⊗ ⋀ⁿ⁺¹ E', 𝒪_{S'})`, to the canonical map
`g^* SheafHom(Sym^{-n-1-d}(E) ⊗ ⋀ⁿ⁺¹ E, 𝒪_S) ⟶ SheafHom(Sym^{-n-1-d}(E') ⊗ ⋀ⁿ⁺¹ E', 𝒪_{S'})`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem higherDirectImageTopIso_baseChange (hn : 1 ≤ n) (d : ℤ) :
    bundleTwistBaseChange g E hfree E' hE D D' n d ≫
        (higherDirectImageTopIso E' (isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_iso_pullback g E hfree E' hE)
          D' hn d).hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).map (higherDirectImageTopIso E hfree D hn d).hom ≫
        bundleTopTargetBaseChange g E hfree E' hE d
declarations.comment: compatibility with base change, the q = n row: for g : S' → S and E' ≅ g^*E, the base change map g^* R^n π_* O(d) → R^n π'_* O(d) followed by R^n π'_* O(d) ≅ SheafHom(Sym^(-n-1-d)(E') ⊗ ∧^(n+1) E', O_S') is g^*(R^n π_* O(d) ≅ SheafHom(Sym^(-n-1-d)(E) ⊗ ∧^(n+1) E, O_S)) followed by the canonical map g^* SheafHom(M, O_S) → SheafHom(g^* M, O_S') and g^*(Sym^(-n-1-d)(E) ⊗ ∧^(n+1) E) ≅ Sym^(-n-1-d)(E') ⊗ ∧^(n+1) E', for every integer d and n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.isIso_bundleTwistBaseChange_of_ne
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XX], compatibility with base change, the vanishing rows**: for `q ≠ 0, n` the
base change map `g^* R^q π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d) ⟶ R^q π'_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E')}(d)` is an isomorphism of zero
modules, for every integer `d`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_bundleTwistBaseChange_of_ne (q : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hqn : q ≠ n) :
    IsIso (bundleTwistBaseChange g E hfree E' hE D D' q d)
declarations.comment: compatibility with base change, the vanishing rows: for g : S' → S, E' ≅ g^*E and q ≠ 0, n the base change map g^* R^q π_* O(d) → R^q π'_* O(d) is an isomorphism between zero modules, for every integer d

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.isIso_bundleTwistBaseChange_zero_of_neg
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XX], compatibility with base change, the row `q = 0` for `d < 0`**: the base
change map `g^* R⁰π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d) ⟶ R⁰π'_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E')}(d)` is an isomorphism of zero modules.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_bundleTwistBaseChange_zero_of_neg (hn : 1 ≤ n) {d : ℤ} (hd : d < 0) :
    IsIso (bundleTwistBaseChange g E hfree E' hE D D' 0 d)
declarations.comment: compatibility with base change, the q = 0 row for d < 0: for g : S' → S and E' ≅ g^*E the base change map g^* R^0 π_* O(d) → R^0 π'_* O(d) is an isomorphism between zero modules, for n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.higherDirectImage_iso_compatible
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XX]: the identifications of the higher direct images of the twists on a
projective bundle are compatible with isomorphisms between locally free sheaves.** Let
`e : E ≅ E'` be an isomorphism of finite locally free `𝒪_S`-modules of constant rank `n + 1`,
`n ≥ 1`, inducing `𝐏(E') ≅ 𝐏(E)` over `S` and the maps
`R^q π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d) ⟶ R^q π'_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E')}(d)` (`higherDirectImageIsoMap`). For every pair
`(q, d)` of integers:
* `q = 0`, `d ≥ 0`: the identifications `R⁰π_* 𝒪(d) ≅ Sym^d` correspond under `Sym^d(e)`;
* `q = 0`, `d < 0`, and `q ≠ 0, n`: the induced map is zero, between modules that vanish;
* `q = n`: the identifications `Rⁿ π_* 𝒪(d) ≅ SheafHom(Sym^{-n-1-d}(E) ⊗ ⋀ⁿ⁺¹ E, 𝒪_S)`
  correspond under the dual of `Sym^{-n-1-d}(e⁻¹) ⊗ ⋀ⁿ⁺¹(e⁻¹)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem higherDirectImage_iso_compatible :
    (∀ d : ℕ, higherDirectImageIsoMap hfree hfree' e D D' 0 d ≫
        (higherDirectImageZeroIso E' hfree' D' hn d).hom =
      (higherDirectImageZeroIso E hfree D hn d).hom ≫ (symHom hfree hfree' e.hom).app (d : ℤ)) ∧
    (∀ d : ℤ, d < 0 → higherDirectImageIsoMap hfree hfree' e D D' 0 d = 0) ∧
    (∀ q d : ℤ, q ≠ 0 → q ≠ n → higherDirectImageIsoMap hfree hfree' e D D' q d = 0) ∧
    (∀ d : ℤ,
      haveI := isQuasicoherent_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank E hfree
      haveI := isQuasicoherent_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank E' hfree'
      higherDirectImageIsoMap hfree hfree' e D D' (n : ℤ) d ≫
          (higherDirectImageTopIso E' hfree' D' hn d).hom =
        (higherDirectImageTopIso E hfree D hn d).hom ≫ topRowTargetMap hfree hfree' e d)
declarations.comment: compatibility with isomorphisms between locally free sheaves, every row: for an isomorphism e : E ≅ E' of finite locally free modules of constant rank n + 1, n ≥ 1, over an arbitrary scheme S, the maps R^q π_* O(d) → R^q π'_* O(d) induced by e and P(E') ≅ P(E) carry the identification R^0 π_* O(d) ≅ Sym^d(E) to R^0 π'_* O(d) ≅ Sym^d(E') under Sym^d(e) for d ≥ 0, are zero for q = 0, d < 0 and for q ≠ 0, n, and carry R^n π_* O(d) ≅ SheafHom(Sym^(-n-1-d)(E) ⊗ ∧^(n+1) E, O_S) to the same identification for E' under the dual of Sym^(-n-1-d)(e⁻¹) ⊗ ∧^(n+1)(e⁻¹), for every integer d

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.isZero_higherDirectImage_twist
declarations.doc:
For `E` finite locally free of constant rank `n + 1` with projective bundle `π : 𝐏(E) ⟶ S`,
`R^q π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d) = 0` for every integer `d` and every integer `q` with `q ≠ 0` and `q ≠ n`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_higherDirectImage_twist (d q : ℤ) (hq0 : q ≠ 0) (hqn : q ≠ n) :
    IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (relativeProj (bundleAlgebra E hfree)).toBase).rightDerivedPlus
      q).obj (D.algebra.piece d))
declarations.comment: the vanishing row: R^q π_* O(d) = 0 for q ≠ 0, n, every integer d and every integer q, for E finite locally free of constant rank n + 1 over an arbitrary scheme S

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.isIso_symToPushforwardTwist
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map `Sym^d(E) ⟶ π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d)` is an isomorphism**, for `n ≥ 1` and
`d ≥ 0`.
declarations.statement: public theorem isIso_symToPushforwardTwist (hn : 1 ≤ n) (d : ℕ) : IsIso (D.ψ d)
declarations.comment: the q = 0 row in degrees d ≥ 0, in the canonical form: the map Sym^d(E) → π_* O(d) of Tag 01NR is an isomorphism, for n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.higherDirectImageZeroIso
declarations.doc:
`R^0 π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d) ≅ Sym^d(E)` for `d ≥ 0`: the comparison `R^0π_* = π_*` of
[Stacks, Tag 05TD] followed by the inverse of the canonical map of Tag 01NR.
declarations.comment: the q = 0 row, d ≥ 0: R^0 π_* O(d) ≅ Sym^d(E), for n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.isZero_higherDirectImage_zero_of_neg
declarations.doc: For `d < 0`, both `R^0 π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d)` and `Sym^d(E)` vanish.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_higherDirectImage_zero_of_neg (hn : 1 ≤ n) {d : ℤ} (hd : d < 0) :
    IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (relativeProj (bundleAlgebra E hfree)).toBase).rightDerivedPlus
      0).obj (D.algebra.piece d)) ∧ IsZero ((bundleAlgebra E hfree).piece d)
declarations.comment: the q = 0 row, d < 0: R^0 π_* O(d) = 0 = Sym^d(E), for n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.higherDirectImageTopIso
declarations.doc:
For `n ≥ 1` and every integer `d`,
`Rⁿ π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d) ≅ SheafHom(Sym^{-n-1-d}(E) ⊗ ⋀ⁿ⁺¹ E, 𝒪_S)`. For `d ≤ -n - 1` it is induced
by the multiplication pairing `𝒪(d) ⊗ π^* Sym^{-n-1-d}(E) ⟶ 𝒪(-n-1)` and the trace
`Rⁿ π_* 𝒪(-n-1) ≅ (⋀ⁿ⁺¹ E)^∨`; for `d ≥ -n` both sides vanish.
declarations.statement:
public def higherDirectImageTopIso (hn : 1 ≤ n) (d : ℤ) :
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (relativeProj (bundleAlgebra E hfree)).toBase).rightDerivedPlus
      (n : ℤ)).obj (D.algebra.piece d) ≅
      Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf
        ((Stacks.ProjectionFormula.tensorRightInvertible S
          (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))).obj
          ((bundleAlgebra E hfree).piece (-(n : ℤ) - 1 - d)))
declarations.comment: the q = n row, every integer d: R^n π_* O(d) ≅ SheafHom(Sym^(-n-1-d)(E) ⊗ ∧^(n+1) E, O_S), for E finite locally free of constant rank n + 1 over an arbitrary scheme S, n ≥ 1

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleVanishing.isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward_twist
declarations.doc:
**The higher direct images of the twists on a projective bundle vanish outside the relative
dimension.** Let `E` be an `𝒪_S`-module which is finite locally free of constant rank `n + 1`,
let `π : 𝐏(E) = Proj_S(Sym(E)) ⟶ S` be the structure morphism of its projective bundle and let
`𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d)` be the degree-`d` homogeneous piece of a family of twists on it. Then
`R^q π_* 𝒪_{𝐏(E)}(d)` is zero whenever `q < 0` or `q > n`.

Below degree zero this is the vanishing of any right derived functor in negative degrees. Above
degree `n` the affine opens over which `E` is free form a basis of `S`, over such an open the
section ring of `Sym(E)` is generated by `n + 1` degree-one elements, and
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleVanishing.isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward_piece`
turns that into the vanishing. The vanishing in every degree `q ≠ 0, n` is
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleCohomology.isZero_higherDirectImage_twist`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isZero_rightDerivedPlus_pushforward_twist (n : ℕ)
    (hqc : Stacks.SymGraded.IsQuasicoherentPieces E)
    (hfree : Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank E (n + 1))
    (D : TwistData (Stacks.SymGraded.schemeSheafGradedAlgebra E hqc)) (d : ℤ) (q : ℤ)
    (hq : q < 0 ∨ (n : ℤ) < q) :
    IsZero (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
        (relativeProj (Stacks.SymGraded.schemeSheafGradedAlgebra E hqc)).toBase).rightDerivedPlus
      q).obj (D.algebra.piece d))
declarations.comment: the vanishing clause in the degrees above the relative dimension and below zero

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveBundleVanishing.TopDegree.topCohomologyTwistIsoSymTensorDet
declarations.doc:
**The top cohomology of the twists on projective space**: for a commutative ring `R`, for
`n = m + 1 ≥ 1`, an integer `d` and a natural number `k` with `k = -n - 1 - d`,

  `H^n(𝐏(E), 𝒪(d)) ≅ Hom_R(Sym^k(E) ⊗_R ⋀^{n+1}E, R)`,  `E = R^{⊕ n+1}`,

as `R`-modules.
declarations.statement:
public def topCohomologyTwistIsoSymTensorDet (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (d : ℤ) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : (k : ℤ) = -((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1 - d) :
    Stacks.ProjectiveSpace.Cohomology.twistCohomology R (m + 1) d (m + 1) ≅
      ModuleCat.of R
        (TensorProduct R (SymPow.symmetricPower k R (Fin (m + 1 + 1) → R))
            (⋀[R]^(m + 1 + 1) (Fin (m + 1 + 1) → R)) →ₗ[R] R)
declarations.comment: the q = n identification for an affine base S = Spec R and a free module E = R^(n+1), n ≥ 1, on the cohomology module H^n(P(E), O(d))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceCriteria.coherent_tfae
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XZ].** On a locally Noetherian scheme the following are equivalent for a
module `F`: it is coherent; it is quasi-coherent and of finite type; it is of finite
presentation; on every affine open it is the sheaf associated with a finite module; on the
members of some affine open covering it is the sheaf associated with a finite module.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherent_tfae (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules) :
    List.TFAE [
      F.IsCoherent,
      F.IsQuasicoherent ∧ F.IsFiniteType,
      F.IsFinitePresentation,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U), IsFiniteTildeOn F U hU,
      ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens),
        IsOpenCover U ∧ ∀ i, ∃ hU : IsAffineOpen (U i), IsFiniteTildeOn F (U i) hU]

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceCriteria.structureSheaf_isCoherent
declarations.doc: **[Stacks, Tag 01XZ].** The structure sheaf of a locally Noetherian scheme is coherent.
declarations.statement:
theorem structureSheaf_isCoherent (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).IsCoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceCriteria.isCoherent_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
declarations.doc:

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherenceCriteria.isCoherent_of_isInvertible
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01XZ].** An invertible module on a locally Noetherian scheme is coherent.

By [Stacks, Tag 0B8N] (b) an invertible module is, on a covering of the whole scheme, a direct
summand of a finite free module, hence the kernel of `1 - e` for the associated split idempotent;
and the structure sheaf is coherent, so
`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isCoherent_of_locallyKernelFiniteCoproduct` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_of_isInvertible (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F : X.Modules)
    [Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property F] :
    F.IsCoherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentKernel.coherent_tfae
declarations.doc:
**The five equivalent conditions of [Stacks, Tag 01XZ]** for a module on a locally Noetherian
scheme: coherence, quasi-coherence together with finite type, finite presentation, and the two
forms — at every affine open and on some affine open covering — of being the sheaf associated to
a finite module.

Every implication but the two into (1) was available beforehand; the new one is
`isCoherent_of_isQuasicoherent_isFiniteType`.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherent_tfae (F : X.Modules) :
    List.TFAE [
      F.IsCoherent,
      F.IsQuasicoherent ∧ F.IsFiniteType,
      F.IsFinitePresentation,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U), IsFiniteTildeOn F U hU,
      ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens),
        IsOpenCover U ∧ ∀ i, ∃ hU : IsAffineOpen (U i), IsFiniteTildeOn F (U i) hU
    ]

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentTFAE.tfae_isCoherent
declarations.statement:
theorem tfae_isCoherent (F : X.Modules) :
    List.TFAE
      [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F,
        F.IsQuasicoherent ∧ SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.{u, u, u} F,
        F.IsFinitePresentation,
        ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U), IsFiniteTildeOn F U hU,
        ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens),
          IsOpenCover U ∧ ∀ i, ∃ hU : IsAffineOpen (U i), IsFiniteTildeOn F (U i) hU]

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentTFAE.coherent_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01XZ.** The five characterizations of a coherent module on a locally
Noetherian scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherent_tfae (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (F : X.Modules) :
    List.TFAE [
      F.IsCoherent,
      F.IsQuasicoherent ∧ F.IsFiniteType,
      F.IsFinitePresentation,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U), IsFiniteTildeOn F U hU,
      ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens),
        IsOpenCover U ∧ ∀ i, ∃ hU : IsAffineOpen (U i), IsFiniteTildeOn F (U i) hU
    ]

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentOfFiniteType.isCoherent_of_mono_of_isQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01Y1, submodules.** A quasi-coherent submodule of a coherent module on a locally
Noetherian scheme is coherent.

This carries the tag, and with the quotient statement below 01Y1's covering set is complete. The
source (coherent.tex:2364) states exactly two assertions — "Any quasi-coherent submodule of `F`
is coherent. Any quasi-coherent quotient module of `F` is coherent." — and one declaration is
tagged for each. Both are proved here, so the attribute is not an over-claim.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_of_mono_of_isQuasicoherent {G F : X.Modules} [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F) (ι : G ⟶ F) [Mono ι] :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent G

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentOfFiniteType.isCoherent_of_epi_of_isQuasicoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 01Y1, quotients.** A quasi-coherent quotient of a coherent module on a locally
Noetherian scheme is coherent. This is the second of 01Y1's two assertions; see the submodule
statement above for why the tag is complete here.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_of_epi_of_isQuasicoherent {F Q : X.Modules} [Q.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F) (p : F ⟶ Q) [Epi p] :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent Q

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TensorHomCoherent.isCoherent_sheafInternalHom_of_isCoherent
declarations.doc:
**The sheaf-hom clause of [Stacks, Tag 01Y2].** On a ringed space, the sheaf-hom
`SheafHom(ℱ, 𝒢)` between two coherent modules is coherent.

A coherent module is of finite presentation ([Stacks, Tag 01BW] (1)), and the sheaf-hom from a
module of finite presentation into a coherent module is coherent ([Stacks, Tag 01CQ] (2)). The
source states this for a locally Noetherian scheme; see `isCoherent_sheafHom` below for that
statement.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCoherent_sheafInternalHom_of_isCoherent {Y : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (O : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) CommRingCat.{u})
    (F G : SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (spaceRingedSite O).O))
    [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] [_root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent G] :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent (sheafInternalHom (spaceRingedSite O) F G)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TensorHomCoherent.isCoherent_sheafHom
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01Y2], the sheaf-hom clause.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme and let
`ℱ`, `𝒢` be coherent `𝒪_X`-modules. Then `SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(ℱ, 𝒢)` is coherent.

This is `isCoherent_sheafInternalHom_of_isCoherent` at the site of opens of `X` with its
structure sheaf; the Noetherian condition is the source's and is not used.
declarations.statement:
instance isCoherent_sheafHom (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F G : X.Modules)
    [hF : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F] [hG : _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent G] :
    _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent (sheafInternalHom (spaceRingedSite X.sheaf) F G)
declarations.comment: sheaf-hom, as the source states it: locally Noetherian scheme

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.TensorHomCoherent.isCoherent_tensorObj
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 01Y2], the tensor-product clause.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme and
let `ℱ`, `𝒢` be coherent `𝒪_X`-modules. Then `ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} 𝒢` is coherent.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.tensorSheaf_isCoherent`, which carries the tag, read at

declarations.statement:
instance isCoherent_tensorObj (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (F G : X.Modules)

declarations.comment: tensor product, as the source states it: locally Noetherian scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_epi_over_of_stalk_surjective
declarations.doc:

stalk is an epimorphism after restriction to a neighbourhood of that point.

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.SheafHomStalk.exists_localHom_of_stalkLinearMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 01Y4.** A linear map out of the stalk of a finitely presented sheaf of
modules on a ringed space is represented by a homomorphism on some open neighbourhood.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_localHom_of_stalkLinearMap (X : TopCat.{u})
    (Rc : TopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u} X)
    (G F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheaf Rc))
    [G.IsFinitePresentation] (x : X)
    (ψ : TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u})
        (commVal G).presheaf x →ₗ[TopCat.Presheaf.stalk
          (C := CommRingCat.{u}) Rc.obj x]
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (commVal F).presheaf x) :
    ∃ (U : Opens X) (_hxU : x ∈ U) (φ : G.over U ⟶ F.over U),
      ∀ (V : Opens X) (hVU : V ≤ U) (hxV : x ∈ V) (m : G.val.obj (op V)),
        TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u}) F.val.presheaf V x hxV
            ((φ.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hVU)))) m) =
          ψ (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (C := Ab.{u}) G.val.presheaf V x hxV m)
